ji ltar rgyal sras phan pa'i bsam pas 'dir// 'gro kun rnam par smin byed gnas pa ltar// de bzhin pha dang ma dang gnyen bshes rnams// bu dang gnyen pa rnams la legs mi gnas// ji ltar brtse bdag bde dang phan phyir sbyor// sems can gzhan la byams 'dod de ltar ni// skye bo bdag la'ang byams par mi 'dod na// rab sdug skye bo gzhan brten smros ci dgos/ shin tu mdza' ba'i 'gro ba gzhan ci smros// zhes 'grel chen du bsgyur// zhes so// rab sdug skye bo ni mdza' bo'am grogs po ste de dag gcig gis gcig la phan 'dogs pas kyang bsgrun du med ces pa'i don du blo brtan no// rnams mang tshig ste/ gcig ni mos dang ldan pa dang*// lhag pa'i bsam pa dag pa gzhan// mtshan ma dang ni mtshan med dang*// mngon par 'du byed med spyod pa// lnga po 'di dag sa kun la// byang chub sems dpa' yin zhes bya// zhes te/ mos spyod kyi sa bzhi la gnas pa ni mos pa dang ldan pa'i ste chos dbyings kun 'gro mngon du ma byas kyi chos dbyings kun 'gro la dad cing yid ches pas so// zhes te tshogs lam pa'ang der bsdu dgos so// (59) sa dang po pa lhag bsam dag pa'i ste/ mthong spang sgrib pa gnyis spangs pa'i phyir rnam par dag pa zhes bya'o// sa gnyis pa nas drug pa'i bar mtshan ma spyod pa'i ste/ sa gnyis pa la theg pa gsum du 'byed pa'i mtshan ma spyod pas so// gsum pa la/ 'jig lta lhan skyes kyi mtshan ma 'byung bas so// bzhi pa la sdug kun gyis gnod 'gog lam zhi bar mthong ba'i mtshan ma sbyong bas so// lnga pa la bzo'i las kyi rnam pa sna tshogs la rtog pa 'byung ngo*// drug pa la rten 'brel lugs mthun lugs bzlog la rtog pa'i mtshan ma yod pas so// sa bdun pa la mtshan med spyod pa'i ste drug pa man la 'byung ba'i mtshan ma rnams spangs pas so// brgyad pa yan mngon par 'du byed med pa la spyod pa'i ste/

don gnyis dang mi rtog ting nge 'dzin lhun grub tu gnas pas so// zhes 'di'i 'grel chen du blo brtan no// gnyis pa ni/ lam gsum bden pa'i skye med du shes pa snying rje la sogs pa'i thabs dang bcas pa nyid kyis so// gsum pa ni/ 'jig pa la brten pa'am shān+tis skad cig gis 'jig cing rgyun gyis 'jigs pas rab tu 'jigs pas 'jig rten te bcud kyi sems can la phan pa'i don mngon mtho nges legs ji ltar 'os pa bzhin du dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas sgrub pa'am gser rdzogs par mdzad pa'o/ gser// gang gis na yum sher phyin gyis te/ de yang yum sher phyin chos can/ byang se'i yum yin te/ de'i rgyud la lam shes bskyed nas byang sems mngon mtho nges legs sogs kyi 'gro don sgrub par bsgrubs pa'i/ mi rtog ye shes/ yin pas so// lam shes de'i yum du (60)

yang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ 'dir lam shes ni sngar bshad ltar dang lam gsum phyin ci ma log par ji bzhin shes pa'i rjes thob gnyis ka gzung ste/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal por bdud rtsi 'thob byed lam ni 'di yin gyi/ lam ngan spongs la lam bzang mnos shig ces// lta ngan sems can mthong nas 'doms byed de// rgyu des byang chub sems dpa' zhes brjod do// zhes pa ltar ro// des na byang sems 'jig rten gyi don bsgrub pa chos can/ lam shes kyi 'bras bu'i tha snyad byar rung*/ de phan byed du yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pas so// rtags grub ste/ rim bzhin du lam gsum shes na bstan nus la snying rje sogs yod na bstan 'dod de lam bstan pas mngon mtho nges legs la 'god pas so// sems 'grel du/ rang nyid nges pa gzhan dag la// nges pa bskyed par bya ba'i phyir// rtag tu 'khrul pa med par ni// mkhas rnams rab tu 'jug pa yin// zhes so// yang rang gis lam mi shes na bstan mi nus la snying rje sogs med na bstan mi 'dod de/ ji skad du/ rang gi rtogs pa'i rjes 'brang bas// ji tsam zhig ni dpag par nus// thabs byung de rgyu lkog gyur pas// de 'chad pa ni dka' ba yin// zhes 'grel ched du drangs so// gsum pa ni/ lam shes kho nas 'jig rten gyi don bsgrub par mi rigs te gzhi shes rnam mkhyen gyis kyang sgrub pas so zhe na/ byang sems 'jig rten gyi don sgrub pa'i dngos kyi rgyu tshogs su gyur pa'i thabs lam shes kho nar 'dod kyi 'jig rten gyi don sgrub byed thams cad lam shes kho nar mi smra'o// gsum pa la/ gsungs par mdzod ces pa'i chos gsum ste/ gsungs (61) shing ston pa'i don/ de'i 'thad pa/ de la rtsod spong ngo*// dang po la/ thabs gang las/ gang zag gang gis/ 'bras bu gang gsungs gsum las/ dang po ni/ rnam mkhyen gang dang yang dag ldan pas so// gser ni yum gang dang zhes so// gang spyi sgra yin yang mkhyen pa gsum las med cing gzhan gnyis smros zin pa'i lhag shān+ti mar gyur pa dang*/

gang mngon rtogs su ldan pa'i stobs kyis brgyad khri bzhi stong gi chos 'khor bskor zhes pa'i don gyi shugs shān+ti kyis kyang rnam mkhyen la go ste/ dkon mchog gi sgras dge 'dun go ba dang 'ga' zhig 'ongs so zhes pa bzhin no// dag ldan du/ lhag ma dang don gyis zhes so// khyad par thub pa'i tshig dang 'brel bas go ste dza mad ag ni'i bu rā ma zhes pas rā ma'i khyad par gcig go ba bzhin no// dpe de dag ngag las shes so// gnyis pa ni/ sgo gsum mi dge ba la gser don dngos 'jug pa thub pa ste/ yang dag par gser bsdams pa ste sangs rgyas gser shān+ti so// yang na bdud bzhi thub ces kyang rung ngo*// de yang sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa can zhig ste/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab par// la la sangs rgyas chos rnams la// dpe 'god ji snyed byed pa ni// de dag sangs rgyas mi 'tsham ste// de dag rgyal la skur ba 'debs// 'di la dpe gcig yang dag ste// nam mkha'i khams su bstan pa lags// de ni sangs rgyas chos dang mthun// gang na'ang de yi tshad ma mchis// nam mkha' 'dir ni ji tsam pa// sangs rgyas kyi ni tshul khrims dang*// ting nge 'dzin dang rnam grol dang*// rnam grol ye shes mthong (62) de can// nam mkha'i tshad ni ji tsam par// sangs rgyas gzugs kyang de tsam ste// 'jig rten mgon po'i spyi gtsug kyang*// nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs pa lags// nam mkhas ji snyed khyab gyur pa// skus kyang de snyed khyab pa lags// de bzhin du sku dang 'od dang gsung dang thugs dang byams pa dang ye shes dang sku rnams sbyar ro// gnyis pa ni/ sna tshogs 'di dag rnam pa kun gsung gser 'gyur ba zhes te/ sher phyin la sogs pa'i chos 'khor sna tshogs 'di dag rnam pa kun tu ste thams cad gser du gsungs shing gser ston par mdzad gser pa'o// dag ldan du sna tshogs 'di dag rnam pa kun mkhyen pa zhes bya ba la rnam pa kun ni chos 'di dag rnam pa kun te de kun nas mkhyen pa'i'o// 'di'i yum zhes so// 'gyur 'di ltar na/

theg pa che chung ngam sde snod gsum gyi rnam pa kun bu ston gser zhes sam bden pa gnyis kyi chu 'od gnyal gser rnam pa kun dang ldan pa'i zhes sbyar ro// gang gis sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos gsung bar mdzad na/ yum gyis te/ yum sher phyin chos can/ rdzogs sangs rnams kyi yum yin te/ de rnams kyi rgyud la rnam mkhyen bskyed nas de rnams kyis brgyad khri bzhi stong gi chos 'khor bskor bar bskrun pa'i mi rtog ye shes yin pas so// rnam mkhyen de'i yum du yang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ thub rnams chos 'khor gsungs pa chos can/ rnam mkhyen gyi 'bras bu'i tha snyad byar rung zhes sogs dgod do// rtags rim bzhin du grub ste/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes thugs rje chen po can rgyud la yod na de bskor nus te/ mdor rnam mkhyen nyid thob nas chos kyi (63) 'khor lo bskor zhes so// de med na bskor mi nus te/ 'dab gshog med pa'i bya 'phur mi nus pa bzhin/ mdor/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par ma bgyis par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi nus so zhes so// gsum pa ni/ rnam mkhyen nyid de'i rgyur smros pa mi 'thad de/ ljags sogs yang de yin pas so zhe na/ rnam mkhyen nges pa'i rgyu yin gyi gzhan yang rgyu yin pa mi 'gog go /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ don dngos/ de'i 'thad pa'o// dang po ni/ nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs te dge 'dun ni 'jig rten gyi shān+ti dngos bla ma yin la/ sangs rgyas ni bla ma de'i yang*/ shān dngos/ dam pa'o// de dag gi shān dngos yang bla mar gyur pa'i yum sher phyin de la bstod de/ tshogs bcas sangs rgyas kyi yum zhes pa'i shān tshig gis de dag gi yang yum shān don du bstan to// 'o na bu dang ldan pa'i chung ma de ni bu'i yang chung mar 'gyur ro zhe na/ 'dir bcas sam ldan pa'i don ni lhan cig pa la brjod par 'dod pas skyon med do// zhes pa rnams shān+tis so// gnyis pa ni/

yum sher phyin chos can/ 'phags bzhi'i yum yin te/ snga phyi la ltos te de'i ngo bo bskyed/ de'i gnas skabs gso ba'am rgyas par byed/ de la phan chen po 'dogs pas so// rtags grub ste/ yum shān don sher phyin gyis 'phags bzhi'i zag shān don med kyi phung po ma bskyed cing de dag gi zag med kyi phung po ma gsos pa de srid du de dag gis nyer zhi thob sogs don chen po thob par mi nus pas yang yum mo// yang yum sher phyin la 'phags bzhis nyer (64) zhi sogs don chen po gsum thob pas phan btags pa'i phyir na yang ste/ shān+tis/ yum dngos sher phyin de la bsdus phyag 'tshal lo// 'di ji ltar de rnams kyi yum du 'gyur zhe na/ ji skad bshad pa'i don chen po gsum thob pa'i phyir te/ gang yang 'jig rten gyi phan pa chen po 'dogs pa de ni 'jig rten na ma zhes bya'o// gzhan yang ji srid du de dag gi zag pa med pa'i phung po'i bdag nyid ma bskyed cing ma gsos pa de srid du de dag gis ji skad du bshad pa'i don chen po rnams thob par mi nus so// de'i phyir don gyis na bskyed pa dang gso ba yin par shes par bya'o// de'i phyir yang 'di yum yin no zhes so// rnam par mi rtog par bstod pa las/ gzhan don mngon dga'i bdag nyid can// dpa' bo dag ni thams cad kyi// gso mdzad bskyed par mdzad pa ste// khyod ni byams ma'i yum lags so// zhes so// mkhyen gsum dang 'phags bzhi yum sras su sgrub pa yang shes par bya ste/ snga phyi bskyed bya skye byed dang dus mnyam gso ba dang bzhed pa sgrub pa'i yum yin pa'i tshul gyis so// yum byed tshul yang shes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ yul bla ma'i shān+ti yang bla mar gyur ba'i yum sher phyin de la gang zag rje btsun byams pas phyag 'tshal ba 1$0000220shān+ti 1$0000270 ste sgo gsum gus pas 'dud pa'o// 'dir 'phags pas 'phags bzhi gang zag thams cad kyi dbang du mdzad nas thams cad mkhyen pa rnam pa gsum gyi/

thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan nye bar dgod pa sngon du 'gro bas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod pa 'di ni mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi (65) man ngag bshad sbyar du bya'o snyam pas bshad pa don bsdus 'di sbyar bar dam bcas pa yin no zhes dang*/ btsun grol yang de skad 'chad pas dngos su yon tan brjod de phyag 'tshal nas shugs la brtsam par dam bcas pa yin par shes par bya'o// 'o na mchod brjod kyi brjod bya mkhyen gsum go rim 'chol te/ dman shos gzhi shes dang por brjod pas so zhe na/ bod snga rabs rnams gleng gzhi'i 'grel ba yin pas skyon med zer ba ni 'khrul te 'phags seng sogs rgya gar mkhas pa sus kyang de skad ma bshad cing slob dpon dang chos bshes kyis gleng gzhi rgyan gyi ma bsdus par bshad pa dang 'gal zhing*/ gal te gleng gzhi'i 'grel pa yin pas de'i'o// rim bzhin dgos na rnam mkhyen dang por ston dgos par 'gyur te bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab ces thog mar byung bas so// bstan bcos rin chen sgron mar/ gleng gzhi rgyas par bka' stsal don mchog rnams// legs par bsdus pa phyag 'tshal tshigs bcad yin// zhes seng bzang gis bshad do zhe na/ bstan bcos de ni bod kha cig gis byas kyi seng bzang gis mdzad pa ma yin no// de las mthar gyis pa dngos po drug tu bshad pa la sogs 'gal ba du ma yod ces gsungs shing don la'ang der gnas so// gzhan yang rgya gar mar ming btags nas bod kyis byas pa don bsdus sgron ma dang sdud pa'i lde mig dang dharma shrī'i 'bum ṭīka dang nyi khri gzhung 'grel chung ba sogs mang po snang ngo*// des na mchod brjod du mkhyen gsum gyi go rim 'di dman mchog gi rim pa (66) yin la/ lus rgyas bshad du rnam mkhyen zhes sogs kyis bstan pa ni mchog dman gyi rim pa'o// gsum pa 'grel pa la lnga/

dgos bsdus tshig don/ mtshams sbyar brgal lan no// dang po la gsum/ rtsa bas yum gyi yon tan brjod/ de las yum la dang ba'i tshul/ dang ba las gang zhig 'grub pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ zhes bya ba'i skad dod/ i ti ni/ smra sgor/ i ti rgyu mtshan gnas skabs dang*// gsal byed sogs dang rdzogs rnams la// zhes de rnams la 'jug pa las 'dir de ltar gyi don yin zhing gsungs pa ni bshad pa ste/ rgya dpe 'ga' zhig la yod de/ phal cher la mi snang zer ro// nyan thos zhi tshol zhes sogs mchod brjod kyi tshig bcad 'dis ni chos can/ yum sher phyin 'di'i che ba'i yon tan gyi bdag nyid dam dngos po phul du byung ba dang ldan par brjod de/ yum sher phyin gyis 'phags bzhi nyer zhir khrid sogs yon tan khyad par ba ston pas so// gnyis pa la gnyis/ dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang ba'i tshul/ chos kyi rjes 'brang dang ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ mchod brjod tshigs bcad des yum gyi yon tan brjod pa thos pas rkyen byas nas yum la dang ba skye tshul gnyis yod pa las re shig dang po brjod na/ dang ba skye'o// gang zag gang na/ tshig tsam las gser nges shes skye ba dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba ste/ de ni gang zag gtso bor byas nas 'jug pa'o// zhes mdo kun btus 'grel par/ shān+tis so// gang la na yum sher phyin 'di la'o// ji ltar na/ yum la de 'dra'i yon tan yod dam med snyam pa'i the tshom med par byas nas thos ma thag 'jam gsar bu skye bas myur du chen por gsar bu skye bas rab tu'o// (67) mchod brjod chos can/ dgos pa yod de zhes dgod do// 'og ma la yang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ dang ba skyed par byed pa nyid do// rkyen ni/ de thos nas so// gang zag gang na/ chos kyi mtshan nyid la lung rigs kyis brtags dpyad byas nas 'jug pa chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams so// kyang ni dad rjes 'brang du ma zad do// 'di ni rang gi shes rab gtso bor byed pa'o zhes mdo kun btus 'grel par shān+tis so// gang la na/

yum de la'o// ji ltar na rkyen ngan pas mi 'phrogs pa'i rab tu'am chen po'o// 'o na snga mar 'di zhes nye tshig dang*/ 'dir de la zhes ring ba'i sgra smros pa ci ltar yin zhe na/ rtsa bar yum de la zhes pa'i tshig la gnyis ka bsnyeg pas snga ma de la tshig rim nye bas 'di la zhes nye tshig dang*/ phyi ma 'di de bas tshig rim ring bas de la zhes ring ba'i tshig smros so// lha dbang blos/ de zhes pa ni lkog tu gyur pa'i sgra'o// 'di zhes pa ni mngon du gyur pa'i'o zhes bshad do// dbang rnon mchod brjod las yum la dang ba skye ba'i rgyu mtshan la gnyis las/ de'i brjod bya'i don la gnod byed ma mthong ba dang*/ sgrub byed gzung ba'o// dang po ni/ mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya dbang rnon chos can/ de 'dra'i mchod brjod ngag las yum sher phyin la rab tu dang ba skye ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzhi phung skye sogs dang lam gsum dang rnam pa chos nyid dam rnam rtags mtshan ma thams cad don dam par bden pa'i skye ba med par yongs su shes pa yang yin/ mchod brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i brjod bya'i don sras chos bshes gsum bskyed nus kyi mtshan nyid dam rang bzhin can yang yin (68) pa'i yum la bden pa'i skye ba yod chos bshes do zhe'am/ sras gsum dngos skye ba'i mtshan nyid dang mi ldan no zhes rigs pa rnam dag gis gnod pa ma mthong nas te rgyu mtshan gyis chos bshes dngos de 'dra de skyes pa'i phyir ro zhes sbyar te/ chos bshes kyi don dngos so// bden pa'i skye med du gang las 'grub ce na/ gzhi lam rnam gsum chos can/ bden pa'i skye ba med de/ bden pa'i gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dam rang bzhin dang bral ba'i phyir/ gzugs brnyan bzhin/ sogs pa rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje gzegs ma/ 'bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog rten 'brel chos bshes gyi rtags dang*/

rgyu 'bras gnyis ka la dpyod pa chos bshes don mu bzhi skye 'gog ste dngos po'am snang ba don dam par gdod ma nas ma skyes pa nyid du yid ches par byed pa'i rgyu gtan tshigs de dag nyid chos bshes dngos la yul 'jal ba'i tshad ma de byed pas tshad ma zhes bya zhing rgyu mtshan des so// de bzhin du tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i dbang las rigs pa zhes bstan/ blo don dang mthun par sgrub cing der 'dren pa'i phyir na sgrub pa dang 'dren pa nyid du yang bstan to zhes chos bshes so// 'thad pa sgrub pa'i rigs pas bsdus pa bden dngos dgag pa'i rtags bzhi'am lnga ste/ dang po ngo bo la dpyad pa gcig dang du bral ni/ dngos po'am snang ba chos can/ de kho nar bden pa'i dngos por med de/ don dam pa'i bden pa'i gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i phyir/ gzugs brnyan bzhin/ lang gshegs las/ ji ltar me long ngos rnams la// gcig dang gzhan nyid spangs pa'i gzugs// snang yang de na yod ma yin// de bzhin dngos

(69) rnams ngo bo nyid// ces dang*/ gang gis dngos po rnams dpyad na// zhes sogs drang ngo*// gnyis pa rgyu la dpyad pa rdo rje gzegs ma ni/ dngos po chos can/ don dam par bden pa'i skye ba med de/ don dam par bdag las/ gzhan las/ gnyis ka las/ rgyu med las mi skye bas so// rtsa sher las/ bdag las ma yin gzhan las min// gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min// dngos po gang dang gang la yang*// skye ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes so// gsum pa 'bras bu la dpyad pa yod med skye 'gog ni/ chos can chos 'dra/ don dam par 'bras bu yod zin mi skye/ med pa mi skye bas so// rigs pa drug cu par/ yod pa skye bar rigs min te// med pa nam mkha'i pad+ma bzhin// zhes so// bzhi pa rten 'brel gyi rtags ni/ chos can chos 'dra/ rten 'brel yin pas so// sgyu ma bzhin no// blo gros rgya mtsho'i mdor/ gang rnams rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*// de rnams rang bzhin cung zad med// ces so// lnga pa mu bzhi skye 'gog ni/ chos can chos 'dra/ don dam par rgyu du mas 'bras bu gcig dang du ma mi byed/ don dam par rgyu gcig gis 'bras bu gcig dang du ma mi byed pas so// bden gnyis las/ du mas dngos po gcig mi byed// du mas du ma byed pa'ang min// gcig gis du ma'i dngos mi byed// gcig gis gcig byed pa yang min// zhes so// rgya cher dbu ma'i thal rang bstan bcos rnams dang*// mdor bsdus pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i lung gi snye ma sogs las shes par bya'o// de dag la yang dpyad par bya rgyu mang po yod de skabs 'grig na phyis bstan (70) pa la'o// gnyis pa la/ spyi'i don yang lung snye sogs las/ shes par bya ste/ go sla bas 'dir ma bris so// yan lag gi don ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes pa khyad par chos dngos gyi gzhi'o/ dngos/

de'i khyad par ni thams cad mkhyen pa dngos nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid ces smros te/ yum de la yang kun rdzob tsam du yang dbye ba byar med do snyam pa dgag pa dang sras gsum car skye bar bstan pa'i phyir tshig 'di smros te/ rnam par mi rtog par bstod pa las/ sangs rgyas rnams dang rang dngos sangs rgyas// nyan thos rnams kyis nges bsten pa'i// thar lam khyod nyid gcig bu ste// gzhan zhes bgyi ba ma mchis nges// zhes bstod cing*/ nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang sher phyin la bslab ces sogs gsungs so// 'o na yul 'di nyan rang rnams skyed pas gang zag gi bdag med chos bshes dngos tsam zhig yin zhing byang sems dang sangs rgyas skyes pas bdag gnyis med pa nyid yin la/ gang zag gi bdag med tsam ni dran pa nyer bzhag sogs las bstan/ bdag gnyis med pa ni sdong po bkod pa sogs las bstan pas yang yum 'di bstan pa la don lhag po med la yum 'di yang theg pa gsum gyi rang rang gi rtogs pa las rmad du byung ba ci yod snyam na/ de bsal ba'i phyir tshul gsum pa can zhes smros te/ 'dir yum la mkhyen pa gsum du phye ba ni rang bzhin nam dngos po chos bshes gsum du phye ba min te de ltar dbye mi nus chos bshes dngos pa'i phyir ro// 'o na ci zhe na 1$0000220dngos/1$0000270 gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang kun dngos gis sras gsum gyi yum yin no zhes bstan gyi don la (71) 'am dngos su ni sangs rgyas byang don thob sems kho na'i yum yin gyi nyan rang g.yung po lta bu ni bud kun dngos med rin po che lta bu'i yum 'dis dngos su ga la skyed/ mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag sogs kyang theg dman gyi lam tsam bstan pas gzhung phyogs gcig pa yin no// sdong po bkod pa sogs theg chen gyi bya ba'am tshul dang 'bras bu sogs gtso bor bstan gyi nyan rang gi lam 'bras ma bstan pas phyogs gcig pa'o// yum 'dir rigs can gsum ka'i bstan pa bsgrags pas gzhung chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i sde yin no zhes dang*/

de'i phyir rang bzhin gcig kho na las med par rkyen gzhan kha cig gis du mar snang ba'i du ma ji snyed pa ni 'dir tshul gyi sgras bstan no// des na du mar snang yang gcig tu sgrub pa ni/ tshul gsum pa can ni zhes bya ba yin la/ gcig du mar ston pa'i mthu dang ldan par ston pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid ces smros so// de lta'i mthu de su'i mthu snyam na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes te/ don gyi go rim ni de ltar blta bar bya'o// chos bshes so// de ltar na yum sher phyin chos can/ sangs rgyas dang sogs pas nyan rang byang sems te sras 'phags bzhi dngos dang brgyud pa ci rigs pas bskrun par mdzad pa ni gdon mi za bar srid pa nyid do// gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang gis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid de dngos por dbyer yod pa'i mi rtog ye shes yin pas so// 'on kyang*/ de chos can/ don la khyod yin pa'i theg pa gsum gyi mkhyen gsum mtshan nyid pa dbyer mi rung ste/ mkhyen pa gsum (72) gyi tshul lam cha byad dam rnam par mdzad pa can yin gyi khyod yin pa'i gzhi shes mtshan nyid pa med pas so zhes pa chos bshes kyi dgongs pa ste bod dag ni gzhung klog pa tsam du zad do// des na mchod brjod gdul bya dbang rnon chos can/ ngag de las yum la rab dang skye ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ yum sher phyin gyis chos kun don dam par skye med du rtogs shing sras 'phags bzhi bskrun pa'i sgrub byed yang dag mthong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de skye bas so// gsum pa ni/ mchod brjod ngag gis yum gyi yon tan brjod pa la brten nas yum de la rab tu dang ba skyes pa las brjod bya yum sher phyin de dang de la brten pa'i gsung rab ste de brjod byar byed pa'i rjod byed bu 'od zer mgon po mdo bstan bcos sam/ yang na rgyas 'bring bsdus pa sogs de dang brten pa mngon rtogs rgyan zhes ral gri'o// gser ni/

yum dang de la brten pa ting nge 'dzin rgyal po sogs zhes bzhed par mngon no// de 'dra de rnams la shin tu gus par byed do// kyang ni dang bar ma zad do// gang zag gang na/ yum sher phyin de'i yon tan nam 'bras bu nyer zhi thob pa sogs la mngon par 'dod pa'i gang zag rno rtul gnyis ka yang ngo*// ci'i don du na/ tshig rnam pa thams cad du gzung ba dang don rnam pa thams cad du kun chub pa la sogs pa'i don du'o// yang na dus dang skabs kyi rnam pa thams cad du zhes sbyar ro// gus par byas pa'i rjes de nas thos pa dang sogs pa bsam pa dang bsgoms pa las byung ba'i shes pa'am shes rab skye ba'i rim gyis yum la 'jug go /de la ming la dmigs pa'i shes rab ni thos pa'i shes rab bo// ming don gnyis ka la dmigs pa'i shes rab ni bsam byung*/ don kho na la dmigs pa'i shes (73) rab ni sgom byung gi shes rab ces mdzod du/ thos sogs las byung blo rnams ni// ming dang gnyis ka don yul can// zhes so// dbyig gnyen ni de lta na bsam byung du 'dod pa'i shes rab de ming la dmigs cha nas thos byung dang don la dmigs cha nas sgom byung du song bas bsam byung dngos mi rnyed pas/ yid ches pa'i lung tshad ma las skyes pa'i dang*/ rigs pas nges par brtags pa las skyes pa'i dang*/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i shes rab gsum la rim pa bzhin du bzhed do// 'dir bsam byung gi rten rigs pa ni rgyus 'bras bu skyed pa bya ba byed pa'i/ 'bras bu rgyu la ltos pa ltos pa'i/ rtags dang dpe sogs ni 'thad pa sgrub pa'i/ de dag de ltar yin gyi de las gzhan du min pa chos nyid kyi rigs pa bzhi ste rgyas par shes par bya'o// de ltar zhugs pa las legs pa'i mchog byang chen thob par 'gyur ro// rnam par mi rtogs par bstod pa las/ lan gcig tsam yang bsam dag pas// khyod la tshul bzhin blta ba gang*// des kyang mthong ba don yod kyi// dngos grub nges par thob par 'gyur// zhes so// 'dir byang chub gsum la 'chad pa ni nor ba'o// des na bcom ldan 'das ma sher phyin chos can/

khyed la rab tu dang ba ni mtho ris dang byang dza ya maṭ+nata yang ngo*// grol gyi legs pa thams cad 'thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo ste dang po'i rgyu yin no// mchod brjod ngag gis khyed kyi yon tan brjod pa las dang*/ dang ba las gus/ gus pa las khyod la thos sogs kyis 'jug zhugs pa las legs pa'i mchog byang chen thob pa de'i phyir ro// chos bshes ni gtso bo'i rgyu ni byed rgyu'o// (74) zhes dang*/ gser ni dngos kyi rgyu zhes gong du'o// gnyis pa ni/ de la zhes pa snga phyi sbrel ba'i tshig gi phrad dam/ mchod brjod la dgos bsdus tshig gsum yod pa de la ste de'i nang nas bsdus pa'i don ni zhes sam/ mchod brjod kyi dgos pa bstan nas mchod brjod de'i don gtan la 'bebs pa la dang po bsdus pa'i don ni/ bstod do// gang la na sher phyin la'o// gang gi sgo nas na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi thun mong ār+ya ma yin pa'i yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas so// de'i rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa ci zhe na/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis ni mdo'i don mngon rtogs brgyad bsdus la brgyad po de dag kyang dngos btags ma phye na spyir sher phyin pa'i ming 'thob pa yin zhing*/ mkhyen pa gsum po des kyang nyan thos dang de'i phyogs su bslan pa zhes sogs tshig don du 'chad par 'gyur pa'i tshul gyis 'phags bzhi'i bzhed pa'i don thams cad phun sum tshogs par rdzogs par 'gyur zhing 'gyur ba yin no zhes de ltar byams mgon gyis thugs la bzhag nas te bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis dang de ltar bstan pa'i ched du'o zhes pa'o// gsum gyis brgyad bsdus zhes pas don la mdo'i don thams cad skabs gsum du yang bsdu bar ston zhes chos bshes so// 'di yang bsdu bya sdud byed so sor ma phye bas gsum gyis brgyad bsdus zhes bya yi/ phye na gsum gyis lnga bsdus pa yin no// rje btsun byams pa chos can/

mkhyen gsum gyi yon tan brjod pa'i sgo nas yum sher phyin la bstod pa mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gsum gyis brgyad bsdus brgyad po'ang dngos btags ma phye na sher phyin gyi ming 'thob (75) cing gsum pos 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de'i sgo nas de la bstod pas so// de la dgos pa yod de de ltar bstan pa'i ched du zhes dgod do// dgongs pa de yin mod bod sgros rnying pa dang mi mthun pas rjes zlos goms pa rnams kyi blor shong ba dka' 'o// 'dir mkhyen gsum pa bstod ces phal cher 'chad kyang*/ dngos su gsum la bstod pa min gyi thabs gsum po de'i sgo nas gang zag gsum gyi don sgrubs zhes yum sher phyin nyid la bstod par snang ngo*// spros pa la dga' na sbyor phreng yid kyi mun sel du sgros rnying pa'i lugs yang bkod yod pas shes par bya'o// rang kir ni/ mkhyen gsum dngos po'i dbye bas phye ba yin la gzhan rnams ni 'di las spros pa yin pas mkhyen gsum ni dngos po'i dbye bas phye zhes rtogs pa'i ched du gsum po 'di rnams nyid kyi rab tu dbye ba'i phyag 'tshal zhes so// dngos po'i dbye bas ni rdzas tha dad gzhan dang gzhan yin zhes pa'i don no// gsum gyis brgyad ji ltar bsdus na/ dbang rtul rim gyis sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rim pas dang por nyan thos kyi 'bras bu'i dbang du byas te/ rnam kun tu rnam mkhyen gyi rnam par byang phyogs so bdun bstan te nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi byang phyogs so bdun lam gyi gzhir bstan/ de la rnam pa du zhes rtog pa la/ mthong lam gtso bor byas te gzhi shes kyi rnam pa med pa nas 'dul ba med pa'i bar bcu drug bstan/ gzhi shes de'i mtshan nyid ji lta bu zhes rtog pa la/ gzhi shes kyi shes mtshan bcu drug don ngo 1$0000220don 1$0000270mtshan bzhi ste nyi shu chos bshes dngos bstan gsungs te de lta na yang byed mtshan

(76) la yang cha shas thob bam snyam mo// nyan thos kho rang gi mtshan nyid nyer gsum la zer dgos so// nyan thos kyi sbyor lam gang zhe na/ 'phags pa nyan thos lam la zhes sogs dang*/ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang*/ zhes sogs kyis shugs la bstan no// de las mthong lam 'byung bas skabs gnyis pa gsum par shugs bstan gyis mthong lam bstan/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu ni go sla bas sam kho rang gi gzhung la ltos pas sam/ gdams ngag tu/ dbang po rtul dang rnon po dag /ces sogs kyis thun mong du bstan rung ngo*// zhes so// mdor na/ rnam kun gyi gzhi shes kyi rnam pa dang po bcu drug dang byang phyogs so bdun dang mtshan nyid go gcig gi shugs bstan gyi nyan thos kyi mtshan nyid kyi cha/ spyod pa bkag pa'i shugs bstan gyi sbyor lam rnams kyi nyan thos kyi rtogs pa'i cha lam shes kyi nyan thos kyi sbyor lam dngos/ lam shes dang gzhi shes shugs bstan gyi mthong lam nyan thos kyi rtogs pa'i cha rnams nyan thos kyi gzhi shes kyis sdud tshul ci rigs par bsdus so// lam shes kyi rang rgyal gyi sbyor mthong rnam kun gyi rang rgyal gyi shes rnam bcu gcig rang rgyal gyi gzhi shes kyis bsdus so// gzhi shes kyi skabs bsdus pa'o zhes so// nyan rang zhi ba'i dbyings las langs te theg chen du zhugs pa na/ dang por rnam mkhyen du bstan pa'i sems bskyed dang po gsum bskyed de/ gdams ngag la brten nas tshogs lam phal pa sbyangs nas rnam kun tu bstan pa'i thar cha bskyed de/ skabs dang por bstan pa'i sbyor lam dang go sgrub dang skabs bzhi pa lnga par bstan pa'i sbyor lam sbyangs te/ (77) sbyor lam de dag gi rtags thob par byas nas/ de yan chad rigs la gnas shing 'jug sgrub dang*/ lam shes kyi mthong lam bskyed/ skabs lnga pa'i mthong spang rnam rtog spangs nas yang lam shes kyi sgom lam bskyed/ tshogs sgrub la gnas/

skabs lnga par bstan pa'i sgom spang rnam rtog spangs te lam de gnyis kyi rnam pa mtshan nyid rtags dang bcas par sbyangs nas/ mthar gyis pa sbyangs te/ bar chad med rtse gtso bor gyur pa'i skad cig ma nges 'byung sgrub pa'i ngo bo can rdzogs par byed de/ sems bskyed/ rigs/ gdams ngag dmigs pa/ ched du bya ba/ yon tan skyon dag ni thun mong du ci rigs su sbyar te lam shes kyi skabs bsdus pa'o zhes so// mdor na sems bskyed nyer gnyis kyi thog mar skyes pa'i 'dun sogs gsum/ gdams ngag bcu'i dang por tshogs lam phal pa bas thob pa'am nyams su blangs ba'i gdams ngag sgrub pa bzhi'i thog mar skyes pa'i go sgrub/ rnam kun gyi thar cha lam shes kyi yul nges pa sogs kyi thar pa cha mthun gyi cha rnams tshogs lam gyis bsdus/ rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor lam/ 'jug sgrub kyi sbyor lam ba'i rtogs pa'i cha/ tshogs sgrub dang po bco lnga'i cha/ rnam kun gyi sbyor lam gnyis/ rtse mo'i sbyor lam rnams sbyor lam gyis bsdus so// lam shes dang gzhi shes dngos bstan gyi mthong lam/ rtse mo'i mthong lam/ rnam kun gyi mthong lam rnams mthong lam gyis bsdus so// lam shes kyi sgom lam rnam kun gyi dang*/ rtse mo'i sgom lam tshogs sgrub kyi sgom lam gnyis/ nges 'byung sgrub pa/ bar chad med

(78) rtse rnams sgom lam gyis bsdus so// mthong sgom gyi rnam pa mtshan nyid rtags spang bya spong ba rnams de gnyis su 'dus so// mthar sbyor ni lam bzhi'i mthar sbyor bas med pas lam bzhir 'dus so// sems bskyed lhag ma rnams las tha ma gnyis min pa dang*/ gdams ngag lhag ma rnams ci rigs su byang se'i lam de dag tu 'du'o// rigs bcu gsum ni brten pa sgrub pa bcu gsum lam shes su 'du bas de'i rten gyis bsdus/ dmigs pa de la dmigs dgos pas yul du bsdus/ ched du bya ba dang yon tan gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi thob byar bsdus/ skyon rnams yum la chos spyod byed pa na dor dgos pas spang byas bsdus so// sems bskyed tha ma gnyis dang thun mong min pa'i shes rnam brgya dang bcu sangs rgyas sa'i mtshan nyid rnams dang*/ ched du bya ba'i mthar thug gi cha sogs rnam mkhyen gyis bsdus te gzhan yang dpyad cing bsdu ba shes par bya'o// chos sku ni rnam mkhyen gyis bsdus/ 'phrin las ni chos sku'i bya ba yin pas byed pa pos bsdus so// bsdu tshul la gnyen pos spang bya bsdu ba sogs mang du yod pas shes dgos so// bsdu tshul de dag phal cher chos bshes kyi dgongs pa'o// gsum pa la/ gang zag gsum gyi bzhed don sgrub par bstod/ 'phags bzhi'i yum du bsgrubs pas phyag 'tshal ba gnyis so// dang po la/ rtsa ba bzhin gsum las/ dang po ni/ thob par mdzad do// gang gi lan/ nyan thos dang der ma zad rang sangs rgyas kyang ste'o// bsam pa ji 'dra can zhe na/ rang gcig pu zhi bde'i mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pa can no// rnams ni mang tshig go /rtsa bar rang rgyal bstan pa med do zhe na/ rang rgyal (79) chos can/ mchod brjod kyi nyan thos zhi ba tshol zhes sogs rkang pa dang pos ma bstan pa min te/ des khyod nyan thos kyi phyogs su bslan nas bstan pas so// slon pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/

chos can/ der slon pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gang zag theg dman bsam pa rang don rtogs pa gzhi shes mtshan nyid pa'i rim par gcig pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis der bslan pas so// des na nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi mngon rtogs thun mong min pa gzhi shes kyis nyer zhir khrid ces bstan pas rtsa bar rang rgyal yang bstan no// nyan thos dang khyad med dam snyam na/ chos can/ nyan thos pas lhag pa yin te/ phyi'i gzung ba bden 'dzin gyi rtog pa las rnam par thar pa cung zad tsam zhig ste gzung ba bden med rtogs pa'i phyir/ des lhag go /rang rgyal gyis gzung med rtogs tshul ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten ni res 'jig res 'chags pas dang*/ bcud kyi yang sems can gyi lus rab tu 'jig pas bdag med du rtogs sla bas der rtogs la 'dzin pa'i sems ni 'khor ba rnams su rgyun brtan pas de dag bdag med ces de dag gi ye shes mi 'jug go zhes chos bshes so// thabs ni/ dmigs yul gzhi thams cad rnam pa gang zag dang gzung ba bden pa'i skye ba med par yongs su shes pa nyid kyis so// 'bras bu gang na/ nyon mongs spangs kyang sdug bsngal gyi phung po dang bcas pa dang sdug bsngal gyi phung po'ang med pas las nyon gyi 'bras bu'i me zhi ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa ste myang 'das rnam pa gnyis thob par mdzad pa'i yum gang yin pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ gang zag byang chub sems dpa' (80) dus gdul bya'i 'khor ba ji srid par 'gro ba'i don byed pa rnams/ thabs dmigs yul bud+dha shrī lam gsum po thams cad rnam pa mnyam bzhag tu bden pa'i skye ba med par dang rjes thob tu lam gsum gyi ngo bo dmigs rnam sogs legs par rtogs pa grogs snying rje chen po dang bcas pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis/ 'bras bu gdul byar gyur pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don mngon mtho nges legs sgrub par mdzad pa'i yum gang yin pa dang*/ gsum pa ni/

bskor bar mdzad do// thabs gang las na/ dmigs yul rnams pa rdzas rigs ma lus pa thams cad rnam pa bden pa'i skye ba med par dang ji snyed pa mtha' dag thugs su chud pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes gang dang ldan na ste des so// gang zag gang gis na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spang bya kun yang dag par bsdams pa'i sku'am rang bzhin can/ dbang phyug gser dngos chen po la sogs pa las rnal 'byor ches gser dngos lhag pas gser nyan rang byang sems don dngos ni rnal 'byor can gser gyi dbang phyug gser dngos go /rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes gser sogs kyis che ba'i gser yon tan gyis sangs rgyas rnams ni de rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu yin pas gtso bo ste des so// 'bras bu gang na/ chags sdang gti mug gsum cha mnyam ste/ rtsa ba bzhi re re la nyi khri chig stong ste/ brgyad khri bzhi stong la spyod pa'i gnyen por chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa rnam pa thams cad do// de yang chos 'khor gyi sgra don ni/ gdul bya'i rgyud la mkho bar snang bas sam/ tsakra tshogs la 'jug pas chos kyi tshogs so zhes chos bshes so// rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che ni yul khams sam gling gzhan du 'pho/ (81) ma rgyal ba las rgyal bar byed/ rgyal ba rnal du 'god par byed/ sa mtho bar 'phar dma' bar 'bab pa bzhin du gdul bya'i rgyud chos bshes la 'pho/ sa gong ma mtho ba pa rnams sgrib pa las rgyal nas thob par byed/ sgrib pa spangs nas thob pa rnams la bde bar gnas/ khams gong ma'i nyon mongs sel/ dma' ba 'dod pa'i yang nyon mongs sel bas lung dang rtogs pa'i chos de nyid la 'khor lo zhes dpe'i blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo 'grel du ming ngo*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yang*/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad legs par bshad pa la bya ste/ 'phags pa'i lam gyi chos de yang 'khor lo dang 'dra ba'i phyir chos kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ste/

ji ltar 'khor lo ni lte ba dang rtsibs dang mu khyud bzhin du 'phags lam yan lag brgyad las/ yang dag pa'i ngag dang*/ yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang*/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba gsum ni tshul khrims kyi phung por gtogs te lte ba dang 'dra'o// yang dag pa'i lta ba rtog pa dran pa rtsol ba bzhi ni shes rab kyi phung par gtogs te rtsibs dang 'dra'o// yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni spros pa thams cad zhi bar byed pas mu khyud dang 'dra'o// rnam pa gnyis su na ji ltar 'khor lo rin po che des phyogs sam rgyal ba rnams ni rgyal bar byed/ rgyal ba rnams su gnas 'cha' ba de bzhin du/ 'phags lam gyi chos 'di yang sa gong ma ma thob pa rnams ni sgrib pa las rgyal nas thob par byed/ sgrib pa spangs nas thob pa rnams la ni gnas so// rnam pa gsum du na 'khor lo de gyen du 'gro zhing*/ bla 'og tu dgra sel ba de bzhin du 'phags lam brgyad 'di yang shes rab myur ba'i rang bzhin yin pas bla la ni gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams kyi nyon mongs pa sel/ 'og tu ni 'dod pa'i khams kyi nyon mongs sel bas 'khor lo dang 'dra'o zhes so// ma lus pa ni chos phung brgyad (82) khri bzhi stong ngo*// chos kyi phung po re re'i tshad ni/ kun btus 'grel bar rgyal po'i sras dang chos bshes ni/ sh+lau ka stong nyid de/ tshigs bcad re la tsheg bar sum cu rtsa gnyis re'o// 'dir rtsa gsum zhes pa ma dag go /de ltar byas na chos kyi phung po thams cad la tshigs bcad bye ba phrag brgyad dang 'bum phrag bzhi bcur 'gyur ro// 'di ni re shig thun mong gi grangs so zhes so// mdzod 'grel du/ re re la sh+lau ka drug stong du bshad de/ shā ri'i bus mdzad pa'i bstan bcos chos kyi phung po dang tshad mnyam zhes so// mngon pa ba kha cig phung po sogs chos can re re ston pa las brtsams pa'i gtam gyi tshogs rdzogs pa re la 'dod de/

de'i ltar na'ang thams cad kyi tshad 'di tsam bzhag rgyu med do// mdzod du/ kha cig bstan bcos tshad ces zer// phung po la sogs gtam re yin// spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni// chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs// zhes so// chos bshes kyis/ theg chen gyi dbang du byas te lha'i dbang po'i glang chen rab brtan 'di'i lus kyi mtha' bskor du dpag tshad bdun yod par bshad gyis khur bar 'os pa'i snag tshas chos phung gcig bri bar nus so zhes gsungs te/ de ltar byas na drin lan bsab par lhas byin gyis spos mdor yod kyi glang po che lnga stong gis khur bar bya ba'i glegs bam rnams kha ton du brjod par byed do zhes gsungs pa'ang rigs par 'gyur ro// chos phung de snyed yod na ci'i phyir deng sang 'dzam bu'i gling na mi snang zhe na/ kha cig ni 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na spyod cing*/ gzhan yang (83) phal cher klu rnams kyi gnas na spyod de/ slob spring las/ bstan pa rin chen mchog ltar bzang la 'phan med pa// rnam par dag tshul gang yin klu mgo'i gdengs ka can// chen po rnams kyis gtsug gi rgyan bzhin gus mnos nas// sa yi gting na gnas pa'i rab rib sel bar mdzad// ces so// chos kyi phung po de dag kyang sde snod gsum du bzhag ste/ mdo dbyangs lung tshigs ched brjod kyi sde lnga nyan thos kyi mdo sder 'du/ gleng rtogs de skyes bzhi gnyis ka'i 'dul ba'i sde snod du 'du/ bam po bzhi bcu par bshad/ shin rmad gnyis byang se'i mdo sder 'du/ gtan phab gnyis ka'i mngon pa'i sde snod du bsdus so zhes sogs dang*/ yum 'bum ldan ma sogs byang se'i shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod du bsdus zhes so// bye brag tu smra ba ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo mthong ba'i lam// zhes mthong lam kho na chos 'khor du 'dod de/ rgyu mtshan 'phros dang bcas pa mdzod las shes dgos so// chos bshes ni/

spyir tshogs sbyor nas bar chad med lam gyi bar ro// zhes te mi slob lam chos 'khor du ma bshad snang ste dpyad par bya'o// rnam pa thams cad du bskor ba ni/ dang po drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su ko'u di n+ya la sogs pa la bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor te 'di ni dman pa'i chos 'khor ro// de nas rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri la snying po dang mngon par rtogs pa'i don ston pa'i mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor/ de'i 'og tu ri ma la ya la sogs par mngon pa'i sde snod mtshan nyid gsum phye ba'i don dam rnam nges kyi chos 'khor chos bshes kyi phyogs sngar ro// (84) de la chos bshes ni/ de mi rigs te thub pa chen pos rim gyis chos bstan pa med de zhes lung drangs shing*/ chos 'khor ma lus pa skad cig kho na la bskor yang gdul bya'i dbang gis dus ring thung dang gsung tha dad thos par zad ces gsungs te/ kun shes ko'u de n+ya sogs la gsungs pa'i bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor de chos 'khor dang po min zhes sogs rgyas par 'byung ba ni ha cang snyon 'dings pa ste/ mdo sde dgongs 'grel las/ de dang por bshad cing de'i 'grel ba rnams dang brgyad stong 'grel chen sogs las kyang dang por bshad do// 'khor lo gsum rim can min par skad cig gcig kho na la bskor zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de mdo de las rim can du bskor bar gsungs shing*/ skad cig gcig kho na la bskor na dgung lo so drug pa la sangs rgyas nas brgyad cu'i bar ci zhig mdzad/ yang 'khor lo bar pa drang don/ tha ma nges don du smra ba ni rnam par 'khrugs zhes gsungs pa'ang sangs rgyas la skyon 'dzin pa ste/ mdo dgongs 'grel du/ dngos su rgyas par de skad bshad pas so// des na 'khor lo tha ma gnyis rang bzhin spros bral stong nyid 'od gsal ston par 'dra yang tha ma gsal bar bcud mi gsal zhing bar bar thams cad med thams cad yod ces dang thams cad dge

thams cad mi dge thams cad lung ma bstan zhes sogs dgongs pa can mang pas drang don du gsungs shing*/ tha mar yod med sogs legs par phye nas bstan pas nges don du gsungs pa ste rgyas par shes dgos shing skabs 'grig na phyi nang gi grub mtha' rnam 'byed rtsom par spro ba yod do// gnyis pa (85) ni/ gtso bo sangs rgyas 'khor nyan thos dang sogs pa rang rgyal byang sems dang bcas pas yongs su bskor ba de sgrub par byed pa nyid kyi yum de la phyag 'tshal lo// kha cig de mi 'thad de rang rgyal sangs rgyas dang de'i nyan thos med pa na 'byung bas snyam na/ skyon med de/ rang rgyal dgra bcom la bsam na bskor zhes pa da lta sangs rgyas dang lhan cig nyid du gnas mi dgos kyi spyir sangs rgyas kyi 'khor yin pas so// rgyal po'i 'khor bzhin/ slob pa la bsam na sangs rgyas dang lhan cig gnas pa nyid do// bzhi pa ni/ rje btsun gyis thog mar mkhyen gsum gyi yon tan gyi sgo nas yum la phyag 'tshal bas bstan bcos rtsom par dam bcas ār+ya 1$00002201$0000270so// de la dgos pa med do zhe na/ dgos pa yod par dgos 'brel gyi ngag gis ston no// dgos ldan gyi bstan bcos gang zhe na/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// zhes sogs lus dang yan lag rgyas bshad kyis ston no// lnga pa la brgal lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa'i tshul de ltar phyag 'tshal ba dang bstod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ār+ya don rtsom na ci zhig brjod byar byas nas rtsom/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi don du gzhi phyi nang gi dngos po tsam mam/ spang bya spang ba'i 'grel chen don phyir gnyen po ma lus pa tsam mam/ shes bya ma lus pa shes 'grel chen pa'i phyir du rnam pa ma lus pa tsam ste de las gang yang rung ba re re tsam zhig brjod byar bsdus par mdzad grang na/

phyogs dang po ltar na mngon rtogs rgyan chos can/ dus phyis byams pas (86) khyod rtsom pa la gser don 'bad pa don med pa yin par thal/ gzhi tsam ston pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ de lta na mngon pa'i sde snod dang gser zlos pa'i skyon du 'gyur te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mngon rtogs rgyan 'di las ni mtshan nyid kyi bstan bcos te mngon pa'i sde snod las mi smros pa'i gzhi gang yin pa de 'byung ba ni med do// yang na sher phyin ni mdo 'grel chen don la sbyar ro// ār+yas mdo sde 'di las zhes so// chos bshes kyis/ gzhung gang las sa sogs dngos po rnams srab la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid du don dam par yod par ston pas mtshan nyid kyi bstan bcos so// gzhung gang las don dam par mtshan nyid med par ston pa ni kun rdzob tsam du mtshan nyid ston kyang mtshan nyid kyi bstan bcos min te kun rdzob ni don dam par gnas pa'i mtshan nyid can min pas so zhes so// gnyis pa ltar na yang*/ rgyan chos can/ spang bya kun nas nyon mongs pa'i dngos po rang gi brjod byar ma bsdus par thal/ rnam par byang ba ni myang 'das te de'i rgyu lam gsum gyi dngos po tsam kho na rang gi brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod la brten nas lam gsum po 'di spang bya gang gi gnyen po yin pa khong du chud par mi 'gyur ro// 'dod na/ yang 'phags bzhi'i gser don mngon rtogs rgyan du rtsom pa don med par thal lo// gsum pa ltar na yang*/ rnam pa gzhi las 'grel chen dngos tha mi dad dam tha dad pa gcig bsdus 'grel chen dang po ltar na gzhi bsdus pa la bkod pa'i skyon yod 'grel chen dngos do// gnyis pa ltar na/ rgyan chos can/ mtho ris dang thar pa don gnyer la nye bar mkho

(87) ba'i don cung zad kyang ma bshad par thal/ rnam pa gzhi dang 'brel ba med pa rtog pas gser dngos sprul pa tsam zhig brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir/ rtags khas so// khyab pa yod de/ de bsgom pa gser goms kyang gzhi'i don gang yang gser rtogs pa'am gser 'grel chen 'gyur rnying thob pa med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod brtsams pa don nam dgos pa med par thal ba yin no snyam du gzhan blo dman pa dag sems sam dogs par 'gyur ba ma yin nam ste yin no zhe na/ snang ba dang rnam 'grel du yang 'di dang 'dra bar snang zhing*/ 'grel chen du ni mdzad grang na yan gyi don phyogs sngar byas nas/ phyogs dang po ltar na man ril po rang gzhung du mdzad do// gnyis pa la gsum/ gsum car bsdus tshul mdor bstan pa/ de nyid lung gis rgyas par sgrub/ bsgrubs pa de yi mjug sdud bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ bstan bcos 'di chos can/ gzhi gnyen rnam pa gang rung re re kho na brjod byar bsdus pa de ni ma yin te/ gang gi phyir na/ gzhi gnyen rnam pa'i phyogs gsum car gyis kyang brjod byar bsdus pa'i phyir ro// rtags ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag rang gi brjod byar bsdus pas so// rtags ma grub na/ der thal/ mkhyen gsum rang gi brjod byar rdzogs par bsdus pas so// khyab pa yod de/ go rim ji lta ba bzhin sbyar na/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs mtha' dag gzhi shes kyis bsdus/ byang chub sems dpa'i mngon rtogs mtha' dag lam shes kyis bsdus/ (88) bla ni gong ste de'i gong na de bas 'phags pa med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs mtha' dag rnam mkhyen gyis bsdus pas na/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag bsdus pas na'o zhes sbyar ro// rtags dgod dang khyab sgrub tu mdzad pa la ni 'brel ba med do// gnyis pa la lung drang*/

de'i don bsdus te bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po la gsum/ yum bar ma/ bsdus pa/ rgyas pa'i lung gis bsgrub pa'o// dang po la/ bstan/ bshad do// dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum chos can/ 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs bsdus te rgyu mtshan 'di ltar ram gang phyir na de bsdus par bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'i yum tshig bar ma nyi khri lnga stong sgom rtse'i spang bya rtog pa tha ma dgu'i dang po gsum gyi mdo yin pa las don mthun du bshad pas so// ji ltar bshad na/ su bhu ti zhes pa rab 'byor ram legs 'byor te/ brgyad stong par gnas brtan rab 'byor zhes par 'grel chen du lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten du mchod pa la sogs pas mthu dang brtson pa thob pa'i phyir gnas brtan no// nyon mongs pa med pa rnams kyi nang nas mdzes shing mchog tu gyur pa'i sems kyi 'byor pa gang la yod pa de ni rab 'byor ro// zhes su'i sgra rab bam mdzes pa'am mchog tu bshad pa'o// zla zer du'ang gnas brtan ni mchod pa'i don/ dgra bcom nyon mongs med par gnas pa rnams kyi mchog gi phyir ro// zhes so// 'on kyang dus phyis don de ltar yin gyi 'di ni dang po nyid nas btags pa'i ming yin te/ gang po la sogs kyi rtogs brjod brgya par/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od bsrung gi dge slong chos smra bar gyur te slob ma (89) slob mi slob lnga brgya tsam yod de/ re shig sdang sems kyis sbrul gdug pa rnams zhes brjod pas skye ba lnga brgyar klur skyes shing mkha' lding gis zas mthar shāka thub kyi nyan thos mthong bas dad bzhin du shi nas mnyan yod kyi ded dpon 'byor pa'i bur skyes 1$0000220ral gri 'byor po zer 1$0000270nas ming 'dogs pa na pha 'byor pa yin zhing sngar bu med pas da rab tu 'byor 'dug pas rab 'byor zhes thogs zhes btags par bshad do// rab 'byor zhes bos nas/ gzhi thams cad shes pa nyid ni gang zag nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon rtogs yin no// lam shes pa nyid ni gang zag byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mngon rtogs yin no// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni/

gang zag chos phyin ci ma log par ston pas gzhan don phun sum tshogs pas de bzhin gshegs pa/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pas rang don phun sum tshogs pas dgra bcom pa/ phun tshogs de gnyis thob byed kyi lam thugs su chud pas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon rtogs yin no// bshad pa de rnams 'grel chen gyi'o// sgra sbyor bam gnyis su/ ta thā ni de bzhin/ ga tā ni gshegs pa'am phyin pa'am/ mkhyen pa'am gsungs pa la bya ste/ tshig gi don ni/ spyir sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams ji ltar gshegs shing phyin pa dang chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid mkhyen cing gsungs pa la yang bya ste zhes dang*/ a ra had/ lha mi kun gyis mchod par 'os pas mchod 'os zhes kyang bya ste/ 'dir ni nyon mongs pa'i dgra bcom pas na dgra bcom pa zhes gdags zhes (90) dang*/ saṃ myag saṃ bud+dha zhes pa/ spyir na chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid ma nor bar thugs su chud cing mngon par byang chub pa'i mtshan te yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya zhes so// gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po gzhi shes kyis nyan rang gi mngon rtogs bsdus tshul ni/ bcom ldan 'das zhes bos nas/ gzhi thams cad 'tshal ba ste/ shes pa nyid rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon rtogs lags/ zhes zhus pa'i lan ni/ rab 'byor thams cad ces bya ba ni skabs 'dir gzugs sogs phyi dang mig sogs nang gi skye mched kyi chos rnams ji snyed pa 'di tsam yin la/ mdo gzhan du'ang*/ bram ze thams cad/ ces bya ba ni skye mched bcu gnyis ji snyed pa yin no// zhes gsungs so// mdzod 'grel du drangs so// gzhi phyi nang gi skye mched de dag kyang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis mnyam bzhag tu rim pa ltar gang zag dang bdag phyed dang gnyis kyis stong par shes shing rjes thob tu de dag gi ngo bo ci rigs par shes pa'i cha mtshan 'dzin gyi blo zhig 1$0000220dbyig gnyen 1$0000270gzhi shes yin gyi/

theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad bden pa'i skye med dam lam gsum ji bzhin shes pa nyid kyi sgo nas kyang shes pa min pas lam shes ma yin la/ rnam pa rdzas rigs ma lus pa thams cad mngon gsum du mkhyen pa'ang ma yin pas rnam mkhyen min no// kyang yang ni phan tshun bsdu ba'i tshig go /yang na/ theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad kyis kyang nges par 'byung ba ma yin pas lam shes min/ ji ltar ji snyed pa'i rnam pa thams cad du yang (91) mkhyen pa ma yin pas rnam mkhyen min zhes sbyar ro// nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon rtogs ni chos can/ gzhi thams cad shes pa nyid ces bya'o// mkhyen gsum gyi ya gyal gang zhig lam shes rnam mkhyen gang yang min pa de'i phyir ro// gnyis pa/ lam shes kyis byang se'i mngon rtogs bsdus tshul ni/ bcom ldan 'das rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du lam gyi rnam pa 'tshal ba nyid ni/ gang zag byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mngon rtogs lags/ lan ni/ rab 'byor zhes bos nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos can/ khyod kyis ni mtshan mar gzung ste bsgoms na nyan thos kyi lam du 'gyur ba gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa gang yin pa dang*/ 'dzin pa'i mtshan mar gzung ste bsgom na rang sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gyur ba phyi gzung ba bden med rtogs pa gang yin pa dang*/ chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa'i lam thams cad de/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa bdag phyed gnyis med rtogs/ bdag mtha' dag med rtogs kyi lam thams cad kyi rigs rgyud la bskyed par bya zhing*/ lam de thams cad mnyam bzhag tu rang bzhin med par dang rjes thob tu ji lta ba bzhin phyin ci ma log par shes par bya'o// lam gsum po de dag gi spangs rtogs kyi rigs kyang yongs su rdzogs par bya zhing*/ lam gsum po de dag gi lam gyi bya ba sgrib pa spong ba dang sems can smin pa yang bya dgos te/

mkha' khyab sems can 'khor ba las sgrol bar bzhed pa'i slob lam pa yin pas so// de yang nyan rang gi spangs (92) rtogs sa dang por rdzogs gsungs te/ sa dang po yan du nyon mongs spang bya med par 'gyur te/ nyan rang dgra bcom gyi spangs pa der rdzogs pas so// khyab pa yod de/ theg dman dgra bcom gyis nyon sgrib spangs par theg pa che chung kun las bshad pas so// spyod 'jug tu/ nyon mongs spangs kyang de dag la// zhes dang*/ rnam 'grel du yang*/ nyon mongs med dang*/ zhes dang*/ spel mar bstod par/ bse ru'i rwa dang 'dra gang dang*// gang yang khyod kyi rjes 'gro slob// grol ba tsam du khyod dang mtshungs// rmad byung yon tan tshogs kyis min// zhes so// mdor/ dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ zhes sogs te lung mtha' yas so// rgyun du zhugs pa dang rang sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi shes pa dang spong ba gang yin pa de ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa yin no// zhes mdor gsungs shing*/ ār+yas/ bzod pa gang yin zhe na/ sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa'o// zhes so// gnod 'joms su/ mi skye ba'i bzod pa sa brgyad pa la bshad nas der rdzogs gsungs te/ dad rjes 'brang nas rang bsdus sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi shes pa dang spong ba gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i bzod pa yin no// zhes bya ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab kyi che ba bstan pa ste/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgra bcom pa'i lam gyi 'bras bu'i shes pa dang nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa rnams kyi/ sa brgyad pa la zhugs pa mi skye ba'i chos la (93) bzod pa tsam nyid kyis mthar gtugs par 'gyur te/ de dag gi shes pa dang spong ba ni bzod pa de las lhag pa med do// de phan chad ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams rnam pa thams cad du nyon mongs pa med do// zhes bshad pas/

rdzogs pa'i don sa brgyad par thob pa'i spangs rtogs de bas lhag pa nyan rang dgra bcom la med kyi der de'i spangs rtogs kyi rigs rdzogs pa'am de thob pas de dag gi spangs rtogs kyi don mthar phyin pa tsam la de skad zer ro// des na ār+ya'i ltar mi legs kyi gnod 'joms ltar shin tu legs so// ār+ya ltar na sa dang po yan du nyon mongs spang rgyu med par 'gyur ba'i skyon 'ong bar snang ngo*// 'od zer mgon po ni rtogs pa sa dang por rdzogs/ spangs pa sa brgyad par rdzogs zhes so// ral gri ni/ rtogs pa sa dang po dang spangs pa sa bcu par 'dus zer ro// zla grags ni/ rang sangs rgyas rnams thub dbang dbyangs skyes bcas// rdzogs pa'i byang sems dang po la gnas pas// bsod nams dbang gis thul zhing rnam par 'phel// ring du song bar de ni blos kyang lhag /ces sa bdun pa ma thob bar du rtogs pas zil gyis gnon mi nus gsungs so// theg chen slob pa'i spangs rtogs kyi ngo bo tsam ci rigs pa sa dang por rdzogs shing ma lus pa rgyun mthar rdzogs gsungs bu ston rin po che so// zhing sdud tshig go /byang sems chu mig sam/ lam gsum po de dag gis yang dag pa'i mtha' chos nyid dri bral gyi 'gog pa mthar thug mngon sum du ni mi bya'o// gtan nas mi bya'am zhe na/ (94) dmigs bsal ston pa ni gzhan don brlabs can sgrub pa'i smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa ma byas pa dang*/ ji ltar rma dang zas la de dag gi /gzag dang spyad du rung ba smin 'dod ltar// de bzhin rten 'dir phyogs gnyis zhi ba dang*// yongs su spyad la smin pa nyid du bstan// zhes pa ltar/ gdul bya'i sems can rnams sgrib pa ci rigs spong rung dang gnyen po skye rung du byas pa ni yongs su smin pa yin la de ltar ma byas pa dang*/ rang 'tshang rgya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi snod bcud kyi zhing yongs su ma sbyangs par mi bya zhes dngos su bstan pas rdzogs smin sbyangs nas bya zhes 'phangs so// zhing sbyong ba ni/

gang du sangs rgyas na zhing de'i sems can mtha' yas pas mngon mtho nges legs thob par byed nus pa'i snod bcud can zhig la zer gyi/ dag pa'i zhing kho nar byas pa mi dgos te gzhan du ma dag pa'i zhing med par 'gyur ro// dag pa'i zhing la yang theg dman dang bud med kyi ming yang mi grags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhing lta bu dang*/ nyan thos yod cing bud med kyi dngos po med pa bde ba can lta bu dang*/ bud med yod pa mngon dga' lta bu'o// don thob 'di man ār+ya 'grel chen du yod ma dag pa'i zhing la yang snyigs ma lnga dang ldan mi ldan gnyis las phyi ma na sems can de dag yongs su chud par 'gyur ba med do zhes so// 'dir kha cig yang dag mtha' ngo bo nyid sku min te/ tshogs ma rdzogs par de mngon du byed mi nus pas mi bya zhes dgag mi dgos/ nus na de las 'phrin las 'byung bas mi dgos pas so// des na dri ma thams 'od zer mgon po cad dang bral ba'i chos nyid yin te/ de dmigs (95) bsal ma rdzogs par mngon du byas na myang 'das chad pa'i mthar ltung zhes zer ro// mi rigs te dri ma thams cad bral ba'i chos nyid dang*/ ngo bo nyid sku la khyad med de/ rgyan du/ de bzhin nyid de thams cad la// khyad par med kyang dag gyur pa// de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir// zhes sogs mtha' yas so// ngo bo nyid sku mngon du byas na ji ltar byas kyang rung ste sangs rgyas pa yin zhes pa'i lan de legs so// chad pa'i yang dag mtha' yang min te rdzogs smin sbyangs kyang mngon tu mi byed pas so// des na ngo bo nyid sku yin no/ gnyal chu bu ston kha cig chos can yang dag mtha' dang chos nyid yang dag mtha' gnyis te rtogs pa chos sku dang ngo bo nyid sku yin zhes mdo dang sbyor ba ni/ mdo'i dgongs pa min te/ de bzhin gshigs pa'i sku ni yang dag pa'i mthas rab tu phye bar blta ste 'di lta ste shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o// zhes pas/

chos can yang dag mtha' bstan par/ 1$0000220/bu ston dngos chu mig pa'i don 1$0000270bzhed pa ni mi 'thad de/ 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku zhes pa don dam ngo bo nyid sku yin la de yang dag mthas phye ba ste de nyid sher phyin zhes pa rang bzhin gyi sher phyin la dgongs kyi kun rdzob pa min no// de lta min na/ 'dus byas kyi rtogs pa chos sku chos can/ don dam chos dbyings sogs yin par thal/ yang dag mtha' mtshan nyid pa yin pas so// ma khyab na/ de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'// zhes pa nas/ chos kyi dbyings ni rnam grangs so// zhes dbus mthar bshad cing rgyas 'bring bsdus (96) par yang de rnams rnam grangs su bshad cing*/ theg chen gyi mdo kun las kyang ngo*// 'dir rdzogs smin ma sbyangs par yang dag mtha' mngon du mi bya ste de byed pa la nges par rdzogs smin sbyang dgos pa'i phyir zhes pa'i don tsam du mngon no// kha cig rdzogs smin sbyangs pa gsum 'dir dmigs bsal du 'dod pa ni rnam par 'khrul ba ste/ 'o na de gsum sbyangs na yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed ces par 'gyur/ zhes sogs ngag las shes so// byang chub sems 1$0000220'od zer sogs 1$0000270dpa' rnams kyi mngon rtogs ni chos can/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ces bya'o// rdzogs smin ma sbyangs par yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byed par gzhan don byed pa'i slob lam yin pa de'i phyir ro// gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyis sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs bsdus tshul ni/ bcom ldan 'das rgyu mtshan ci'i slad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid/ gang zag phyin 'grel chen dngos ci ma log pa'i chos nyid thugs su chud 'grel chen pas sam/ ji lta ba nyid ston par 1$0000220'grel chen dngos 1$0000270mdzad pas de bzhin gshegs pa/ mchod par 'os 1$0000220'grel chen 1$0000270pas ār+ya dgra bcom pa/

tshogs gnyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs lags1$0000220 'grel chen ting 'dzin rgyal po'i 'grel par 'jam dpal grags pas bshad snang ngo*// 1$0000270lan ni/ rab 'byor rnam pa ni kha dog dang dbyibs te me 1$0000220dngos 1$0000270 lce zlum pa 1$0000220chos bshes dngos 1$0000270 dang kha dog smug po la sogs dngos te ngo bo dang mtshon par byed pa'i rtags te 'bras bu du dngos ba lta bu 'bras bu dang 1$0000220don 1$0000270mtshan ma ste/ rgyu bud shing lta bu rgyu ste ngo bo 'bras bu rgyu gang gis chos rnams rab tu brjod pa

(97) ste rtogs par byed par 'gyur ba'i rnam pa ngo bo de dag dang rtags 'bras bu de dag dang*/ mtshan ma rgyu de dag ma lus par de bzhin gshegs pas mngon sum gyis thugs su chud do// te tshig lhag ma can no// des na de bzhin nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon rtogs ni chos can/ rnam mkhyen nyid ces bya'o// chos thams cad kyi rnam rtags mtshan ma thams cad mngon sum gyis mkhyen pa'i ye shes mthar thug de'i phyir ro// rnam rtags mtshan ma gsum la rgya 'grel rnams na mi 'dra ba mang ste re re tsam 'og tu yang bshad par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ gsum chos can/ bzhi'i mngon rtogs bsdus te der bar ma las bshad pa de bzhin du don khyad med kyang tshig mdor bsdus pa brgyad stong pa las kyang gsungs pas so// ji skad du na/ nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang sher phyin la bslab par bya'o// sogs pa rang sangs rgyas byang sems sangs rgyas kyi sa la sbyar te bslab par bya'o zhes so// sa ni mkhyen gsum la slob dpon 'chad do// chos rje 'jam gsar sogs/ sa ni lam dang 'bras bu/ sher phyin ni gzhi shes sogs zhes so// gsum pa ni/ gsum gyis bzhi'i mngon rtogs bsdus par tshig rgyas pa 'bum las kyang gsungs so// de yang don re re la'ang rnam grangs du ma dang don tshan re re la'ang gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar 'gres rkyang pa la sogs pas rgya cher ro// gnyis pa ni/ don de ltar gnas pa de la zhes sam/ mkhyen pa gsum bstan pa de la ste de'i nang nas dang po nyan rang gi rgyud kyi gzhi (98) thams cad shes pa nyid mi dmigs pa gzugs dang sogs pa tshor sogs phung po lnga skye mched bcu gnyis khams bco brgyad kyi chos la'o// gzhi shes dngos ston pa'i skabs kyi gzugs sogs zhes 'byung ba rnams su phal cher de ltar sbyar ro// rnam pa ni mi rtag sdug bsngal la sogs bcu drug gi rten can nam yul can bral ba'i 'bras bu gang zag gam bdag phyed gnyis su rmongs pa spangs pa'i 'bras bu can yin no// lam shes nyid ni/

rang rgyud ldan gyi byang sems de gdul bya'i dbang gis theg pa thams cad kyis te 1$0000220chos bshes dngos 1$0000270gsum car gyis nges par 'byung ba ste mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston pa ste/ dge slong dag chos bshes dngos nga lan stong du ni nyan thos kyi mya ngan las 'da' bas mya ngan las 'das so// lan stong du ni rang sangs rgyas kyi mya ngan las 'da' bas mya ngan las 'das so zhes dang*/ theg pa brlabs po ches ni skrag gyur cing*// 'di ni sems can dman la mos rig nas// byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag nyan thos 'gyur// rang rgyal byang chub par yang rab tu ston// zhes so// de kho na nyid ni gang zag la bdag med pa'i mtha' zhi ba nyid de/ de mngon sum du mi byed pa ni sgom pas spang bya'i nyon mongs rnams mi spong zhing de ma spangs na mya ngan las mi 'da' ste slob dpon gyis nyan thos kyi lam ni byang sems kyi shes bya yin gyi mngon sum du bya ba min pas sgom pa'i lam ma bstan to// zhes ston par 'gyur ro// zhes chos bshes so// yang na dmigs pa rgyu'i theg pa thams cad kyis rang rang gi spang bya las nges par 'byung ba la dmigs/ rnam pa de rang bzhin med par shes shing (99) lam gyi bya ba byed kyang de kho na nyid myang 'das mngon du mi byed pa'i rten can zhes gsungs 1$0000220bu ston rin po che 1$0000270te/ 'on kyang theg pa ste lam gsum po thams cad kyis rang rang gi spang bya las nges par 'byung bas rang rang gi spang bya las nges par 'byung byed kyi lam gsum po la dmigs shing byed las rdzogs smin ma sbyangs par de kho na nyid yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed pa'i rten byed pa can bdag 'bras sems can 'khor du ma bsdus pa 'khor du sdud cing tshogs lam bskyed/ sogs pas sbyor lam bskyed de smin mthong sgom bskyed de grol bar byed pa can yin no// yang na shes rab kyis theg pa gsum car gyi lam bsgom zhing thabs kyis de kho na nyid 'chad pa'i myang 'das mngon du mi byed pa'i rten byed pa can zhes sbyar yang 'tsham mo// smin grol mu bzhi ste/

sbyor lam pa smin gyi grol ba min/ mi slob pa grol gyi smin pa min/ mthong sgom pa gnyis ka de las gzhan gnyis min no zhes 1$0000220bu ston 1$0000270so// rnam mkhyen nyid ni dmigs pa chos thams cad rnam pa bden pa'i skye ba med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rten te yul can/ 'bras bu gnyis las gzhan don rgya che ba nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs 1$0000220bzhi mtha' med pa'o zhes gser 1$0000270par sems can gyi don dus rtag tu rgyun mi chad pa/ ngo bo gang 1$0000220bu ston 1$0000270 la gang phan tshul 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba dang*/ rang don la rtogs pa'i khyad par dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'i yang dag pa'i mtha' rtogs shing mngon du byas pa dang*/ spangs pa nyon mongs pa'i bag chags yang yin yang srid par nying (100) mtshams sbyor ba yang yin pas bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba ste/ srid par skye byed nyon mongs pa'i bag chags nyid spangs pa'i 'bral 'bras can yin no// bag chags kyi zhes gser chos gnyis kar du snang ngo*// spangs rtogs de dag mkhyen pa de dang de'i rang bzhin yin pas 'bras bur mi 'thad do zhe na snga phyi rgyu 'bras su rung ngo*// gsum pa ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan ni chos can/ 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs ril rdzogs par bstan pa yin no zhes bya ba 'di 'thad pa yin no// gzhi gnyen rnam pa mtha' dag brjod byar bsdus nas bstan pas na'o// khyab ste de gsum gyis mkhyen gsum bsdus/ mkhyen gsum gyi 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs kun bsdus pa de lta bas na'o// rtsod lan 'di snang ba dang 'grel chen du dgos 'brel gyi 'og tu bstan cing 'dir mchod brjod las 'phros par slob dpon nyid kyis mdzad do// //gnyis pa la snga rtsa 'grel gsum las/ dang po ni/ dgos 'brel gyi ngag gsungs zhes drang ngo*// te ni lhag ma can no// de'i brjod bya gang na/

byams pa rang gi bstan bcos rgyal ba'i yum mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa ston pa thams cad kyi man ngag gi tshig le'ur byas pa 'di'i 'di yan chos bshes dngos brjod par bya ba/ rgyal yum mngon rtogs kyi rim pa ston pa thams cad de 'og tu yum rnam pa gsum car zhes smros pa ni nye bar mtshon pa'i don tsam mo zhes chos bshes te/ 'grel pa'i skabs su yum gyi don la bshad pas mngon rtogs ston pa'i rgyal yum gsum brjod bya dang bcas pa (101) 'di'i brjod bya dang*/ rgyan la brten nas yum don 1$0000220chos bshes dngos 1$0000270 legs par ram chos bshes bde blag tu rtogs pa dgos pa dang*/ rtogs pa ltar sgrubs pas chos bshes dngos sa dang po nas mi chos bshes gnas pa'i myang 'das thob pa'i bar 1$0000220chos bshes 1$0000270dgos pa'i yang dgos pa dang*/ rjod byed bstan bcos rgyu dang brjod bya yum don rtogs shing 1$0000220chos bshes don thob kyi dngos su med 1$0000270 thob pa'i dgos pa gnyis 'bras bur 'brel ba ni 'di'i 'brel ba ste/ de 'dra'i 'brel ba 1$0000220'di yan chos bshes dngos 1$0000270de ched du ma byas kyang shugs nyid kyis rang dbang med par 'brel bas na khong na yod pa ste des na 'brel bas ni bstan bcos dgos pa gnyis bsgrub pa'i thabs yin par yid ches par byed pa'o zhes chos bshes so// chos bshes ni rjod byed dang brjod byar 'brel ba la'ang bshad par mngon no// gang gi don du na/ gnyis te dgos nying dgos so// 1$00002201$0000270dang po la rnam gcod/ yongs gcod gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sgrib gnyis phal cher bcom pa dang ldan pas bcom ldan 'das nga lags nga ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba/ zhes pa ni 'di'i mtshan ma pham pa zhes 'byung ba'i don bstan pa ste 'khor ba'i sems can rnams dag gang las ma rgyal ba ni bdud de de las pham par rgyal te bdud rnams pham par byas pa ste/

gser du ma pham pa zhes bsgyur ro// ting nge 'dzin rgyal por/ ma pham bdud rnams pham byas khyod song shig /ces so// dge ba lhas bdud rnams kyis pham par mi nus pas na ma pham pa ste/ zhes spyod 'jug 'grel (102) bar ro// srid pa tha ma pa rnams bcos ldan 'das yin la sangs rgyas min/ nyan rang dgra bcom rang bī ra sangs rgyas yin la bcom ldan 'das min// sangs rgyas gnyis ka de las gzhan gnyis ka min zhes lung las bshad gsungs so/ 1$0000220bu ston rin po che/ 1$0000270/de 'dra'i byams pas sangs rgyas kyis sngar gsungs bzhin du yang mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa la don te dgos pa ci zhig yod de med dam snyam du skye bo blo gros te shes rab dman pa dag dogs pa bsal ba'i phyir du'o// dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ skye bo blo dman pa dag der dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bcom ldan 'das tshig rgyas pa dang 'bring dang mdor bsdus pa la dad pa'am dga' ba'i sems can dbang po rtul 'bring rno gsum la rim pa bzhin du chos rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyis phan 'dogs par bzhed pa'i thugs rje chen po can nyid kyis bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa de dang de las mngon rtogs brgyad kyi rim pa gzhung sher phyin pa'i don mtha' dag gsal bar mdzad pa ma yin nam ste yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// gnyis pa ni/ dgos 'brel dag gi bstan bya'i don lus kyi dgos sogs chos bzhi la don 'gyur bskyed pa ste bstan bcos lus la dgos sogs chos bzhi phal cher yod snyam pa'i don 'gyur the tshom bskyed pa nyid kyi phyir du'o// don la shes pa la chos bshes sogs bu nor snang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ don 'gyur the tshom skyes pas rtogs ldan bstan bcos la thos sogs kyis 'jug pa de nying dgos yin pas de'i lan yag gam thabs su'o// gnyis pa la/

dgos/ bsdus/ (103) tshig gsum las/ dang po ni/ dpyod pa pa'i ston pa ku mā rī la na re/ dgos 'brel ngag gi dgos pa/ ngag de las ngag gi don la sgra byung tshad mas nges pa skyes pa kho na ste/ spyir ngag tshig thams cad rang rang gi brjod bya la ngo bo nyid kyis rang bzhin 'brel stobs kyis don go bar byed kyi brda 'brel la mi ltos so zhes zer ro// de dgag pa/ ngag de chos can/ ngag don la sgra byung tshad mas nges pa dngos su bskyed pa ma yin par thal/ ngag don dang bdag gcig de byung gi 'brel pa gang yang med pas so// rtags grub ste/ bdag gcig na/ me sgra brjod las kha ni cis mi 'tshig /ces dus 'khor sogs sogs dang*/ de byung med de/ ngag don de med par brjod 'dod las skye bas so// zhes sogs tshad ma'i bstan bcos sogs las shes par bya'o// mkhas grub zhi 'tsho ni/ bstan bcos 'di brtsam bya min te dgos pa sogs med pa'i phyir bya rog so rtog gi bstan bcos bzhin 1$0000220'brel ba sogs med pa'i phyir bstod tshig bzhin zhes sā lu ljang 'grel du klus so 1$0000270zhes bstan bcos rtsom pa'i skabs sam bya ba 'gog pa'i log rtog bzlog pa dgos 'brel ngag gi dgos pa yin zhes gsungs pa'ang de kho na dgos par bzhed na brjod bya med par 'dzin pa sogs bzlog pa'ang de'i dgos pa min par 'gyur bas de yang dgos par bzhed de de ltar yin no// 'di dbu ma bden gnyis kyi bka' 'grel na yod pas slob dpon de'i gzhung na med gsungs pa ni nor ro/ bu ston gsung sgros// bram ze bde byed dga' (104) ba'i bzhed par grags shing lo ts+tsha ba chen po gzhung bkod pa mdzes par byed pa de'i dgos par bzhed de/ des mdzad pa'i 'di'i 'grel bshad du de kho na yin gsung ba snang ste de mi 'thad de/ bstan bcos la dgos med kyi log rtog bzlog pa'ang de'i dgos pa min par 'gyur ba las 'dir don ci zhig yod snyam du dogs pa bsal zhes so// de yang 1$0000220lo ts+tsha ba 1$0000270dgos par bzhed na de ltar yin no// slob dpon 'di dang chos mchog sogs bstan bcos lus la chos bzhi yod par ram bstan bcos dgos pa gnyis kyi rgyur don 'gyur the tshom bskyed pa dgos par bzhed de/

de yang de ltar yin no// dzñā na shrī nges pa skyes pa dgos par bzhed de/ dgos 'brel ngag las bstan bcos kyi lus la dgos sogs chos bzhi yod par nges pa'am bstan bcos dgos pa gnyis kyi rgyur nges pa ste de yang dbang rtul gyi dbang du byas na 'thad do// de ltar na bstan bcos rtsom pa'i skabs sam bya ba 'grogs pa bzlog pa/ gzhung bkod pa mdzes pa/ dbang rnon la de 'dra'i don 'gyur ba skyed pa/ dbang rtul la de 'dra'i nges pa skyes pa/ bstan bcos la dgos med kyi log rtog bzlog pa/ 'brel med sogs kyi log rtog bzlog pa/ dul lhas sum cu pa'i 'grel bshad du bshad pa ltar nyan pa po spro ba bskyed pa thams cad de'i dgos 1$0000220'grel chen sogs 1$0000270pa'am bya ba'i 'bras bu yin la/ de las rtog ldan bstan bcos la thos sogs kyis 'jug pa nying dgos sam bya ba'i 'bras bu'i 'bras bu 'grel chen sogs yin no// spros pa lhag ma rnams gzhan las rtogs (105) par bya ste tshig mangs su dogs pas 'dir ma bkod do// gnyis pa ni/ dgos 'brel ngag gis bstan bcos kyi lus la dgos sogs chos bzhi yod do zhes ston no// gsum pa la/ dngos su zin pa'i chos gsum shugs kyis 'phangs pa'i chos gcig go /dang po la brjod bya/ dgos pa'i dgos pa/ dgos 1$0000220chos bshes ltar ro 1$0000270pa'o// dang po ni/ chos gang zhig bstan bcos 'di'i brjod bya yin zhe na/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston par gyur 1$0000220sgra sbyor bam gnyis dngos 1$0000270pas ston pa ste de rnams la rnam dag legs pa'i mtshan brjod lam ston pa sangs rgyas kyis rgyas 'bring bsdus a sogs gzhung sher a phyin chos bshes gong du 'di las bshad pa'i don 1$0000220seng chos gnyis ka 1$0000270 gang yin pa rnam mkhyen nyid de des skabs dang po'i don gyi a bha gtso bo rnam mkhyen nyid brgyad pa'i don 'bras 1$0000220a bha 1$0000270bu chos sku ste de gnyis bgrod par bya 1$0000220shān+ti a bha dngos 1$0000270bas 1$0000220a 1$0000270lam yin la 'dir bgrod par byed pas 1$0000220a 1$0000270 lam ni sangs rgyas 1$0000220a 1$0000270kyi rgyu'i lam 1$0000220a 1$0000270ste rnam 1$0000220a 1$0000270mkhyen du ci rigs 1$0000220a 1$0000270par 'dus 1$0000220a 1$0000270pa mngon rtogs 1$0000220a 1$0000270gzhan 1$0000220a 1$0000270drug ste phal 1$0000220a 1$0000270ba'o// de ltar 1$0000220a 1$0000270rgyu dang 'bras 1$0000220a 1$0000270bu'i bdag nyid 1$0000220a 1$0000270kyi mngon rtogs 1$0000220a 1$0000270brgyad kyi 1$0000220a 1$0000270ngo bo'i a lam 1$0000220a 1$0000270de bstan bcos 'di'i brjod 1$0000220a 1$0000270bya'o// a bha ya ste/

chos bshes ltar na brjod bya de'i 'grel bar che ba ni byang sems shān+ti las gzhan gyis myong ba ste khong du chud pa ma yin pa zhig go zhes rkang pa dang po gsum gyis brjod bya bstan to zhes te 'grel bar yang de skad sbyar ro// a bha ya ni dgos pa la phyir

(106) sbyor bar gsal lo// gnyis pa ni/ chos bshes kyis/ chos spyod nas blo dang ldan pas rtogs 'gyur/ zhes pa'i bar rkang pa gsum gyis nying dgos bstan/ bde blag tu ni rtogs 'gyur ba nas yin gyis/ dgos pa bstan zhes so// de yang mthong ba ste/ mngon sum du byed par 1$0000220seng a bha sogs 1$0000270 'gyur zhes drang ngo*// gang zhe na/ byang sems las gzhan gyis myong ba ma yin pa sangs rgyas nyid do// thabs gang las na/ sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i chos spyod phar phyin bcu'i bdag nyid kyi yum mdo'i don to// bdag nyid yang yin la mdo don yang yin pas zhes sbyar ro// a bha ya ni chos ni/ sems bskyed dang gdams ngag la sogs pa rnam pa bcu'i khongs su gtogs pa'i mngon rtogs bdun du phye ba de'i spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis bde blag tu zhes sogs mdo rtsom pa'i dgos pa'o zhes so// chos bshes kyi 'grel bar kha cig yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa sogs bcu ste byams pa nyid kyis gsungs zhes pa mi 'thad de/ sbyor lam gyi sgrub pa'i spyod pa tsam gtso bor gyur pa'i phyir thams cad du mchog min pa dang slob dpon gyis 'grel bar 1$0000220dngos 1$0000270zung tsam yang ma bstan pas so// kha cig dge ba bcu la 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ slob dpon gyis 'dir zur 1$0000220dngos 1$0000270tsam yang ma bstan pas so zhes te sgrub byed ltar snang 'ba' zhig tu zad do// sher 'byung gis kyang yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*/ nas bsgom pa'o// zhes bya ba chos spyod bcu yin par 'chad pa ni mi 'thad de/ de ni mngon par rtogs pa'i yan lag yin gyi sbyin sogs ni mngon par rtogs pa nyid kyis mngon du byed (107) srid pas so// zhes so// de yang sgrub byed ltar snang ste phyogs snga ma yongs snang ngo*// des na tshan pa de gnyis dang phar phyin bcu dang sems bskyed gdams ngag sogs bcu chos spyod bcur don la khyad med cing tha snyad grags ma grags la byas na yi ge 'bri sogs bcu grags che zhing don la shān+ti ltar yin no// de 'dra'i mdo don/

thos byung gi shes rab kyis rtogs pa bzhin du bsam byung gi dran pa la bzhag ste sgom byung shes rab kyis sgrub pa la brten nas so// gang gis na/ blo dang ldan pa byang sems kyis te// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che// blo ldan nyid dang gsal ba'i mchog /rgyal sras rgyal ba'i gzhi dang ni// rgyal byed rgyal ba'i myu gu dang*// rtsal ldan dang ni 'phags mchog dang*// ded dpon dang ni grags mchog dang*// snying rje can dang bsod nams che// dbang phyug de bzhin chos dang ldan// zhes so// de yang 'di la yod pa dang med pa las 'das pa'i blo yod pas na blo dang ldan pa'o zhes dge ba lhas so// dbus mtha'i 'grel bshad du/ rang bzhin gyis nyan thos la sogs pa'i rigs can rnams las dbang po rno ba dang shes par bya ba thams cad kyi rnam pa thams cad la nye bar rtog pa'i skabs yin pa dang chos zab cing rgya che ba la mos pas byang chub sems dpa' nyid blo ldan yin gyi gzhan ni min no// zhes so// bdag med gnyis ka rtogs pa'i blo ldan zhes bu ston rin po che so// gser gling pa ni mdo don ni mngon rtogs brgyad do// des nye bar mtshon pa'i don ni byang chub sems dang*/ sbyin sogs bcu'i chos spyod ces so// gsum pa ni/ sngar (108) bshad pa'i brjod bya mngon rtogs brgyad po de bstan bcos 'di las bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes bya ba de bstan bcos 'di rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin no// tshig mdor bsdus pas kyang don rgya chen po tshegs chung ngus rtogs pa ni bde blag tu rtogs pa'o// zhes chos mchog sogs 'chad do// gnyis pa ni/ phyir rtsom zhes sbyar ba'i shugs kyis bstan bcos 'di las yum don bde blag tu rtogs shing de las mthar rnam mkhyen thob pa'i dgos pa gnyis bstan bcos 'di'i 'bras bu dang bstan bcos 'di de'i rgyur 'brel ba ni bstan bcos 'di'i 'brel ba'o zhes par slob dpon dgongs so// ji skad du/

bstan bcos dang ni dgos pa'i don// 'brel ba'i gzhi ni gnyis la gnas// de bstan 'dus pa de yi phyir// dgos las logs shig ma bstan to// zhes bshad do// yang na bstan bcos 'di rjod byed/ yum gsum brgyad dang bcas pa 'di'i brjod byar 'grel pa ni 'di'i 'brel ba'o// rang kīr ni rkang pa dang po gsum la blo dang ldan pas mthong 'gyur gyis dgos pa ste/ snod ldan gyi slob ma'i rgyud la mngon rtogs brgyad rim bzhin nges par bskyed pa dgos pa/ chos spyod/ ces sogs gnyis dang*/ bde blag rtogs 'gyur dgos pa yin// zhes sbyar bas dgos pa'i dgos pa ste 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur nyams su len pa'i mtshan nyid de'o// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni sangs rgyas nyid de chos longs sprul pa'i sku gsum gyi bdag nyid kyi de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad pa chos sku'i mngon rtogs so// lam ni de dang bcas pa ste mngon rtogs bdun no// de bas na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam ni ba (109) lang shing rta bzhin te mngon rtogs brgyad kyi bdag nyid do zhes sogs te/ de las shes dgos so// slob dpon 'dis rnam mkhyen ni chos sku la 'chad do// shān+ti ni/ rnam mkhyen pa nyid ni sangs rgyas nyid de de yang skyes bu dam pa'o// zhes so// ji skad du/ sgrib pa kun gyi dri med pa// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid thob// rin chen snod ni phye ba ltar// sangs rgyas nyid ni yang dag bstan// zhes pa 1$0000220mdo rgyan 1$0000270ltar ro// de ji ltar lam du 'gyur/ btsal bar bya bas lam yin gyi tshol bar byed pas lam ni min no// ston pas mdo 'di las bshad pa gang byang sems las gzhan gyis myong ba min pa ste ma rtogs pa'i don blo ldan byang sems mthong ba ni mngon du byed pa ste thob pa mngon sum du byed pa ste bstan bcos 'di las gsal bar shes zhes dgongs so// 'dis ni rtsom pa'i gtso bo'i dgos pa bstan te zhes bstan bcos 'di la brten nas rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob pa gsal por shes pas 'di las de thob pa gtso bo'i dgos pa'o zhes pa'o// mdo 'di'i don bstan bcos 'di las gzung ste/

dran pa la bzhag nas/ chos ni 'dir mdo nyid do// spyod pa ni rnam bcu ste/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*// nyan dang klog dang len pa dang*// 'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang*// de sems pa dang bsgom pa dang*// spyod pa de bcu'i bdag nyid ni// bsod nams phung po dpag tu med// ces bshad pa'o// de bde blag tu ni rtogs 'gyur ba zhes bya ba ni rjes su sgrubs shig pa'o// de rtsom pa'i dgos pa gtso bo ma yin pa'o (110) zhes te/ bstan bcos la brten nas mdo don rtogs shing dran pa la bzhag nas chos spyod bcus bde bar sgrub pa'am sgrub pa dgos pa phal ba yin zer ba'o// gsum pa la/ brjod bya/ 'brel ba/ nying dgos/ dgos chos bshes dngos pa'o// dang po ni/ bstan zhes dang ngo*// gang na/ skabs dang po'i brjod bya rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs su chud pas mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i lam dang de snga ma sangs rgyas phyi mar bgrod pa'i lam yin no// ste ni lhag ma can no// de bstan bcos kyi brjod byar dngos su bstan pa ni mngon par rtogs pa gzhan bdun po thams cad bstan bcos kyi brjod byar nye bar mtshon pa'am ston pa lhur len pa ste gtsor byed pa'am byas pa yin no// dper na rgyal po gshegs so byas na dpung tshogs bzhi 'gro bar 'phangs pa lta bu'o snyam du dgongs so// kha bu cig gis gzhan du bshad do// des na mngon rtogs brgyad po de'o// gang gis na/ bdud bzhi bcom pa dang ldan cing 'jig rten las 'das pa ste bcom pa'i tshul ni/ lan mi lon par bstod pa las// khyod kyis dang por lha yi bu'i// bdud kyi me tog rgyal mtshan bsnyal// de nas nyon mongs bdud kyi ni// nga rgyal rgyal mtshan mthon po gtib// khyod kyis byang chub ma thob bar// 'dod khams dbang phyug las rgyal te// byang chub bar chad med lam la// srid gsum khams gsum zhes chos bshes dbang phyug las rgyal lo// zhes pa ltar/

srod la lha'i bu'i bdud bcom/ tho rangs rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom par mthun/ sangs rgyas nas (111) rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs pa na bdud kyis 'da' bar gsol bas 'khor rnam bzhi'i don ma byas bar du mi 'da' zhes gsungs dus 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom/ dka' ba spyod pa'i dus su phung po'i bdud bcom zhes kha cig go /tshul khrims bskyangs kyis phran tshegs 'grel bar/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus su 'chi bdag dang phung po'i bdud bcom zer ro// chos bshes kyis sngar drangs pa ltar drangs nas de yang gdul bya'i snang ba dang 'tsham par brjod kyi don la cig khyod byang chub pa dang dus gcig kho nar bdud thams cad nges par bcom lags sam zhes sogs kyi rjes su 'brang ngo zhes te bdud thams cad gcig car bcom zhes pa'i don no/ blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa'i mdo 'grel du// lha'i bu'i bdud ni byang chub kyi shing drung du byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bcom/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyang byang chub mngon par rtogs pa'i tshe bcom/ phung po'i bdud kyang byang chub mngon par rtogs pa'i tshe kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa gnas yongs su gyur pas bcom/ 'chi bdag gi bdud kyang grong khyer yangs pa can du mya ngan las 'da' ba las mi 'da' bar zla ba gsum du tshe'i 'du byed slar bsgyur te tshe la dbang thob pas bcom zhes so// 'di dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad par grags so dpyad do// gnod 'joms su 'dod pa'i zag pa spangs pas lha'i bu'i bdud choms so// srid pa'i zag pa spangs pas 'chi ba'i bdud choms so// ma rig pa'i zag pa spangs pas nyon mongs pa'i bdud choms so// lta ba'i zag pa spangs pas phung po'i bdud choms so zhes so// nam mkhar 'gro ba dang gcig tu 'gyur zhing mang por 'gyur sogs sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul te des dad
