rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'di'i dmigs pa ni dngos po med pa'o// (166) bdag po ni dran pa'o// rnam pa ni zhi ba ste mtshan nyid med pa'o zhes so// snang bar 'dod pa du ma smros shing chos bshes su yang ste de dag blta'o// gal te sangs rgyas la rjes thob yod na thugs mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi mnga' zhes dang*/ jo bo rjes yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la ni rjes las thob pa mi mnga' ste zhes bshad pa dang 'gal zhe na/ mnyam bzhag gis ma zin pa'i rjes thob med pa la dgongs la rjes thob yod par bshad de/ rgyud blar/ shes rab ye shes rnam grol rnams// gsal dang 'phro dang dag phyir dang*// tha dad med pa ste 'bral mi rung ba'i phyir 'od dang zer// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang mtshungs// zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel bar/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la mnga' ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes rab ni shes bya'i de kho na nyid la sgrib pa'i mun pa sel bar nye bar gnas pa'i phyir 'od gsal ba dang chos mtshungs so// de'i rjes la thob pa shes bya thams cad kyi ye shes ni shes bya'i dngos po ma lus pa'i rnam pa thams cad la 'jug pas 'od zer gyi drwa ba 'phro ba dang chos mtshungs so zhes so// byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'di ni// rjes thob de bzhin gshegs rnams dang*// sems can yang dag sgrol ba la// 'jig rten na ni mnyam pa nyid// ces so// 'grel chen du yang sems bskyed nyer gnyis par/ dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes rjes las thob pa'i sangs rgyas sas bsdus pa yin no zhes so// 'dir dbu ma rang stong pa rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi 'dus byas kyi ye shes lta ci smros/ sangs rgyas sa'i chos (167) dbyings ye shes kyang don dam par med cing chos nyid dang de bzhin nyid sogs kyang don dam par med par 'dod cing phug gtugs na don dam par yod med gang yang min zhes bzhed pa mang ste snga phyi 'gal ba sogs du ma yod mod kyi re shig bzhag ste gzhan du ston no// gnyis pa/

lam shes la yang snga rabs phal cher nyan rang byang sems sangs rgyas bzhi ka la yang mtshan nyid pa yod zer zhing*/ kha cig theg chen 'phags pa kun la yod zer ro// de mi 'thad cing*/ mtshan nyid pa byang sems kho na'i rgyud la yod de/ mdor/ lam shes pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yin no zhes dang*/ lam shes nyid kyis 'jig rten don sgrub ces dang*/ 'phags seng gnyis kyis lam shes pa nyid ni de kho na nyid mngon sum du mi byed pa'i rten can zhes pas sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la yod pa la gnod cing*/ yul nges pa dang zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel par de yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kho na'i yin gyi nyan thos la sogs pa'i ni ma yin no zhes yul so sor nges zhes ār+yas bshad pas sangs rgyas dang nyan rang la yod pa gnyis ka la gnod cing khyad par du nyan rang gi rgyud la yod pa rmig med par byas so// rgya cher shes dgos so// de ltar na mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya'i sgra bshad/ mtshan gzhi'o// dang po ni/ lam gsum bden pa'i rang bzhin med pa'am lam gsum gyi ngo bo dmigs rnam sogs phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i theg chen slob lam zhes pa'o// (168) theg chen tshogs sbyor gyi skabs kyi de 'dra'i rtogs pa yang lam shes yin no// 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi dbang du mdzad nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan nye bar dgod ces ār+yas bshad pa dang 'gal zhe na/ de yi don ni nyer zhi dngos su thob pa sogs kyi dbang du mdzad pas 'gal ba med do// des na mkhyen gsum gyis nyan rang gnyis byang sems sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs kun bsdus zhes pa'ang yin pa'i tshul gyis bsdus pa yin gyi de min der bsdus pa min no// 'on kyang mtshan nyid la mngon sum gyis rtogs zhes bsnan nas snga rabs ltar mos na'ang de ltar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad mnyam bzhag tu bden pa'i skye med du shes rjes thob tu lam gsum ji bzhin shes nas ston par byed pa grogs snying rje can nyid do// lam thams cad skye ba med par yongs su shes pa nyid kyis zhes dang*/

nyan thos kyi lam gang yin pa dang zhes sogs drang ngo*// gsum pa ni/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i theg chen slob lam mnyam bzhag dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i theg chen slob lam rjes thob dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes gnyis so// mnyam rjes la spyir 'jig rten pa'i mnyam bzhag bsam gtan gzugs med sogs dang*/ 'das pa'i mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i blo gnyis so// rjes thob la bsam gtan las langs pa'i 'dod sems lta bu 'jig rten pa'i rjes thob/ 'das pa'i mnyam bzhag gi stobs kyis de'i dmigs rnam dang mthun par (169) dran nam mthong ba dper na chos kun bden pa'i rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur dran nam mthong ba lta bu mnyam bzhag gis zin pa'i rjes thob/ mnyam bzhag gi dmigs rnam sogs brjed pa'i dus kyi yid shes rgya yan pa lta bu rjes thob rgya yan pa/ dag sa'i'am sangs rgyas sa'i ji snyed pa mkhyen pa mnyam bzhag dang ngo bo gcig pa'i rjes thob/ tha mal gyi dbang shes lnga kun gzhi nyon yid sogs mnyam rjes gang yang min pa'o// de dag ni phal cher blo'i ngo bos phye ba'i mnyam rjes kyi dbang du byas pa'o// dus kyis phye ba'i mnyam rjes kyi dbang du byas nas 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug kyang rjes thob tu bshad de/ kun btus 'grel par/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ni 'jig rten las 'das pa ste/ 'phags pa'i lam gyi rjes la thob pa'i phyir ro zhes so// yul gyis phye ba'i mnyam rjes yul chos nyid dang chos can la dmigs pa ste 'di'i ltar 1$0000220rgyal po'i sras kyis 1$0000270na tha mal gyi dbang shes yang rjes thob yin no// 'di la sangs rgyas sa'i mnyam rjes lta bu ngo bo gcig pa'ang yod do// 'das pa'i mnyam bzhag gis zin pa'i rjes thob dag pa 'jig rten pa'am slob lam gyi ye shes ni lam shes dngos yin no// de lta bu'i theg chen gyi slob pa'i mnyam rjes de gnyis kyis rim pa bzhin du sangs rgyas sa'i spangs rtogs gnyis sgrub ste/

rgyud blar/ chu mtsho sogs bzhin 'dod chags sogs// glo bur nyon mongs dag pa ni// mdor na mi rtog ye shes kyi// 'bras bu yin par rab tu brjod// rnam pa kun gyi (170) mchog ldan pa'i// sangs rgyas sku ni nges thob pa// de ni rjes la thob pa yi// ye shes 'bras bu yin par bstan// zhes so// des na sa brgyad pa yan chad gsum na rjes thob yod de/ sgom lam gzhan don mos pa gsum yod pa'i phyir dang chos can sgyu ma lta bur snang ba'i blo yod pa dang ji snyed pa rtogs pa yod pa'i phyir dang*/ yul gyis phye ba'i rjes thob las kun gzhi'i rnam shes yod pa'i phyir zhes sogs shes par bya'o// gsum pa/ gzhi shes la zhar la/ nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod med dpyad/ skabs don gzhi shes gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po ni/ 'jug pa'i rang 'grel du/ dpe sngon du btang nas/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin du byang sems yang sems bskyed ma thag tu lhag pa'i bsam pa'i che ba nyid kyis nyan thos dang sangs rgyas thams cad zil gyis gnon gyi rang gi blo'i stobs kyis rnam par dpyod pas ni ma yin no// byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni rang gi yul shes pa'i che ba la gnas pas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi bya ba thams cad las shin tu 'das pa yin no zhes ji skad gsungs pa lta bu'o zhes dang*/ ring du song ba kho na nas gzung nas gnon gyi sa 'og ma rnams su ni ma yin no zhes shes par bya'o// lung 'di las ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams la yang chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa yod do zhes bya bar gsal bar nges te/ de lta min na dngos po rang bzhin med par shes pa dang bral ba'i phyir 'jig rten pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba ltar

(171) sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpas kyang rang gi blo'i rnam par dpyod pas kyang zil gyis gnon par 'gyur la/ phyi rol pa bzhin du 'di dag gis khams gsum na spyod pa'i phra rgyas thams cad spangs par yang mi 'gyur ro// gzugs la sogs pa rang gi dngos por dmigs pas phyin ci log tu 'gyur ba'i phyir gang zag gi bdag med rtogs par yang mi 'gyur te/ bdag tu gdags pa'i rgyu phung po la dmigs pa'i phyir ro// ji skad 1$0000220rin chen phreng 1$0000270du/ ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa// de srid de la ngar 'dzin yod// ngar 'dzin yod na yang las te// de las yang ni skye ba yin// 1$0000220rgyun chags pas 1$0000270 lam gsum ni ngar 'dzin las skye ba gsum mo zhes de'i 'grel par mi pham bshes gnyen gyis so// thog mtha' dbus med de// 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor mgal me yi// dkyil 'khor lta bu phan tshun gyi// rgyu can 'di ni 'khor bar 'gyur// zhes sogs mang po drangs so// mthar/ de ltar yang dag ji bzhin du// 'gro ba don med shes nas ni// rgyu med pa yi me bzhin du// gnas med len med mya ngan 'das// zhes gsungs so// ci ste byang sems kho nas de ltar rang bzhin med par mthong ba yin no zhe na/ de yang yod pa ma yin te nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang du byas nas de skad gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'di ji ltar shes she na/ brjod par bya ste/ mjug thogs kho nar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang du mdzad nas/ de ltar byang chub sems dpas kyang*// mthong nas byang chub nges par 'dod// 'on kyang de ni snying (172) rje yis// byang chub bar du nying mtshams sbyor// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro zhes so// gal te nyan thos kyi theg pa las kyang chos la bdag med pa bstan na de'i tshe theg pa chen po don med par 'gyur ro snyam du sems pa de'i lugs la yang 'di ltar rigs pa dang lung dang 'gal ba rtogs so// theg pa chen po bstan pas ni chos la bdag med pa tsam 'ba' zhig ston par byed pa min gyi 'o na ci zhe na/

byang sems rnams kyis dang pha rol tu phyin pa dang smon lam dang snying rje la sogs pa dang yongs su bsngo ba dang tshogs gnyis dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos nyid kyang yin no// rin chen phreng ba las/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni// byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang*// spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad des// byang chub sems dpar ga la 'gyur// zhes so// chos kyi bdag med pa gsal bar bya ba'i phyir theg pa chen po bstan pa yang rigs pa nyid de rgyas par bstan pa brjod par 'dod pa'i phyir ro// nyan thos kyi theg pa las ni chos kyi bdag med pa mdor mtshon pa tsam zhig tu zad do// ji skad du/ 1$0000220'jig rten las 'das par bstod par 1$0000270mtshan ma med pa ma 1$0000220ma zhugs par snang 1$0000270rtogs par// khyod kyis thar pa med par gsungs// de phyir khyod kyis theg chen las// de ni tshang bar bstan pa lags// zhes gsungs so// zhes so// spyod 'jug tu/ bstan rtsa dge slong nyid yin na// dge slong nyid kyang dka' bar gnas// sems ni dmigs dang bcas rnams la// mya ngan 'das pa'ang dka' bar gnas// zhes so// dge slong gi don nyon mongs bcom pas dgra bcom pa yin na/ stong (173) nyid ma rtogs pa'i nyon mongs bcom pa dka' zhes sher 'byung ngo*// dge lhas gzhan du bshad shān+tis/ chos su lta ba ma spangs na gang zag tu lta ba log par mi 'gyur te/ 'phags pa nyid kyis/ ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa// de srid bdag tu lta bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// zhes mdo kun btus 'grel par bshad la/ thub dgongs su yang bshad do// do// 'on kyang sdud par/ thabs med shes rab bral bas nyan thos nyid du ltung*// zhes dang*/ mi rtag yongs su ston pa bcos la spyod pa ste// zhes sogs 'dir yang*/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas// zhes sogs dang*/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang*// zhes nas/

spyod pa'i 'du shes mi mthun phyogs// zhes sogs bka' tha ma phal che dang bka' bar pa'i mdo bstan bcos du ma las nyan thos la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa med par bshad cing rang rgyal la'ang*/ 'dzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni// zhes 'dzin pa rang bzhin med par rtogs pa med par bshad do// gang drang don nges don yin zhe na/ 'phags pas byas pa'i bstan bcos su 'di drang don 'di nges don yin zhes phye ba snang na de'i rjes su 'brang gi gzhan du dbye dka' 'o gsungs bu so// 'on kyang yum gyi mdo bstan bcos rgyan rjes 'brang dang bcas par nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa med par ches gsal bar bshad pas sa bcu pa dang 'phags pa klu'i gsungs de dag dgongs pa can du bya dgos sam snyam ste sa bcu pa'i lung de sa bdun pa'i rtogs pa dang yon tan ston pa'i skabs yin pas de'i che ba (174) brjod pa dang sa bdun pa thob nas re re tsam gnas skabs nyan rang du ltung ba srid kyi phal cher mi ltung zhing drug pa man du nyan rang du gnas skabs ltung ba mang po yod pas de dag gis nyan rang zil gyis gnon mi nus zhes sam rang rgyal la gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa yod pas de tsam la dgongs pa'am drug pa man du rjes thob rgya yan cung zad yod cing mtshan ma spyod pa yin la bdun pa mtshan med spyod pa yin pa sa bdun pa nas mnyam rjes gnyis kas zil gyis gnon cing drug pa man mtshan 'dzin mang bas zil gyis gnon mi nus par gsungs so zhes sogs dpyad cing bya'o// 'phags pa'i lung gi dgongs pa yang bdag med rtogs pa med par phung po don dam du gzung na zhes bshad du rung ngam snyam mo// yang na nyan rang dgra bcom gyis rim pa bzhin du phung po gang zag dang gzung bas stong par rtogs shing skad cig tsam bdag med par shes pa'ang mu stegs sogs las khyad 'phags pas na de tsam la dgongs nas nyan rang 'phags pa'i che ba dbyung ba'i ched du sa drug pa man chad kyis rtogs pas zil gyis gnon mi nus zhes gsungs pa yin la/

rin chen phreng bar gsungs pa yang kha cig skad cig tsam bdag med du shes pa dang kha cig chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa la sbyar te/ thub dgongs su/ sa bcu par gsungs pa ni gzhan du yang 'thad de/ skad cig tsam bdag med par shes pa yang 'jig rten gyi 'dod chags dang bral ba dang phyi rol pa rnams las khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir dang*/ 1$0000220nyon mongs kyi 1$0000270 bag la nyal spangs pa ni bdag gi 1$0000220ste rang rgyud kyi 1$0000270 (175) bdag med pa rtogs pa las kyang 'gyur ro// rin chen phreng bar gsungs pa rnams kyang*/ kha cig skad cig ma'i bdag med dang kha cig chos kyi bdag med du sbyor te/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi rigs rnams kyi thun mong du gsungs pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ro zhes so// gnyis pa la/ snga rabs rnams byang sems dang sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la'ang gzhi shes mtshan nyid pa yod par smra ba ni mi 'thad cing gzhi shes mtshan nyid pa nyan rang kho na'i rgyud la yod de/ mdor/ thams cad shes pa nyid ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin no zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung zhing nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir khrid ces dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyis da ni 'di man chad byang chub gzhan shes nas spang bar bya dgos pas thams cad shes pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid ces pa dang*/ chos bshes kyis spang bya gzhi thams cad shes pa med par gnyen po lam shes pa med ces sogs dang*/ mdor/ thams cad shes pa nyid la shes pa dang mthong bas bltas nas 'da' bar 'dod pas yum la bslab par bya'o// zhes sogs du ma yod do// des na mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya/ mtshan gzhi las/ dang po ni/ gzhi gang zag gi bdag med phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyi blo'am gzhi phung skye khams kyi ngo bo mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs ji bzhin du rtogs pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyi blo gang rung zhes pa la rung mod kyi da lta grags pa ltar na mngon sum gyis rtogs zhes bsnan no// rab 'byor thams cad

(176) ces bya ba ni zhes sogs sngar drangs pa ltar dang gzhi thams cad skye ba med par rtogs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ gzhi thams cad mnyam bzhag tu bdag gcig gam phyed gnyis kyis stong par shes rjes thob tu gzhi phung sogs kyi dngos po'i ngo bo mtshan nyid dbye ba sogs phyin ci ma log par shes pa nyid do// sngar drangs pa ltar mdo drang ngo*// gsum pa la/ slob dpon gyis sdud 'grel du sa dngos dang po sogs sa bdun dngos po la lam shes dang*/ sa bdun pa nyid la gzhi shes bzhag brgyad pa la rnam kun sogs sa mtshams so sor mdzad do// 'dir lam shes sa bdun zhes bsgyur te bdun pa la thug pa drug pa'i bar la dgongs te lam shes gzhi shes sbyor bzhi rnams sa mtshams so sor mdzad par snang ngo*// de yang gzhi shes btags pa ba gnyen po gzhi shes la zer na'ang sa dang po sogs drug brgyad pa sogs na gnyen po gzhi shes med par 'gyur zhing*/ 'dod na/ mtshan 'dzin gyi spong gnyen sa bdun pa kho nar 'gyur ba'i skyon yod do// mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes la zer na sa bdun pa'i mngon rtogs de gnyen po gzhi shes kyi spang byar 'gyur ba dang byang sems mthong lam nas mtshan 'dzin gzhi shes la shes pa dang mthong bas bltas nas 'da' ba min par 'gyur ro// 'dod na/ thams cad shes pa nyid la shes pa dang zhes sogs sngar drangs pa ltar dang*/ ār+yas mthong bas 'da' ba ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dag las ste zhes sogs dang 'gal lo// sa brgyad pa sogs na lam shes med na// skad cig ma'i (177) mdor/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la spyod cing chos thams cad kyi yongs su rdzogs pa thob nas rnam mkhyen nyid rjes su thob par byed do zhes dang*/ rgyud bla'i 'grel par/ byang sems kyis mi g.yo ba la rnam par mi rtog pa skyon med pa rgyun mi chad pa rang gis ngang gis 'jug pa'i lam shes pa nyid la brten nas zhes pa dang 'gal zhing*/

dag sa'i rtogs pa rnams gzhi shes sam rnam mkhyen du 'gyur zhing*/ 'dod na/ khas blangs dang lung dang 'gal lo// a bha yas/ sems bskyed dang po lnga gzhi shes mtshan nyid par thub dgongs su bzhag pa'ang gnyen po gzhi shes la byed na ni sems bskyed nyi shu bzhag dgos la/ mtshan 'dzin la byed na dang po lnga theg chen sems bskyed min par 'gyur ba dang lnga pa sa dang po na med par 'gyur la 'dod na khas blangs dang lung dang 'gal ba dang*/ dkon mchog sprin las/ mos pa spyod pa'i sar byang sems nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa thams cad las 'da' bar 'gyur ro zhes pa dang 'gal lo// des na nyan rang gi lam lnga'am/ nyan rang 'phags pa kho na la yod cing gnyen po gzhi shes zhes pa ni spang bya'i ming gis btags pa ste 'dod khams kyi lam bden bzhin no// des na mkhyen gsum/ ngo bo tha dad du rang kir dang lo chen gyis bshad cing bu ston rin po che bzhed de mdo bstan bcos kyi dgongs par nges so// bzhi pa rnam kun la/ slob dpon gyis sdud 'grel du sa brgyad pa'i skabs kho na la bzhag pa ni mi 'thad de/ tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i sbyor ba la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chos can/ sher (178) phyin zab gting dpag dka' tshad med pa la skrag srid pa min pa dang las dang po pa min par thal/ sa brgyad pa ba yin pas so// 'dod na/ dang po khas blangs 'gal te sher phyin la skrag pa dang zhes so// gnyis pa la 'phags pas las dang po par bshad do// rnam kun gyi sdug bsngal rjes bzod kyi skad cig la gnas pa'i byang sems nyan rang du ltung mi srid par thal/ sa brgyad pa thob pas so// 'dod na/ ār+yas sdug bsngal la rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa'i skad cig la ni rjes su shes pa dang 'brel pas nyan thos la sogs pa'i sar ltung ba srid de/ khams gsum pa'i gnyen por byung ba nyid kyi phyir ro zhes pa dang 'gal lo// bo dong pa na re/

rgyun mtha' na med zer ro// kha che gzhon nu dpal gyis zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba ni bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyor ba'o zhes so// des na theg chen tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod de/ rnam kun gyi thar cha thog mar bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rgyur dang*/ tshegs chen yun ring rtogs sbyor las dang po pa nas ār+yas bshad pas dang*/ srid zhi mnyam sbyor mi slob pa'i dge 'dun la 'phags seng gnyis kyis bshad cing byang sems nang nas mi slob pa ste rgyun mtha'i rdor ting pa der thub dgongs su bshad de la lar ni rdo rje lta bu'i sems ni mi slob pa rnam par grol ba sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar chad med pa'i lam yin pa nyid kyi phyir na mi slob par gsungs so// zhes so// des na mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya/ gzhi gsum las/ (179) dang po ni/ mkhyen pa gsum la dbang gyur thob pa'i phyir du mkhyen gsum bsdus nas bsgom pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sbyor ba ste thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum yongs su shes pa ni zhes sogs dang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum po 'di nyid gcig tu byas pa'i bdag nyid ni rnam kun mngon rtogs zhes so// rang kir gyis gsum po 'di rnams nyid 'dus pa ni mngon rtogs bzhi pa'o zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ rnam dngos pa ni bye brag ste sangs rgyas kyi sa la sogs pa la chos kyi bye brag ji snyed yod pa kun ston pa'o// kun ni mkhyen pa gsum car gyi'o// mngon par ni mngon du phyogs te'am sam ni rdzogs par ram yang na yang dag par ro// rtogs pa ni bsgoms pas khong du chud pa'o zhes chos bshes so// mdor na mkhyen pa gsum car gyi bye brag gam rnam pa la mngon du phyogs pas yongs su rdzogs pa'am yang dag par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhig go zhes pa'o// gsum pa ni/ theg chen slob lam bzhi'am sbyor ba nyi shu'o// 'dir rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ni rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa btags pa ba/

'bras bu rnam mkhyen ni de mtshan nyid par a bha ya bzhed de/ thub dgongs su rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa btags pa ba ni sbyor ba ste mtshan nyid pa ni rnam mkhyen nyid chos sku'i nang du 'dus pa srid pa dang zhi ba mnyam pa nyid kyi bdag nyid 'bras bu kho na'o// de skad du dgongs 'grel las/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa phra mo (180) spangs pa las shes bya la ma chags ma thogs pa rnam pa kun nye bar rtogs pa bzung na sa bcu gcig pa sangs rgyas kyi sar brjod do zhes so// zhes pa ni legs par mngon mod bod rgan rnams dang mi mthun no// 'o na sa brgyad pa yan na 'bad pa yod par thal/ dbang du bya ba'i phyir bsgom pa yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rnam sbyor yod pas so// 'dod na/ rgyud blar/ sngon gyi 'phen pa'i dbang dang ni// rnam rtog thams cad bral ba'i phyir// de ni lus can smin pa yi// don du 'bad pa byed ma yin// zhes pa dang 'gal zhe na/ 'dod de/ sa bcu pa'i mdor/ sa brgyad par/ nged kyi ye shes stobs spangs sangs rgyas chos kyi rnams// de dag khyed la med kyi de la brtson 'grus rtsoms// zhes dang rmi lam bstan par/ sa brgyad pa la mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa la/ dgu pa la spyod pa la/ bcu pa la tshad med pa la rtsol ba dang bcas so zhes so// sngar gyi lung ni sa bcu par gzhan don 'bad med du 'byung ba'i don du thogs med kyis so// theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor sogs na rnam sbyor med par thal/ gsum bsdus bsgom med pas so// der thal/ der gsum mtshan nyid pa med pas so zhe na/ gzhi lam rnam gsum bden pa'i rang bzhin med par gtan la phab nas der gcig car rtogs par byas te bsgom pa tsam la gsum bsdus sgom du bzhag pa'o// 'dir bu rin gyis lan ma btab snang ngo*// lnga pa rtse sbyor la/ sdud 'grel du sa dgu pa bcu pas bsdus gsungs te zhib tu 'og tu 'chad do// chos bshes yang de'i rjes su

(181) 'brang ngo*// 'o na skabs dang por bstan pa'i mthong spang gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa bzhi dang*/ rtse sbyor du bstan pa'i mthong spang gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog brgya rtsa brgyad kyi spong gnyen gyi zag med lam yin pa zhig sa dgu pa mnan med par 'gyur te rtse sbyor gyi mthong lam de sa bcu pa'i skabs kho na la bzhag pas so// rtags sdud 'grel du sa bcu pa dang 'brel pa zhes rtse sbyor mthong lam du'o// 'dod na byang se'i mthong lam gyis spang bya gang spong smra dgos so// mthong spang spong gnyen sa bcu par 'dod pa ni bzhad gad kyi gnas su mi 'gyur ram/ 'gal ba mtha' yas te ngag las shes par bya'o// 'jam gsar/ tshogs lam na de yod par 'dod pa'ang nor te/ tshogs lam na rtse sbyor bdun po gang yang med pa'i phyir/ bdun pa sa lhag pa gcig yod ce na/ sangs rgyas byams pa sogs kyi sa bdun pa sa ma bshad do// don gyis thob ce na/ tshogs lam na skad cig ma'ang yod par don gyis thob par mtshungs so// des na mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya/ gzhi gsum las/ dang po ni/ gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sbyor ba ste/ de rab ces dang*/ rtse mo'i mngon rtogs ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi rab kyi gnas skabs so zhes 'dir bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ bsdus bsgom sngar bas rtse mo ste rab tu phyin pa'am son pa'o// gsum pa ni/ bdun yod la sa mtshams drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod de 'og tu 'chad do// drug pa mthar sbyor la/ sdud 'grel du sa bcu (182) pa'i bar chad med lam du thob zer/ chos bshes kyis dga' ldan na gnas pa nas gzung ste/ bdud btul ba'i bar na yod zer ro// mi 'thad de/ mdo las sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar gzung ste zhes pa dang*/ ār+yas sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa rnam pa lnga'o// gzugs la sogs par dang*/ mtshan dpe la sogs par dang*/ tshul khrims kyi phung po la sogs par dang*/

stobs bcu la sogs par dang*/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung bar yid la mi byed par sangs rgyas dran pa ste lnga dang pos ni sems bskyed pa'o// bzhi po rnams kyis ni nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa bzhi'o zhes pa dang 'gal lo// 'di la mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya/ gzhi gsum las dang po ni/ gsum bsdus bsgom go rim du bsgom pa'i sbyor ba'am sbyin sogs dkar chos bcu gsum go rim gyis bsgoms pa'i sbyor ba ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi go rim gyi gnas skabs so zhes dang rnam gsum rnam bcu zhes pas so// slob dpon ltar na rtse sbyor thob nas zhes bsnan te 'di mi legs so// gnyis pa ni/ bsdus bsgom mam bcu gsum po mthar gyis te snga ma'i rjes su phyi ma 'brel bar rim gyis bsgom pa can yin pas mthar gyis pa'o// gsum pa ni/ bya ba/ bslab pa/ bsgrub pa gsum mo// de gsum rim bzhin 'phags pas/ bgyi ba smros pa ni sems bskyed pa gzung ba'i don du'o// bslab pa smros pa ni nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa shes pa'i don du'o// bsgrub pa smros pa ni mthong ba dang sgom pa'i lam shes pa'i don du'o zhes so// (183) sa mtshams ma mtha' tshogs lam nas dngos su byung zhing ya mtha' rgyun mtha'i bar na yod par ār+ya bzhed par mngon te dran pa nyer bzhag sogs byang phyogs rdzogs pas mthong ba'i lam dang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar gyis ni sgom pa'i lam yin te zhes yid la bya rgyu stong nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar mdor smros pa'i bshad pa'i tshig go /so// slob dpon ltar na drod nas yod de/ rtse sbyor thob pas zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ sbyor ba'i gnas skabs nas bzung nas rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la thug gi bar du mi dmigs pa dang ldan pa'i tshul khrims rang dang gzhan la phan pa'i lus sgrub pa'i phyir ro zhes te/

mthar thug gi bar zhes pa snga logs tshun chad kyi don yin pas rgyun mtha'i snga logs tshun chad ces 1$0000220bu sogs 1$0000270so// bod snga rabs rnams rgyun mthar brtan pa thob pas gcig car sgom gyi rim bsgom med gsungs so// bdun pa skad cig ma thub dgongs du/ kha cig ni rim gyis skye bar nges la skad cig bzhi'i ngo bo ni skad cig gcig gi mngon par rtogs pa'o zer ro// gzhan rnams ni de bsam par bya'o// zhes so zhes bshad do// la/ lo ts+tsha ba ni/ bzhi po rim bzhin/ sa bdun/ brgyad/ dgu/ bcu la thob bo zhes zer ro// 'dir bu kha cig shān+tis thub dgongs su yod gnas skabs de ni sa brgyad pa la sogs pa'o zhes bshad pas sa brgyad pa nas yod par bzhed gsungs pa ni nor te rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma'i rtogs bya rnam smin la bshad pa yin gyi rtogs (184) byed skad cig ma la min no// mi 'thad de/ skad cig ma'i spyir bstan gyi mdor/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin nyer bar sgrub bo// glog lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin nye bar sgrub bo zhes dang*/ skad cig ma gnyis pa'i mdor/ de pa'i ting nge 'dzin ma gtogs bar ting nge 'dzin thams cad thob par byed do zhes dang*/ skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis rnam mkhyen nyid thob par byed do zhes sogs dang*/ de mtha' zhes dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi mthar thug pa'i gnas skabs so zhes sogs dang 'gal lo// des na mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya/ gzhi gsum las dang po ni/ gsum bsdus bsgom mthar thug pa'i sbyor ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ sems kyi skad cig ma gcig kho nas byang chub la mngon du phyogs pas chos thams cad rdzogs par byang chub pa'am/ mngon sum du'am yang dag pa ste byang chub pa ni rtogs pa'o// mdor na sems kyi skad cig ma gcig kho nas chos thams cad mngon sum du yang dag par rtogs pa'i sbyor ba zhes par rung ngo*// gsum pa ni/

ngo bo gcig nyid yul dang de rtogs tshul gyi sgo nas ldog pa'i dbye bas bzhi yod cing sa mtshams rgyun mtha' kho nar yod par sdud 'grel la sogs su'o// ldog pa'i dbye bas rnam pa bzhir ci zhig ltar bsten zhes dang skad cig ma ni sems kyi skad cig ma gcig kho nas rnam pa bzhir mngon sum du byed ces 'grel chen las so// 'o na skad cig ma gang rdul phra ba'i mthar thug pa gcig go sa gcig nas gzhan gcig tu lan gcig 'phos pa'i yun dus mtha'i (185) 'am skyes bu stobs ldan gyis lan gcig se gol gtogs pa'i yun la skad cig drug cu rtsa lnga 'da' ba'i 'am/ chos bshes sum brgya drug cu rtsa brgyad zer ro// skyes bu'i 'dod don sgrub pa'i bya ba brtsams nas de grub kyi bar lta bu bya rdzogs kyi skad cig la byed/ dang po gnyis ltar na ha cang yun thung bas ci ltar de rdzogs par nus/ gsum pa ltar na ting nge 'dzin de'i dus nges pa med de/ snying po byang chub der yun ji snyed cig bzhugs par 'gyur zhe na/ dang po gnyis ltar na'ang nyes pa chen po med de/ dus mtha' gcig tu bden pa med cing rang gi bsam pa'i dbang la rag las zhes bstan zin pas 'di lta bu'i rtog pa skye mthong ngo*// zhes so// 'on kyang de ltar bstan zin kyang dbang thob pas skad cig bskal par byin gyis rlob nus pas sngar chos bshes bshad bu so// 'dir phyogs gsum pa gzung ste byang chub snying por bzhugs nas bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ma bskyed par ldang mi srid ces gsungs pas/ der de nges par bskyed la de yang rang bzhin dbang mtshan par byas na rang gi bzhed pa la rag las pas dang*/ dus la mnga' brnyes pas dus mtha'i skad cig gi yun gyis de brnyes pa la gnod pa med mod/ gdul bya'i dbang gis nges pa med de/ pad dkar las/ de pa mngon par shes pa'i ye shes chen pos bdud bcom nas bar bskal lnga bcur skyil krung mi bshig par bzhugs nas sangs rgyas so// bdag cag gi ston pas byang chub

(186) snying por bzhugs pa'i zhag de nyid kyi tho rangs sangs rgyas byang chub kyi snying po ni gnyis te/ gnas byang chub kyi snying po dang*/ rtogs pa byang chub kyi snying po zhes mdo kun btus 'grel par shān+tis so// so// zhes te bdud btul nas sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi ting nge 'dzin de bar chad med rtse dang de nyid skad cig ma'o// skad cig ma bzhi po gcig car ram rim gyis rtogs/ dang po ltar na/ dang po gnyis pa sogs/ ci ltar rung*/ gnyis pa ltar na bzhi par 'gyur zhe na/ gcig car rtogs la dang po gnyis pa sogs ni grangs kyi rim pa yin gyi don gyi rim pa min no// gnyis pa ltar yin na'ang nyes pa med de byis pa rnams kyi skad cig de dbang thob pas 1$0000220dngos 1$0000270bzhir 'gyur ba'i phyir ro zhes pa rnams chos bshes so// brgyad pa chos sku la/ gzhi'i sangs rgyas 'dus ma byas chos sku min par 'dod pa dgag pa re shig bzhag nas 'phags seng sogs 'grel byed rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas ston pa la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya/ mtshan gzhi/ de dag gi cha la rtsod spong dang bzhi'o// dang po ni/ yum gyi sbyor ba bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug gang zhig zag med kyi chos kyi yan lag can te/ de yi rnam smin ni zhes dang*// chos rnams kun gyi lus yin phyir// zhes bden gnyis las so// gnyis pa ni/ zag med kyi chos mtha' yas pa'i yan lag bsag pa'am tshogs pa yin pas sku/ yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rten byed pas sku/ rigs pa'i rjes su 'brang bas thob bya'am rtogs bya'i ngo bo yin pas sku ste/ bden gnyis las/ chos rnams kun gyi lus yin phyir// yon tan phun tshogs bsam yas phyir// rigs pa'i (187) rjes 'brang ngo bo'i phyir// skyob pa rnams kyi chos skur 'dod// ces so// ngo bo'i phyir zhes pa 'gro ba thams cad de'i ngo bo las ma 'das pas sku zhes pa 'di chos nyid kyi sku'i sgra don te bden gnyis su sku gsum las mi 'dod cing chos sku ngo bo nyid sku gcig tu bzhed pa'i lugs so// 'dir ji bzhin sbyor bar mdzad pa ni cung 1$0000220 bu 1$0000270nor ro// gsum pa la/

mtshan nyid pa dang rjes mthun pa gnyis so// dang po la lnga/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las so// dang po la bzhi ste/ sku gnyis gsum bzhi lngar dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ rgyud blar/ chos sku rnam gnyis shes byas te// chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang*// de yi rgyu mthun zab pa dang*// sna tshogs tshul ni ston pa'o// zhes te/ rtogs pa chos sku dang bstan pa chos sku ste chos dbyings shin tu rnam dag dang gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la rim bzhin ka shis/ chos kyi sku rnam pa gnyis te/ bshad pa'i chos kyi sku dang*/ rtogs pa'i chos kyi sku'o// rtogs pa'i chos kyi sku yang rnam pa gnyis te/ ye shes kyi rgyu can dang*/ bsod nams kyi rgyu can no// zhes rdor gcod 'grel par zer ro// dang po de pa rnams kyi so so rang gis rig bya yin pas de skad bya la de thob par byed pa'i 1$0000220 'grel chen dngos 1$0000270rgyu/ de'i rgyu 1$0000220dngos 1$0000270mthun pa ni bstan pa'i dngos chos te de yang don dam gyi dbang du byas nas zab mo ston pa byang se'i sde snod dang kun rdzob kyi dbang du byas nas gleng gzhi sogs chos sna tshogs ston pa gleng gzhi'i sde sogs so// gzhan bo dong*/ bu ston rin po che du bshad pa ni nor ro// yang na ye shes kyi tshogs las 'khrungs pa chos sku dam pa/ (188) bsod nams kyi tshogs las 'khrungs pa gzugs sku dam pa ste/ rigs pa drug cu pa'i bsngo bar/ dge ba 'di yis/ nas/ dam pa gnyis ni thob par shog /ces so// 'di'i dang po rang don don dam pa'i sku/ gnyis pa gzhan don brda' 'am kun rdzob kyi sku ste/ rgyud blar/ rang don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni// de la brten pa kun rdzob sku nyid de// zhes dang po stobs sogs bral ba'i yon tan so gnyis/ gnyis pa mtshan bzang rnam smin gyi yon tan so gnyis can te/

dang po'i sku ni stobs1$0000220 bcu mi 'jigs pa bzhi ma 'dres pa bco brgyad 1$0000270la sogs/ bral ba'i yon tan rnams dang ldan// gnyis pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan// rnam smin yon tan dag dang ldan// zhes so// spang bya sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma spangs pa'i cha nas rab tu phye bas dang bla ma skyel bsu sogs sngon gyi bsod nams kyi 'bras bu rnam smin yin pas de skad rim bzhin no// des na chos nyid rnam par dag pa mthong na don dam pa'i sangs rgyas mthong bar brjod kyi 'dus byas kyi mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i gzugs mthong ba tsam gyis don dam pa'i sangs rgyas mthong bar mi 'gyur te/ rdo rje gcod par/ gang dag nga la 1$0000220mtshan dpe sogs 1$0000270 gzugs su mthong*// gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa// log par bcom 1$0000220 spong bas zhugs 1$0000270pas skyes pa yi// skye bo des ni nga mi mthong*// 'dren pa rnams kyi chos kyi sku/ 1$0000220/chos rnams kyi rang bzhin gsha' ma gang yin pa de ni 1$0000270 chos nyid zhes bya de nyid de bzhin nyid chos dbyings yang dag mtha' mtshan med don dam zhes sogs dang rnam grangs so de nyid sangs rgyas su blta 1$00002201$0000270bar bya// chos nyid rnam par shes bya'ang min// de ni (189) rnam par shes mi nus// zhes so// brgyad stong par/ dge slong dag nga la gzugs kyi skur ma lta bar nga la chos kyi skur yongs su rdzogs par ltos shig ces pa'i don yang de'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sku gsum gyi ngo bo/ rgyu/ rnam bzhag dpyad pa'o// dang po ni/ 'dus ma byas la sogs pa'i tha mi dad pa/ phyin ci ma log pa/ sgrib pa dang bral ba bzhi dang*/ rang bzhin gyis sgrib pa med pa/ rtog pas dmigs bya ma yin la/ mnyam bzhag so sor rang rig gis rig pa gsum chos dbyings 'od gsal ba zhes gcig tu bsdus pas/

mtshan nyid lnga dang rgya che ba sogs yon tan lnga ldan gyi mthar thug gi sku zhes pa sku gsum du byas pa'i chos sku'i mtshan nyid de/ mtshan nyid lnga dang yon tan lnga ni/ rgyud blar/ thog ma skye ba dbus 1$0000220gnas pa 1$0000270mtha' 1$0000220'jig pa 1$0000270med 1$0000220pas 'dus ma byas pa'o// 1$0000270cing 1$0000220yon tan gyi chos rnams 1$0000270rnam par dbyer med 1$0000220pas tha mi dad pa'o// mtha' 1$0000270gnyis med pas 1$0000220phyin ci ma log pa/ sgrib pa 1$0000270gsum dang bral zhing dri med 1$0000220pa ni rang bzhin gyis sgrib pa med pa1$0000270 rnam 1$0000220rtog gis dmigs byar 1$0000270med pa// chos dbyings rang bzhin 1$0000220rang bzhin 'od gsal 1$0000270gang yin pa de rtogs pa ni// mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis mthong*// zhes mtshan nyid lnga/ gzhal med pa 1$0000220rgya che ba 1$0000270gaṅgā'i bye ma las 'das pa 1$0000220grangs mang ba/1$0000270 bsam med 1$0000220rtog ge'i yul ma yin pa/ 1$0000270mnyam med 1$0000220thun mong ma yin pa ste 1$0000270yon tan rnams dang ldan// 1$0000220de yan gyis bzhi bstan/ 'di man gyis gcig ste sgrib pas dag pa mthar phyin pa yon tan lnga pa'o// 1$0000270de bzhin gshegs pa'i dri med dbyings de ni// bag chags bcas pa'i nyes pa gtan

(190) spangs pa// zhes so// gnyis pa longs sku ni/ gsung brjod pa/ sku snang ba/ mdzad pa sgrub pa rgyun mi chad pa 1$0000220'di gong ma gsum ka la sbyar 1$0000270ste gsum/ de rnams lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs mdzad pa du mar ston yang de dang der bden pa'i rang bzhin dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku zhes pa mtshan nyid do// rgyud blar/ sna tshogs dam chos 'od zer mnga' ba'i sku// 'gro ba'i rnam grol don grub la brtson pa// mdzad pa yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal bzhin te// sna tshogs dngos kyang de yi rang bzhin min// zhes so// gsum pa sprul sku ni/ 'bras bu gsum gyi rgyu'i gzugs sku gang zhig dus nam yang chos sku la gnas pa ste/ rgyud blar/ 'jig rten 1$0000220gdul bya 'khor ba la chags pa dag srid pa la skyo ba bskyed nas 1$0000270zhi ba'i lam 1$0000220myang 'das 1$0000270la 'jug pa dang*/ 1$0000220theg dman la zhugs pa bzlog nas theg chen la 1$0000270rab tu smin 1$0000220cing 'dun par mdzad pa dang gcig1$0000270 dang 1$0000220bar mdzad pa dang gnyis/ byang chub mchog tu 1$0000270lung ston 1$0000220pas rnam grol thob par brjod pa ste gsum gyi 1$0000270rgyu yi gzugs// gang yin de yang 'dir ni rtag gnas te// nam mkha'i khams su gzugs kyi rnam pa bzhin// zhes so// yang na 'og tu 'chad do// gnyis pa ni/ ye shes 1$0000220rin chen phreng 1$0000270kyi tshogs dang rang bzhin 1$0000220rgyan 1$0000270rigs las chos sku/ bsod nams 1$0000220rin chen phreng 1$0000270tshogs dang rgyas pa'i 1$0000220rgyan 1$0000270rigs las gzugs sku gnyis 'byung zhing*/ kun gzhi gnas gyur pas chos sku/ nyon yid gnas gyur pas longs sku/ 'jug shes drug gnas gyur pas sprul sku 'byung bar gser 'od las so// mdor bsdus so// gsum pa

(191) la gsum/ mnyam/ mi mnyam pa/ rtag pa'i khyad par ro// dang po ni/ de dag rten dang dgongs pa dang*// 'phrin las kyis ni mnyam pa nyid// ces te sku gsum dang rim bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ longs spyod rdzogs pa khams kun tu// 'khor yongs 1$0000220su 1$0000270bsdu ba 1$0000220dang 1$0000270zhing dang mtshan 1$0000220dang 1$0000270// sku 1$0000220mdog 1$0000270dang chos 1$0000220te 1$0000270rdzogs longs spyod dang*/ 1$0000220ste chos kyi longs spyod dang*/1$0000270 /mdzad pa 1$0000220ste drug po 1$0000270dag gis tha dad do// 1$0000220rgyan/1$0000270 zhes so// rang bzhin sku ni 1$0000220chos nyid kyis 1$0000270mnyam pa dang*// 1$0000220rtogs dka' bas 1$0000270phra zhing 1$0000220longs sku 1$0000270de dang 'brel ba dang 1$0000220de'i rgyu mtshan gyis longs sku'i phun tshogs pa'i rgyur gyur pa'o/1$0000270 /dgyes rgur longs spyod bstan pa la// longs spyod rdzogs 'byor rgyur 'dod do// zhes so// sprul sku ni/ gzhan don phun tshogs te/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub che// mya ngan 'das par rtag ston pa// sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku de ni// rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen po// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ 1$0000220ngo bo nyid sku 1$0000270rang bzhin 1$0000220gyis rtag 1$0000270dang ni 1$0000220longs sku sku de nyid 'khor ba ji srid bar 1$0000270rgyun mi chad 1$0000220pas rtag go1$0000270 1$0000220/sprul sku yang yang ston cing nam yang gang na yang gtan med ma yin pas 1$0000270rgyun gyis 1$0000220rtag go 1$0000270de dag rtag pa nyid// ces so// gsum pa ni/ 'og tu ston no// bzhi pa ni/ mtshan brjod las/ sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can// zhes pa la/ 'jam dpal grags pas de'i 'grel chen du 'dir bshad bzhi dang ye shes kyi sku dang lnga zhes so// 'jam dpal gyi rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan par/ sku ni gcig gnyis gsum dang ni// bzhi dang lnga ru gsungs pa ste// sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma

(192) 1$0000220med// dang po'i sangs rgyas1$0000270 1$0000220ris med pa// ye shes mig gcig dri ma med// de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes sku/ 1 /ji ltar gzugs kyi sku dang ni// de ltar sangs rgyas chos sku ste/ 2 /zhes dang*/ thugs gsung sku'i dbye ba yis// sku gsum du ni rab tu bsgrags// chos dang longs spyod sprul pa rnams// sngags kyi tshul la mi yis sgug 3 /ngo bo nyid yongs rdzogs pa zhus// zhes sogs 'di bzhin rkang pa bzhi bshad/ 1$0000270gzugs kyi phung po mtha' yas pa// bdag gi sprul pa'i sku mchog go /sgra yi phung po mtha' yas pa// bdag gi longs spyod rdzogs sku mchog /chos kyi phung po mtha' yas pa// bdag gi chos kyi sku rab bsgrags// ye shes phung po mtha' yas pa// bdag gi ye shes sku rab bsgrags// bde ba'i phung po mtha' yas pa// bdag gi bde sku 'gyur med mchog /ces chos longs sprul ye shes bde ba'i sku lngar bshad do// gser ni rtsa ba'i chos sku dang lnga zer ro// sprul sku la rnam par smin pa yin min du phye bas lngar 1$0000220 sngags don rnam gzigs su 1$0000270sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang chos bshes so// gnyis pa la/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ dbye ba gsum las/ rgyu ni/ nyan rang dgra bcom man nas sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams bcur bsgres pas sangs rgyas kyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig ba spu'i bu ga thams cad 'grub pa'i bsod nams brgyas dpe byad bzang po gcig dpe byad brgyad bcu 'grub pa'i bsod nams brgyas mtshan sum cu'i gcig mtshan sum cu 'grub pa'i bsod nams stong gis mdzod spu/ de 'bum gyis gtsug tor/ de bye ba 'bum phrag brgyas gsung chos kyi dung gcig 'grub ces rin chen phreng bar (193) ro// gtsug tor bsod nams bye ba ni// 'bum phrag brgyar ni bsgyur ba yis// stobs bcu mnga' ba'i chos kyi dung*// gcig 'byung bar ni shes par bya// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/

grag stong gnyis med gang zhig lha'i rnga bo che dang rnam pa bzhis mtshungs pa'i gsung yan lag drug cu can zhes pa mtshan nyid do// gang zag dang dus la khyab pas nyi tshe ba min pa/ 'di dang phyi ma la mi phan pa spong bas phan pa/ chos kyi dga' bde sgrub cing phyin ci log gi bde ba sel bas bde ba/ 'khor ba las nges par 'byin pa'o// rgyas par rgyud bla ma las shes dgos so// gsum pa ni/ mnyen dang 'jam dang yid du 'ong*// yid du 'thad dang dag pa dang*// dri med gsal dang snyan cing 'jebs// snyan 'os mi tshugs snyan pa dang*// dul dang mi rtsub mi brlang ba// rab dul rnar snyan lus sim byed// sems sim snying dga' dga' bde bskyed// gdung med kun shes rnam rig bya// rnam gsal dga' byed mngon dga' byed// kun shes rnam rig byed rigs pa// 'brel dang mi bzlos seṅge shugs// glang chen 'brug dang klu dbang dang*// dri za ka la ping ka tshangs// shang shang sgra dbyangs grags pa re re sbyar bdun// lha dbyangs rnga sgra ma khengs pa// mi dma' sgra kun rjes su zhugs// tshig zur ma chag ma tshang med// ma zhum mi zhan rab tu dga'// khyab dang tha ba med rgyun chags/ 1$0000220thub dgongs su1$0000270 */'bel dang gnyis med snang bar ro sgra kun rdzogs par byed// dbang po tshim byed ma smad pa// mi 'gyur ma brtabs (194) 'khor kun grag /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// yan lag drug cu'i gsung yin no/ 1$0000220/snang ba bzhin du snang*/ gcig ma btogs so// 1$0000270zhes so// bu gsum pa ni/ ye shes bzhi'am lnga ste/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ byed las so// dang po la/ gnas gyur pa'i rgyu kun gzhi nyon yid yid shes dbang shes rnams gnas gyur pa las ye shes bzhi rim bzhin 'byung ste/ tsan+t+ra go mis/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes gang yin pa// me long ye shes nyid gyur pa// de yang chos kyi dbyings kyi ni// ngo bo nyid du 'ga' zhig 'dod// ces dang*/

nyon mongs can yid gnas gyur pa// mnyam nyid ye shes brjod par bya// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni// yid kyi rnam shes nyid de'o// zhes dang*/ dbang po lnga yi rnam shes gang*// de ni don kun yongs 'dzin phyir// sems can kun gyi don du ni// bya ba sgrub pa tsam nyid thob// ces so// rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs dri bral du gnas gyur pas chos dbyings ye shes so// bdag po'i rgyu ni/ 1$0000220thos bsam gyis sde snod kyi chos 1$0000270'dzin pa'i phyir dang 1$0000220sems can thams cad la bdag gzhan 1$0000270sems mnyam pa'i phyir// 1$0000220gzhan la chos 1$0000270yang dag 1$0000220 par ston 1$0000270chos rab ston phyir dang*// 1$0000220sems can dang dkon mchog gi 1$0000270bya ba sgrub pa'i bzod phyir yang ste// ye shes bzhi po yang dag 'byung*// zhes so// gnyis pa la/ me long lta bu'i ye shes ni// nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa med pa// dmigs pa bem rig 1$0000220dza ya a nan+da 1$0000270gam snod bcud thams cad la rgya ma chad pa ste kun la dmigs pa dus thams cad du 'byung ba/ sgrib gnyis dang bral bas shes bya kun la ma rmongs/ yul gyi rnam pa med pas mngon du ma phyogs bzhin du me (195) long la gzugs brnyan bzhin du gsal bar snang ba ye shes gzhan gsum gyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa ste/ me long ye shes nga yi med// yongs su ma chad rtag tu ldan// shes bya kun la ma rmongs pa// rtag tu de la mngon phyogs min// zhes so// mnyam nyid ni/ byang se'i dus su bdag gzhan mnyam par bsgoms pa'i rgyu las gzugs brnyan lta bu'i 'gro ba rnams bdag gnyis med par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs nas mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la zhugs pa byams snying rje gnyis dang mtshungs ldan te/ mnyam nyid ye shes sems can la// bsgom pa dag pa las 'dod de// mi gnas pa'i zhi bar zhugs pa ni// mnyam nyid ye shes yin par 'dod// dus rnams kun tu byams pa dang*// thugs rje chen po dag dang ldan// zhes so// sor rtog ni/

shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med par so sor rtogs pa gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rnams kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i ye shes te/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni// shes bya kun la rtag mi thogs// ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams kyi// gter dang 'dra ba kho na yin// zhes so// ye shes de gnyis longs sku ste// tsan+t+ra go mis/ de dag longs spyod rdzogs sku nyid// chos la rdzogs longs spyod ston phyir// byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams// chos la rdzogs longs spyod phyir yang*// zhes so// bya sgrub ni/ 'jig rten thams cad du sna tshogs su sprul pas sems can gyi bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes mthar thug ste/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes ni// khams rnams kun tu sna tshogs (196) shing*// dpag med bsam yas sprul pa yis// sems can don kun sgrub pa'o// zhes so// de sprul sku ste/ de yang rtag par thams cad du// dus ji bzhin dang bsam ji bzhin// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprul sku ste// sprul pa kun gyi rgyu yin phyir// zhes so// chos dbyings ye shes ni/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa las grol zhing*/ shes rab dang snying rje gnyis su med pa spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin gnas yongs su gyur pa'i chos dbyings so// zhes a bha ya dang dza ya a nan+ta'o// de ni ngo bo nyid sku'o// me long lta bus chos dbyings dang chos thams cad la dmigs shing dbyings rig dbyer med pas de gnyis gcig tu bsdus te kha cig tu ngo bo nyid sku/ kha cig tu chos skur brjod ces a bha gsungs pa ni mi legs te ngo bo nyid sku yin pa med par 'gyur 'dus byas kyi me long ye shes dang chos dbyings gnyis ka yin pa med pas so// ngo bo nyid sku 'gog bden min par 'gyur ba sogs skyon du ma yod cing*/ me long lta bu longs skur mdo rgyan du bshad pa dang 'gal lo// gsum pa ni ye shes bzhi'i dang pos phyi ma gsum gyi rgyu byed de/

ye shes kun gyi rgyu mtshan phyir// ye shes 'byung gnas chen po 'dra// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid// ye shes gzugs brnyan 'byung phyir 1$0000220me long lta bu'i 1$0000270ro// zhes so// tsan+t+ra go mis/ kha cig me long ye shes kyang*// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru rtogs// de yang de la rgyu nyid phyir// nye bar btags las de bzhin gzhan// zhes te mnyam nyid sor rtog longs sku'i rgyu yin pas dang bya sgrub sprul sku'i (197) rgyu yin pas de dang der brjod ces tsan+t+ra go mi'i lung de dag thub dgongs su drangs shing dza ya a nan+tas kyang ngo*// pa'o// gnyis pas ni/1$0000220 byams snying rje gnyis kyis 1$0000270sems can rnams la mos pa dang 'tshams par bzhin/ 1$0000220'tshams par 1$0000270sangs rgyas sku ni nges par ston// zhes so// gsum pas ni/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su ni// 1$0000220bla na med pa'i dga' bde'i 1$0000270'byor ba thams cad ston 1$0000220 par 1$0000270mdzad 1$0000220 cing 1$0000270pa// the tshom thams cad gcod pa yi// chos chen char ni rab tu 'bebs// zhes so// bzhi pas ni/ sangs rgyas sprul pa de rtag tu// mdzad pa sgrub pa'i bye brag dang*// grangs dang zhing gis rnam kun tu// bsam mi khyab par shes par bya// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi ma 'dres bco brgyad ni bral ba'i yon tan/ mtshan sogs ldan pa'am rnam smin gyi yon tan/ yang na tshad med bzhi nas phyin drug gi bar rgyan las 'byung ba ltar ro// thub dgongs sogs las 'di rgya cher ro// lnga pa la/ byed pa po la yod pa'i 'phrin las la lhun gyis grub pa dang rgyun mi chad pa gnyis so// rgyud blar/ mdo rgyan las shes dgos so// gnyis pa ni/ tshogs lam na chos nyid rtogs pa'i sgom byung gsal snang can med pa phal che ba'i dbang du byas nas chos sku med ces bzhag

theg chen sbyor lam du de la gsal snang can gyi sgom byung mnyam bzhag brtan po yod pas sku bcas/ sa dang po yan chos dbyings nges pa 'dren nus su mngon sum gyis rtogs pas sku thob/ sa brgyad yan mi rtog ye shes rgyun chad med pas chos sku rdzogs zhes bzhag ste/ sku med pa dang (198) bcas dang sku thob dang*// sku yongs rdzogs dang*/ zhes so// mdor na slob lam na de pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan lhun grub rgyun mi chad kyi 'phrin las rjes mthun pa yod kyi rdzogs pa med do// gsum pa ni/ ngo bo nyid sku ye shes kyi yul du byas na spros bcas su 'gyur ro// ma byas na ma mkhyen par 'gyur ro// zhe na/ yongs gcod du yul min rnam gcad la chos 'ga' yang mthong med kyi tshul gyis mthong bas yul yin zhes 1$0000220bu ston 1$0000270so// 'on kyang yongs gcod ni sgrub pa ste ngo bo nyid sku sgrub chos mtha' yas pa can du rnam mkhyen gyis yul du byas pa kho na'o// chos bshes ni ngo bo nyid sku ye shes kyi yul min zer zhing gser de 'gog ste 'og tu 'chad do// gzugs sku la ye shes yod na rgyud du mar 'gyur te gzugs sku du ma yod pas so// zhe na/ mi 'gyur te/ klu rgyal rnams la sbrul mgo stong la sogs yod cing de sems bcas yin kyang rgyud du mar mi 'gyur ba dang ri tha dad pa'i dbang gis 'char ba'i nyi ma bzhin no// de yang rang gi sku nyid du byin gyis brlabs nas sprul pa yin pa dang don la ye shes nyid du bshad pas so// ye shes yod tshul la rgyan dang slob dpon dang a bha ya chos bshes sogs ye shes nyid longs sprul sku gdung sogs su snang bar bzhed/ tsan+t+ra go mi ye shes rgyur byas nas longs sprul sogs byung bar bzhed do// de ltar na sangs rgyas sa'i chos thams cad ngo bo nyid chos skur bzhag go /sa bcu pa'i byang sems dang sangs rgyas phrin las mnyam par bshad de/
rgyud blar/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'di ni// rjes thob de bzhin gshegs rnams dag /sems

(199) can yang dag sgrol ba la// 'jig rten na ni mnyam pa nyid// ces so// kha cig cung zad tsam gyis mnyam gyi mnyam pa dngos min te/ rgyud blar/ de lta mod kyi sa rdul dang*// rgya mtsho ba lang rmig rjes kyi// khyad par gang yin sangs rgyas dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i khyad de nyid// ces pas so 1$0000220bu ston rin po che 1$0000270gsungs te/ de'i don thogs med kyis sngar drangs des gzhan don khyad med du dang*/ phyi ma 'dis rang don khyad yod par bstan zhes bshad pas dgongs pa dngos min no// gnyis pa la/ tha dad/ go rim/ grangs nges pa bsam pa'o// dang po ni/ gsum mtshan nyid pa rdzas tha dad de/ gang zag so so gsum gyi rtogs pa yin pas so// rjes mthun pa gcig dang tha dad ci rigs so// sbyor bzhi lam shes dang ngo bo gcig cing gzhi shes dang rdzas tha dad do// bzhi po nang phal cher ngo bo gcig la gnas skabs rdzas tha dad pa yang yod de/ bu ston 'di go zlog pa ni nor ro/ tshogs lam na rtse sbyor med cing rnam kun dang mthar sbyor yod pa lta bu'o// chos sku dang rnam mkhyen bdag gcig cing gzhan drug dang bdag mi gcig go /'dir rin po cher nor ba yod do// gnyis pa ni/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab bya'i yul/ phebs nas nyams len sbyor ba/ blangs pa'i 'bras bu chos sku ste/ nyams len gyi rim pa 'bras bcas kyi sgo nas bstan to// 'dir 'jug yul mkhyen gsum zhes 'chad pa ni 'jug yul ngos ma zin pa'i mnyam ste 'jug mkhan (200) byang sems yin mod gzhi shes mtshan nyid pa de'i 'jug yul min te de'i thob bya min pas so// 'jug yul ni thob bya'am don du gnyer bya nyid la zer ro// gsum ni 'jug pa'i yul gyi rgyu'o// zhes slob dpon 'chad pa ni 'jug pa'i yul chos sku ste/ de'i rgyu zhes pa yin no// mkhyen gsum yang 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir rnam mkhyen dang por bstan/

de rgyu la ma goms pa las byung bas de nas lam shes bstan/ de la gol sa shes dgos shing spang bya spong dgos pas de nas gzhi shes bstan te bshad rim mo// sbyor ba la/ gsum thos bsam gyi shes pa de dbang du bya dgos pas de'i thabs rnam kun bstan/ de las dbang thob pa 'byung bas de nas rtse sbyor bstan/ de brtan par byed cing nyams na gso ba'i phyir mthar gyis bstan/ de mthar thug pa na brtan pa thob pa 'byung bas de nas skad cig ma bstan te don rim gtso che'o// de rnams kyi 'bras bu chos sku ston te/ don rim mo// de nas kyi sgras bstan zhes gser dgongs so// gsum pa ni/ yum gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la gtan la dbab bya'i yul/ phebs nas bsgom tshul/ bsgom 'bras gsum du nges pas mkhyen gsum sbyor bzhi chos skur nges so// gsum po yang 'bras bu rgyu gol sa'am/ blang dor gsum du nges la/ sbyor ba 'di dbang thob pa'i don du bsgom pa rgyu 'bras brtan pa thob don du bsgom pa rgyu 'bras su nges pas rnam rtse gnyis mthar skad gnyis su nges te chos sku'i rgyu'i rnal 'byor ni de tsam du zad pas so// zhugs 'bras chos skur nges te de tsam gyis 'dod don mtha' dag (201) rdzogs pas so// des na mngon rtogs de gser ni rnam pa gser brgyad du nges so// dang ni rdzogs tshig go /yang na de nas chos sku dang zhes bsdu ba bya'o// zhes gser ro// zlos spong rnams thad ka thad kar bya'o// gnyis pa la brgyad las/ dang po rnam mkhyen gyi dngos po bcu bshad pa la/ bzhi las dang po lam gyi rang bzhin nam rten byang chub sher 'byung mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid/ gtso bo sems gang zhig gzhan don phyir du rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa dang mtshungs ldan zhes pa 'phags seng ngo*// shān+ti ltar na gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod par gyur pa'i blo zhes pa ste/

dag ldan du/ gzhan don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa ni sems bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid do// zhes dang*/ snying po mchog tu/ sems bskyed pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis brjod pa yin te/ dang po ni/ 'dun pa'i mtshan nyid kyi khyad par ro// lhag ma ni de'i grogs kyi khyad par ro zhes dang*/ mi zad pa brgyad cur brjod de/ dang po ni sems bskyed pa nyid do// lhag ma ni de'i grogs te sbyor ba dang bsam pa la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'o// zhes so// 'di legs so// dbye na nyer gnyis so// gser gyis gzhan don du 'tshang rgya ba nyid kyi sems 'jog pa ni sems bskyed do// zhes so// gnyis pa de smin cing dag par byed pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ theg chen sems bskyed kyis don du gnyer ba'i don rtogs shing thob pa'i thabs sangs rgyas la sogs (202) pas 'doms pa'i ngag gi rig byed dam/ de ltar gdams pa ltar nyams su len pa'i blo gang rung ngo*// chos bshes gyis so// gser gyis rnam pa bcu la bslab pa ni/ gdams ngag go zhes so// de la gdams pa dang rjes bstan gnyis yod de 'og tu ston no// rgyan ltar na ston pa po sangs rgyas/ nyan pa po chos mchog pa la bshad sbyar du bshad cing 'grel chen las tshogs lam pa la bshad de tshogs lam chen po nas so// rgyu chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin te de'i mtshan nyid brtags pa'i dngos po la sems rtse gcig pa gang zhig dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i dran pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'o// sgra bshad ni gsung rab dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos rnams kyi tshig dang don 'dzin pas chos kyi rgyun brtags pa'i dngos po la sems rtse gcig pas ting nge 'dzin no// de tshe chos kyi rgyun la ni// sangs rgyas rnams la zhi gnas dang*// ye shes yangs pa thob bya'i phyir// gdams ngag rgya chen rnyed par 'gyur// zhes so// bsgom pa'i tshul la sogs pa rgyan las rgya cher shes par bya zhing mang du dogs pas 1$0000220kun btus 1$0000270bzhag go

/'dir bshad dang rgyan du bshad pa rnams mi 'dra zhing rgyu mtshan sogs 'og tu bshad par bya'o// gsum pa gdams pa'i 'bras bu nges 'byed cha mthun ni/ nges 'byed de gcig tu nges pa dang ldan pa'o// dam par mi rtog pa rtogs pa ni nges par 'byed pa ste mthong ba'i lam mo// de thob pa ni cha'o// de la phan pa ni nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa'o// zhes dag ldan 1$0000220zla zer yang don de'o// 1$0000270no// nges pa ste mtha' gcig tu mi rtog ye shes/ 'byed pa ni rtogs pa (203) ste mthong lam de'i yan lag ni rgyu zhes pa'o// snying po mchog tu nges par rtogs pa ni nges 'byed do zhes dang*/ so sor rtogs pa ni nges 'byed ces so// gser gyis nges par 'byed pa ni 'tshang rgya ba nyid mngon sum du byed pa'o// zhes so// de'i mtshan nyid ni/ tshogs lam gyi rjes kyi so skye'i sgom byung gi ye shes gang zhig bden pa mngon sum du rtogs pa dang rjes su mthun pa/ dbye na drod rtse bzod mchog rnam pa bzhi'o// dang thams cad sdud tshig go /bzhi pa gdams pa'i don phyin ci ma log par sgrub pa la bzhi las/ sgrub pa yi ni rten du gyur pa ste rgyu rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin te rnam 'gyur dang ya ma bral ba'i chos dbyings rnam dag ste/ ār+yas rang bzhin gtso bor gyur pa ni rigs zhes sogs bshad do// phye na chos nyid gcig nyid brten pa bsgrub pa bcu gsum gyi sgo nas bcu gsum du'o// gnyis pa rten de la brten nas sgrub pa'i dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang bzhin dang ya ma bral ba'i rnam 'gyur sgrub pa po'i shes byar gyur pa ste/ ār+yas rnam 'gyur gtso bor gyur pa ni dmigs pa zhes so// dbye na bcu gcig go /gsum pa de la dmigs nas sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba dag gi mtshan nyid ni/

gang gi don du sgrub pa byed pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug te/ sdud 'grel du/ skad cig ma bstan nas/ de'i rjes la rnam pa thams cad mngon du byed pa ched du bya ba gsum mngon sum du byas nas rtogs pa de nyid ni sangs rgyas kyi sa kun tu 'od la chos skur byang chub ces te 'og tu rgyas par bya'o// (204) dbye na/ gzhan don spangs rtogs gsum zhes sher 'byung ngo*// bzhi pa ji ltar sgrub pa'i ngo bo la/ spyir theg chen sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ sems bskyed la gnas nas rang gzhan gyi don rtsom pa byang chub chen po'i rgyur gyur pa'i byang se'i spyod pa'am nyams len te/ gnas rtsom 'bras bu 'byung ba che bdag nyid// rgyal sras rnams kyi sgrub pa yin par 'dod// ces dang*/ sgrub pa ni spyod pa'o// zhes shān+ti rang kir ro// gser ni sgrub pa ni nyams su len pa ste/ zhes so// 'dir smros byang se'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gdams ngag thob pa rigs la brten nas dmigs pa rim gyis rtogs te chen po gsum gyi ched du brtson pa'i byas te sgrub pa'i gdams ngag sgrub pa'i 1$0000220rang kir 1$0000270rten sgrub pa'i dmigs 1$0000220 rad 1$0000270pa sgrub pa'i ched 1$0000220rang 1$0000270du bya ba zhes dang rten can gyi bya ba zhes so// dbye na/ mi mthun phyogs gyis mi tshugs pa'i go cha'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ byang se'i sgrub pa gang zhig bsam pa'i bya ba ste/ gnod 'joms su/ go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya ba ni sems dang po nas gzung ste bsam pa rgya che bar bstan pa'o// zhes so// sa bcu pa'i 'grel par/ de la go cha ni smon pa'o// zhes dbyig gnyen gyis so// dbye na drug gam so drug go /'dir smros go sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig phyin drug re rer drug drug tshang bar nyams su len par go bgos pa'o// go bgos nas theg chen gyi g.yul du 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ni/

byang se'i sgrub pa gang zhig sbyor ba'i bya ba/ 'dir smros 'jug sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ 'jug yul theg chen dgu char ram gang rung la 'jug cing (205) 'jog pa'i sgrub pa'o// dbye na dgu'o// spyir sgrub pa bzhi ngo bo gcig pa'i lugs so// zhugs te dpung gi tshogs gsog pa'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ byang se'i sgrub pa gang zhig rang 'bras slob lam mam mi slob pa'i byang chen gyi rgyu'i mthar thug pa'i tshogs sgrub pa'am thob par byed pa ste/ dbye na bcu bdun no// dag ldan du/ gang gis rgyu'i mthar thug thob par byed pa de ni tshogs kyi sgrub pa bcu bdun no// zhes so// dpung tshogs bsags pas ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba thob pas nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig nges par 'byung sa brgyad po gang rung du dngos su nges par 'byin pa/ dbye na brgyad do// ār+yas go bgos pas ni 'jug go /zhugs pa ni dpung gi tshogs gsog go /dpung gi tshogs bsags pa ni ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba thob pas nges par 'byung ba'i phyir ro// zhes so// rgyas par 'og tu ston no// sgrub pa dang sbyor bzhi'i khyad par ni/ lo ts+tsha ba na re/ rnal 'byor gyi rang bzhin sbyor ba/ spyod pa gtso bor gyur pa sgrub pa gsungs so// 'dir sgrub pa'i ngo bo brtson 'grus yin gsungs shing dus phyis sgrub pa'ang brtson 'grus kho na min/ sbyor ba'ang ting nge 'dzin kho na min gyi brtson 'grus dang ting nge 'dzin gyi gtso byas pa'i dad sogs yin no gsungs so// ngo bo gcig go /nges 'byung dang bcas pa'i shān+ti dngos chos bcu po rnams kyis thub pa de shān+ti pa'i mngon rtogs rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid bstan to// gnyis pa lam shes kyi dngos shān+ti rang kir dngos po bcu gcig la/ lam shes kyi (206) yan lag dang sher 'byung dngos yan lag can gyi lam shes so// dang po ni/

rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi 'od kyis lha rnams kyis 'od mog mog po gzi med par byed pa'am mdzad pas lha rnams nga rgyal gyi rtogs pa dang bral te sems dang bar gnas par gyur lam lam shes skyo rung gi rten du gyur pa dang*/ sogs pa skye ba'i yul theg chen sems 1$0000220gser 1$0000270bskyed can/ rgyu'i rkyen rigs kyis khyab pa/ gzhan don du skye ba len pa'i rgyu dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi chags pa phra mo ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba'i rang bzhin/ gzhan don gyi byed las can rnams so// mtshan nyid ni/ mtshan 'dzin gyi gnyen po'i yan lag ste/ sher 'byung gis gnyen po'i yan lag ni lam shes kyi yan lag go zhes so// gnyis pa la gsum las/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes ni/ byang chub thob pa nges par slob dpon la ltos pas slob ma ste nyan thos kyi lam yon tan yar ldan du byas te sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i sgo nas phyin ci ma log par shes pa'i blo/ de rgyu 'bras gnyis kyi sgo nas ston no// gnyis pa bse rus mtshon pa rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes ni/ rang rgyal gyi lam yon tan yar ldan du byas te sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i sgo nas ma nor bar shes pa'i blo/ de khyad par ngo bo rgyu gsum gyis ston no// gsum pa byang se'i lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag med gnyis ka rtogs pa'i slob lam du gnas pa'i sgo nas theg chen slob lam ma nor bar shes pa'i blo/ dbye na gnyis las/ phan yon can gyi mthong lam shes pa ni/ tshe 'di (207) pa'i yon tan nad med pa sogs dang tshe gzhan pa'i yon tan phyir mi ldog pa sogs kyi phan yon chen po can gyi mthong ba'i lam gyi dngos por gnas pa'i sgo nas de ma nor bar shes pa/ de yang shes bya theg chen mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ zag med sgom lam ma skyes gong gi zag med ye shes gang zhig

rdzogs byang du bgrod pa'i go skabs phye shul/ dbye na skad cig bcu drug go /gnyis pa byed pa can gyi theg chen sgom lam shes pa ni/ sems dul ba sogs kyi 'bras bu can gyi theg chen sgom lam gyi dngos por gnas pa'i sgo nas de ma nor bar shes pa/ de ston pa la gnyis/ sgom lam gyi byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ sgom lam gyi 'bras bu khyad par ba ste bya ba de byed pa la byed pa zhes bzhag go /yang na sems dul ba la sogs pa'i 'bras bu khyad par ba byed pa'o// shān+tis zag med kyir 'chad do// shes bya theg chen 'phags pa'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ mthong lam gyi rjes kyi nyon mongs pa'i zag med ye shes gang zhig byang chen du phyin byed kyi slob lam mo// 'dir de gnyis dang de gnyis shes pa'i lam shes ngo bo gcig go /gnyis pa byed pa can gyi sgom lam la/ rjes thob dang mnyam bzhag gnyis las/ dang po la gsum gyi/ dang po/ dge ba gsog byed kyi theg chen sgom lam mos pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'phags pa'i sgom lam zag bcas gang zhig yum sher phyin yon tan can la yon tan can du nges nas 'dzin pa ste/ nyer bdun no// de'i phan yon nam 'bras bu bstod pa'i (208) mtshan nyid/ sgom lam rang don mos pa'i che ba'i yon tan ji lta ba bzhin rtogs nas sangs rgyas la sogs pa 1$0000220chos bshes gser sogs 1$0000270thugs dges pa'i gnas skabs sam/ rtogs nas sangs rgyas la sogs pas ston pa'i ngag gi rig byed seng bzang bi ma la gang yang rung ba'o// sgom lam mos pa'i phan yon bkur ba'i mtshan nyid/ sgom lam gnyis don mos pa'i che ba zhes sogs/ sgom lam mos pa'i phan yon bsngags pa'i mtshan nyid/ sgom lam gzhan don mos pa'i zhes sogs dgod do// dbye na dgu dgu ste nyer bdun no// gnyis pa dge ba mi zad par byed pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i sgom lam bsngo ba yid la byed pa'i mtshan nyid/

zur dang po 'dra/ dge ba rnams gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyur stobs pa'o// gser ro// bcu gnyis so// gsum pa dge ba 'phel byed theg chen 'phags pa'i sgom lam rjes su yi rang ba yid la byed pa bla med kyi mtshan nyid/ dang po 'dra/ rang bzhin gyi dge rtsa la rab tu dga' ba yid la byed pa'o// gnyis su byas pa nor ro// gnyis pa la gnyis las dang po/ theg chen gyi sgrub pa sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen 'phags pa'i zag med sgom lam gang zhig bar chad med lam du gyur pa'o// de'i khyad chos lnga yod do// gnyis pa theg chen 'phags pa'i shin tu dag pa'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ zur dang po 'dra/ rnam grol lam du gyur pa zhes bya ba ste/ mos pa dang bcas pa lnga po 'di ni sgom pa'i lam mo zhes gser ro// 'on kyang 'di

(209) gnyis kyi snga ma rtogs pa lam bden/ phyi ma spangs pa 'gog bden te de ltar yin cing zhes bya ba ni sgom pa'i lam spangs rtogs dang bcas pa'o zhes te 'og tu 'chad do// byang chub sems dpa' bden gnyis 1$0000220gser 1$0000270la'am theg gsum gyi 1$0000220bu 1$0000270lam la mkhas pa rnams kyi mngon rtogs lam shes pa nyid kyi skabs ni dngos 1$0000220 shān+ti rang kir 1$0000270po bcu gcig po de 'dra bar bsdus nas mdo las bshad do// lam gsum shes pa de 'drar zhes bu ston no// gsum pa gzhi shes kyi dngos po 1$0000220shān+ti rang kir 1$0000270dgu la dang po ni/ dus gsum mnyam nyid du shes pas srid pa la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ chos kun bden pa'i rang bzhin med par rtogs pas tshur rol gyi mthar mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes/ gnyis pa snying rje chen pos zhi ba la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ mkha' mnyam sems can gyi don byed pa'i bsam pas pha rol kyi mthar mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes/ gsum pa 'bras yum bskyed pa'i thabs ma yin pas 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ ming dang dngos po'i mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gzhi shes/ bzhi pa 'bras yum bskyed pa'i thabs su gyur pa nyid kyis 'bras yum la ring ba min pa'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi thabs shes rab khyad par can gyi gzhi shes/ lnga pa mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ byang se'i mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa'i spang byar gyur pa'i gzhi shes/ de la gzhi lam 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin gsum mo// drug pa gnyen po'i (210) phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi spang bya chags pa'i mtha' ma lus pa 'gog pa'i gzhi shes gang zhig byang se'i rtogs pa yin pa'o// bdun pa gzhi shes dngos bstan gyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ gzugs sogs la mngon zhen bkag nas bsgom pa'i byang se'i sbyor lam/

dbye na bcu'o// bod rnams theg chen slob lam bzhin yod lo// brgyad pa 'dir dngos bstan gyi sbyor ba de'i mnyam nyid ni/ yul yul can gang du yang slom sems bkag nas bsgom pa gang zhig dngos bstan gyi sbyor ba bcu'i mtshungs chos te/ ldog chas phye na bzhi'o// dgu pa mthong lam ste de la gnyis las/ gzhi shes dngos bstan gyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ sngar ltar ram/ gzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum gyis gsar du mthong ba'i ye shes so// dbye na bcu drug go /gzhi shes shugs bstan gyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi gang zag gam gzung ba bdag med mngon sum du gsar du mthong zhing mtshan 'dzin gyi blo/ mthong dmigs bya ba mngon rtogs zhes pa ni theg dman gyi lugs kho na'o// de ltar na shugs bstan gyi de 'dra de nyan thos dang sogs pa rang rgyal gyi kun shes nyid du 'dod pa yin la dngos bstan gyi de sogs pa byang se'i ste gnyen phyogs yin no// 1$0000220jo bo'i dpon po 1$00002701$00002201$0000270 paṇ+ḍi ta da na shri mi tra na re/ a ti'i sgra 'dir sogs min gyi mchog la 'jug ces dang*/ 'jam gsar sogs ral gri ni/ sogs la bsdu bya med zer ba rnams nor ba'o// gser gyis nyan thos la sogs ni/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang sems rnams kyi thabs (211) min dang thabs de 'dra zhes so// bzhi pa rnam kun gyi dngos po 1$0000220 shān+ti rang kir dngos 1$0000270bcu gcig gi dang po rnam pa ni/ yul gzhi'am yul can ye shes bye brag theg chen sbyor ba'i bsgom byar gyur pa/ de la bsdu na gsum/ phye na brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum mo// gnyis pa sbyor ba ni/ gsum la dbang gyur thob pa'i phyir du bsgom bya'i rnam pa rnams bsdus te sgom pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dbye na nyi shu'o// bcas pa ni lhan cig pa ste/ yum gyi sbyor ba po gang zag ni sngon du tshogs bsags pas yum nyan pa la sogs pa'i snod du gyur pa'i skyes bu ste/

dbye na nyan pa/ 'dzin pa/ mi brjed pa/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i snod bzhi'o// 'di shān+ti rang kir gyis ma bgrangs shing zhar byung yin no// gsum pa sbyor ba'i yon tan ni/ sbyor ba bsgoms pa'i gnas skabs sam/ mthar thug gi thob bya'i 'bras bu/ dbye na bcu bzhi'o// bzhi pa sbyor ba'i skyon ni/ sbyor ba bsgom pa po 'ga' zhig gis sbyor ba bsgom pa'i bar du gcod byed kyi las/ yang na yum la thos bsam bsgom pa gang rung gi bar chad du gyur pa'i las/ dbye na zhe drug go /lnga pa sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ sbyor ba rnams kyi rtogs pa khyad par can 'phrin las ngo bo nyid gang yang rung ba mtshon byed yin pa/ yang na sbyor ba rnams rgyu'am khyad par can nam sbyor ba'i ngo bo mtshon byed gang yang rung ba/ dbye na dgu bcu rtsa gcig go /drug pa thog mar bstan pa la 'jug pa thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i mtshan nyid/ so so'i nges 'byed cha mthun ma skyes gong gi myang 'das kyi rgyur gyur pa'i dge (212) ba/ theg chen gyi ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur zhes sbyar ro// nyan rang la yang ngo*// rgyas par 'og tu ston no// bdun pa de yongs su smin pa theg chen gyi rjes thob yin pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ dmigs yul sems can kun la dmigs nas rnam pa de dag la sems mnyam pa la sogs pa gang rung can gyi sbyor lam rjes thob/ dbye na bcu gnyis so// sher 'byung ni zag pa med pa'i sbyor lam zhes dang*/ gser khyad par lam gyi ye shes zhes te/ slob dpon gyi dgongs pa'o// brgyad pa bslab par bya ba yod pas slob pa rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs te dge 'dun gyi mtshan nyid/ da phyin chad theg dman du mi ltung nges pa'i rtags thob pa'i byang sems te sbyor mthong sgom gsum pa gsum mo// 'dir bzhi yan chad tshang ba zhes 1$0000220'od zer mgon po 1$0000270 'jog pa ni theg pa che chung gi grub mtha'i khyad ma phyed pa'i gtam mo// dgu pa chos sku'i yan lag gam 1$0000220sher 1$0000270 rgyu srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/

rnam sbyor gang zhig 'khor 'das la blang dor du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa'i gnyen por 'khor 'das bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mnyam par bsgom pa/ yang na dag sa'i zhes sam rgyun mtha'i sbyor ba gang zhig ces sbyar te 'og tu 'chad do// bcu pa nye ba'i yan lag longs sku'i rgyu zhing dag pa bla na med pa'am mchog tu gyur pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam sbyor gang zhig snod bcud kyi 'jig rten nyes pa med cing yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir du bsgom pa/ de la snod bcud dag pa gnyis so// bcu gcig pa sems can yongs su (213) smin pa'i yan lag thabs mkhas sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ rnam sbyor gang zhig yul bcu mngon sum du bya ba la dus dus min shes pas sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las phun tshogs kyi rgyur gyur pa/ dbye na bcu'o// thabs mkhas dang bcas pa'i dngos po bcu gcig po 'dis ni rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa'i skabs bsdus nas bstan pa yin no zhes so// lnga pa rtse mo'i dngos po shān+ti rang kir brgyad la dang po ni/ sngar rtse mor phyin dang zhes bshad pa'i rtse mo de yi rtags sam rtags kyi rtse mo'i mtshan nyid/ bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur par mtshon byed gang zhig byang se'i sbyor lam drod 1$0000220rang kir don 1$0000270dbye na bcu gnyis so// gnyis pa rnam 'phel gyi rtse mo'i mtshan nyid/ bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sbyor lam rtse mo gang zhig bsod nams khyad 'phags bcu drug can no// dbye na bcu drug go /gsum pa brtan pa'i rtse mo'i mtshan nyid/ shes rab kyis mkhyen gsum gyi chos yongs su rdzogs par bsngos shing snying rje gzhan don gyi bsam pa brtan po can gyi sbyor lam bzod par gyur pa'o// bzhi pa sems kun tu gnas pa'i rtse mo'i mtshan nyid/ de kho na nyid la sems rtse gcig pa'i sbyor lam chos mchog gang zhig bsod nams phul byung mtha' yas pa can no// lnga pa mthong lam rtse mo'i mtshan nyid/

bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pas byang se'i mthong lam/ drug pa sgom lam rtse mo'i mtshan nyid/ bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i byang 'phags kyi sgom lam mo// yang na phar phyin drug gi ngo bor gyur (214) pa'i byang se'i sdug bsngal chos bzod 1$0000220rang kir 1$0000270kho na'i gnas skabs/ seṅge rnam bsgyings sngon du btang ste byang 'phags sgom lam pa'i thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug khyad par pa zhes rim bzhin sbyar ro// rtse mo'i mthong sgom gnyis po mthong sgom gyi gnas skabs de la bzhag snang ngo*// zhes bya ba'i lam gnyis po so so tshe de la spang bya rnam par rtog pa 'jug ldog rdzas btags la brten pa rnam pa bzhi bzhi'i gnyen po nyer bsdogs dang bar chad med lam gnyis gnyis te rnam pa bzhi re re la'ang dgu dgu'o// lam gnyis po re re la dang por gnyis su phye ba ni rdzas kyis phye zhing de nas gnyis su phye ba ni spang bya'i dbang gis phye ba ste ldog pa'i cha nas so// rtog pa bzhi'i ming 'dogs mthun par gser gling pas 'dir bshad/ ār+ya sogs kyi 'og tu ston no// bdun pa bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sgom lam chen po'i chen po gang zhig 'bras bu rnam mkhyen gyi dngos rgyur gyur pa'o// brgyad pa bsal bya log sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ bden gnyis 'gal bar bsam nas rtsod pa'i rtsod pa/ de la bcu drug go /log sgrub dang bcas pa'i dngos po brgyad kyis rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa'i skabs bsdus nas bstan 1$0000220rang kir 1$0000270no// drug pa mthar gyis pa/ dngos po bcu gsum la sbyin pa'i mthar sbyor gyi/ mthar sbyor gang zhig 'khor gsum dag pa'i sbyin 'go rim gyis bsgom pa ste phar phyin gzhan lnga la yang sbyar ro// sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi mthar sbyor gyi/ mthar sbyor gang zhig don dam par de pa'i yon tan dran pa med cing yid la byar med

(215) pa'i tshul gyis kun rdzob tu phyin ci ma log par dran pa/ de bzhin du dge mi dge lung du ma bstan pa'i chos/ slob pa phyir mi ldog gi tshogs/ sdom pa gsum/ chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa/ lhar skyes pa'i 'phags pa zhes sbyar te/ chos/ dge 'dun/ tshul khrims/ gtong ba/ lha rjes dran gyi mthar sbyor gyi'o// dngos med ngo bo nyid du shes pa'i mthar sbyor gyi/ mthar sbyor gang zhig chos thams cad don dam par ngo bo nyid med par rtogs nas bsgom pa/ de ltar dkon mchog gsum rjes dran rnam pa gsum dang gzhan sbyin pa la sogs pa rnam gser pa bcus mthar gser gyis pa'i mngon rtogs bsdus nas bstan 1$0000220rang kir 1$0000270no// bdun pa skad cig ma'i dngos po bzhi la/ dang po rnam smin min pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam smin min pa'i zag med gcig mngon du byed pa na de dang rigs mthun thams cad gcig car mngon du byed pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ste/ de bzhin du rnam smin dang*/ mtshan nyid med pa/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i mtshan nyid/ rnam smin gyi dkar chos/ kun byang mtshan nyid med par/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su med par ro// de dag kyang rdzas tha dad kyis phye ba min gyi spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis phye ba rnam pa bzhis ni skad cig ma gcig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i skabs bsdus nas bstan no// brgyad pa chos sku'i dngos po bzhi ga dbye gzhi ni sangs rgyas kyi sa la chos skur bzhag pa tsam mo// dbye ngo rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag ste ma nor bar brjod (216) do// mdo las/ bzhi po gang na/ ngo bo nyid longs spyod rdzogs sku sprul pa mdzad pa bzhir ār+ya sogs so// sku bzhir seng bzang sogs so// bzhi'i lugs bkod na/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i mtshan nyid/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos dbyings ye shes te/

rgyud blar/ chos dbyings ngo bo nyid kyis ni// dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba// zhes dang*/ nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi /sgrib gsum las ni nges grol te// zhes so// gnyis pa sangs rgyas kyi longs spyod rdzogs sku'i mtshan nyid/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku nges pa lnga ldan te/ gnas nges pa 'og min chen po ste de yang gtsang ma'i gnas 'og min phal pa'i steng na yod de/ lang gshegs las/ gtsang ma'i gnas dag spangs pa yi// 'og min gnas ni nyams dga' bar// yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas// sprul pa po gcig 'dir 'tshang rgya// zhes so// de ltar zhi 'tsho ka shi yang ngo*// bka' bcad du/ 'og min phal pa de'i logs gcig na grong las dgon pa ltar yod par 'dod do// ngo bo'am sku nges pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ 'khor nges pa a bha ya zla grags seng bzang sogs sa bcu'i byang sems/ chos bshes sa bcu pa'i byang sems kho na/ blo brtan yang mthar phyin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang chos 'gro ba myong*/ zhes dbus mtha'i 'grel bshad du'o// dus nges pa sku de nyid kyis 'khor ba ji srid bar bzhugs// chos nges theg chen kho na'o// skyabs gsum bdun bcu par/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs sku ni// mtshan dang dpe byad rab 'bar zhing*// skye bo rnams la sna tshogs gzugs// (217) rang mos dbang gis 'dzin par byed// bsod nams tshogs ni dpag med las// byung ba de ni rgyal ba'i sras// sa bcu la ni gnas rnams kyis// de lta bu yi skur gzigs so// 'di de chos rdzogs longs spyod pas// rgyal sras rnams kyis spyad bya'o// chos rnams rang bzhin kho na la// gnas pa'i blo la sangs rgyas brjod// 'og min gzhal yas khang du ni// de nyid mngon sum bya bar bzhed// ces te/ thub dgongs su drangs so// bod ngan rim pa 'di ji bzhin du rim snod/ bcas ni longs sku/ bzhi'i ya gyal du sdud tshig gam theg chen gyi chos la rdzogs par longs spyod bcas te ldan pa'i sku zhes sbyar ro// ngo bo nyid sku ye shes kyi bdag nyid yin pa de bzhin du sku gzhan yang ye shes kyi bdag nyid can no// zhes blta bar bya'o// gser ro// gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i sku ni/

sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku gang zhig mthong spang gis ma dag pa'i gdul bya'i don dngos su mdzad pa/ dbye na dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' gdul ba'i don du dri zar sprul pa lta bu bzo dang*/ sor phreng can du ston pa lta bu skye ba lho phyogs kyi sangs rgyas gcig gi sprul par sor phreng gi mdor bshad do// yang na dam pa tog dkar lta bu'am ka phi na 'dul ba'i don du 'khor los bsgyur rgyal du bstan pa lta bu'o// 'og min du sangs rgyas nas 'dir mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa byang chub chen po'i sprul pa dang 'grel chen du mya ngan las 'das pa'ang sprul pa'i skur 'dod do zhes so// bzhi pa chos sku ni/ gnas gyur pa'i 'dus byas ye shes kyi tshogs mthar thug pa/ dbye na sde tshan nyer gcig gsal ba brgya zhe bzhi'o// chos sku'i mdzad pa 'phrin

(218) las ni rtogs pa chos skus skal ldan gdul bya'i don bsgrubs pa'am sgrub pa'i bya ba/ dbye na byed pa po la dang*/ bya ba la yod pa'i gnyis las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las gang zhig rgyun mi chad cing lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid zur dang po 'dra/ sangs rgyas kyi gdul byas thob pa'i dge legs ci rigs pa/ dbye na nyer bdun no// bcas pa ni ldan pa ste mdzad pa dang bcas pa'am ldan pa'i chos sku zhes pa slob dpon gyi dgongs pa ste 'og tu ston no// 'on kyang 'dir smros tshigs bcad 'di'i don ni ār+ya sogs ltar yin gyi slob dpon gyi ltar min te/ dus 'khor 'grel chen du/ sku gsum mdzad pa dang bzhir nges par byams pas gsungs pa/ ngo bo nyid longs zhes sogs nas brjod ces so zhes gsungs so// 'dir chos sku zhes pa'i gzhung tshig sku bzhir phye ba'i chos sku la byas nas dbye ba'i ya gyal du bgrang na tshigs bcad 'dis rnam pa bzhir brjod pa'i dbye gzhi ma zin pas dbye gzhi med pa'i dbye ba byas par 'gyur zhing gong ma bdun rnam mkhyen nas skad cig ma'i bar re re zhing smros nas 'dir ma smros pas lus sam skabs bsdu ba'i ngo bo dngos su chad par 'gyur ro// 'jam dpal gyi rang gi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan du/ sku bzhi ston pa la tshigs bcad 'di tshig ji bzhin snang ba dang ni mi 'dra ste/ der gong du/ sku ni gcig gnyis gsum dang ni// bzhi dang lnga ru gsungs pa ste// zhes bstan nas gcig sogs rim bzhin bshad pas dbye gzhi gong du (219) smros zin pa'o// rgyas par 'og tu ston no// gsum pa ni/ lus kyi tshigs bcad bco lnga po de la ste de'i nang nas shes rab nas de rnam brgyad kyi bar tshig le'ur byas pa dang po gnyis chos can/ yum mam bstan bcos kyi lus mdor bstan pa yin no// khyod kyis ni gzhung sher phyin gyi brjod bya'i gtso bo dngos po ste mngon rtogs brgyad du bsdus nas rgyan 'di'i lus rgyas bshad kyi thog mar bkod pa'i 'di'i lus kyi tshig le'ur byas pa yin pa'i phyir/

sems bskyed pa dang nas bzhir ni yang dag brjod kyi bar tshig le'ur byas pa lhag ma bcu gsum chos can/ yum mam rgyan gyi lus rgyas par bshad de/ rgyan 'di'i lus mdor bstan de dag nyid kyi don don bdun cur dngos su phye zhing bsdus nas bstan pa'i 'di'i lus kyi tshigs le'ur byas pa yin pas so// tshul de ltar na bco lnga chos can/ yum mam rgyan gyi lus legs par bshad pa yin no// khyod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa dang po gnyis kyis yum mam rgyan 'di'i lus mdor bsdus pa dang lhag ma bcu gsum gyis de'i lus rgyas par bshad pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa ni/ bsdus pa'i don gyi tshig le'ur byas pa de rnams ni 'grel chung 'dir yan lag rgyas bshad kyi thog mar tshig re re nas dngos su ma bkrol to ste de 'dra'i 'grel pa dngos su ma byas so// de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ de 'dra byas na yan lag rgyas bshad kyi 'grel pa dngos su byed pa dang zlos pa'i nyes par 'gyur du dogs nas so// zlos (220) par dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bstan bcos mdzad pa byams pa nyid kyis/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// zhes bya ba dang 'phrin las kyi bar 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos mtha' dag gis/ lus rnam bzhag de dag 'chad pas na 'grel chung 'dir yan lag rgyas bshad de dag rnam par te re re nas phye nas bshad pas 'grel chung 'dir lus rnam bzhag rnams rgyas par bshad par bsams te zhes pa ste de'i rgyu mtshan gyis dogs so zhes slob dpon gyi dgongs pa ste kha 1$0000220 bu ston 1$0000270cig gzhan du 'chad do// //sngar bshad pa de ltar bstan bcos kyi bsdus pa'i don lus rnam bzhag kun bstan zin nas da gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gtan la dbab bya'i yul mkhyen gsum/ phebs nas nyams su len pa'i 'jug pa sbyor ba/ blangs 'bras chos sku'i yan lag rgyas bshad do// dang po la gsum ste/
