chen po nyid gsum dang ldan pas rnam pa gsum du'o// chen po gsum ldan dgos pa ci'i phyir na/ gsum po de nyid kyi dbang du byas te tshul de ltar bsgrub pa la 'jug pas te/ de'i phyir ro// gsum po gang na/ sems can gyi phung po 'khor ba pa'i tshogs te chen po ni dpag tu med pa'o// gcig kyang 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas 'jug pas rgyun chen por 'gyur bas de bcad pa'i don du phung po smros so// ār+ya'o// dang sde chen po ni zhugs gnas kyi gang zag ces ār+ya ste/ de rnams kun gyi mchog sangs rgyas nyid du bya'o// chos bshes dngos zhes yid la byed pa kha rag pa thugs rje chen po zer sems pa chen po nyid dang*/ zhes chos bshes so// sher 'byung ni/ de gzhan don chen po zer ro// chos dbyings kun 'gro ma dmigs par rtogs pa'i sems chen dang*/ nyon mongs bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pas spong ba chen po nyid dang*/ yul dus kyis chod pa dang dngos po phra ba yang shes pas rtogs pa chen po'o// zhes 'grel pa'i thad du ste/ dang po ji lta ba mkhyen pa/ gsum pa ji snyed pa rtogs pa'o// yang rtsa bar/ dang po chos bshes dang don 'dra/ gnyis pa ār+ya dang (510) 'dra/ gsum pa la 'dod chags sogs ma lus pa spangs nas kyang byang chub rtogs par byed pas rtogs chen no zhes de rnams gser ro// dmigs pa dang ched du bya ba'i khyad par ni/ dmigs pa ni de'i tshe nye ba gser ba yin la/ ched du bya ba ni ma 'ongs pa'i tshe bskal pa zer ār+ya ba yin te rgyang ring ba zhes gser mda' ldong sbyor ba dang 'ben la phog pa lta bu zhes ār+ya'o// bdun pa la gnyis te/ sgrub pa spyi'i mtshams sbyar/ so so'i don no// dang po la gnyis te/ sgrub pa'i ngo bo/ bye brag gi sa mtshams so// dang po ni/ sngar bshad de ltar sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa rigs dang sogs pa dmigs pa ched du bya ba rnams brjod zin nas de'i skabs su kha cig na re sngar chos bshes sgrub pa zhes pa'i ming tsam zhig lan du mar byung bas ming can sgrub pa de'i rang gi ngo bo gang ci zhig yin ston cig ce na/ kun chos bshes/

lan ni/ yul gyis dang*/ sbyor ba'i sgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab bya'i yul thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi skabs la ste skabs su ni thos sogs gsum dang shes rab gsum sogs ma phye bar don thob spyir goms pa'i mthu ma thob pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis dkar chos bshes po dge ba'i chos sgo gang yang rung ba nas sogs pa'i rten byed pa can gyi byang se'i bya ba ni yul gyi sgrub sher 'byung pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rnam pa kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang sogs (511) brtse mthar skad rnam pa bzhi la yun ring du 'dris pa'i mthus mngon par rtogs pa bzhi'i skabs re re zhing yang dge ba sgrub pa ji snyed pa phar phyin pa drug gi rten can du bsdus te sgrub nus pa'i sgrub pa ni sbyor sher 'byung ba'i sgrub pa ste de ltar gnyis so// chos bshes kyi dgongs pa'o// go cha'i sgrub pas gnyis ka bstan/ gzhan gsum dang po'o zhes chos bshes te/ gzhan gsum gnyis pa'o byas na cung legs shing spyir nor te ngag las shes la/ 'chad tshul de mdzad nas spyir sgrub bye brag sgrub ces bu bzhed pa'ang nor ro// gser ltar na/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi la sogs par spyir te thams cad la khyab pa'i dge ba'i chos ni chos dbyings te de'i rten can ni yul can no// chos dbyings kun 'gro rtogs pa'i sgrub pa ni yul mkhyen pa gsum gyi sgrub pa'o zhes par mngon no// 'on kyang 'phags seng gi dgongs pa 'dir mngon te/ spyir dkar chos sgo gang rung nas spyod pa'i sgrub pa ni mkhyen gsum gyi dbang du byas pa'i sgrub pa yin gyi nges par phyin drung tshang ba mi dgos te gzhi shes kyi dbang du byas pa'i sgrub pa yongs yod pas so snyam pa'o// sher 'byung*/ spyi dang bye brag gi sgrub pa zhes te/ phyi ma de ltar ram rang kir dang gnyis kyi don sbyor phreng ltar shes dgos so// chos sku la sgrub pa med de 'bras bu yin pas bya ba med do zhes 'grel chen te/

rnam mkhyen la'ang mtshungs te de yin pa'i sgrub pa (512) med do// de sgrub pa ni gnyis ka la yod do// gnyis pa ni/ spyir sgrub pa gnyis yod pa de ltar na sgrub pa bzhi dang lam bzhi rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ go cha'i sgrub la ni sbyor ba'i lam gyi ngo bo nyid/ 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ni mthong ba'i lam/ tshogs sgrub ni sgom pa'i lam/ nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa khyad par gyi lam gyi ngo bo nyid de de nyid yin no// chos bshes kyis/ shas che ba'i dbang du byas zer ro// sher 'byung gser chos te/ thub dgongs su yang*/ 'grel chung gi don der bshad nas shin tu nor zer ro// kha cig de min te 'grel chen dang ma mthun zhe na/ de dang 'di mi 'dra ba mang ste ngag las dris shig 'grel chen ltar na/ sbyor ba la dngos dang brgyud pa dang mngon sum du sbyor ba las/ go cha'i sgrub pa ni mthong lam la brgyud pas sbyor ba tshogs lam gyi ngo bo nyid/ 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ni dngos su sbyor ba sbyor lam dang po gsum dang chos mchog 'bring man gyi ngo bo nyid/ tshogs sgrub dang po bco lnga mngon sum du sbyor ba chos mchog chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ sa rab dga' dang mthong spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub mthong lam gyi ngo bo/ sa dgu dang sgom spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub sgom pa'i lam gyi ngo bo nyid/ nges 'byung sgrub pa sgom pa'i lam gyi khyad par gyi lam gyi ngo bo nyid kyi sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid de rang bzhin no// tshig zin ltar na sa mtshams de bas mi mtho mi dma' zhes pa'o// thogs med kyi gsung 'grel chen dang thub dgongs su drangs pa/ de la go cha dang (513) 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dag ni go rim bzhin du brgyud pa dang dngos su sbyor ba'i rang bzhin tshogs dang mos pas spyod pa'i sas bsdus pa yin no// tshogs kyi sgrub pa ni brtse ba nas brtsams te gzungs kyi bar ni mngon sum du sbyor ba'i rang bzhin chos mchog chen pos bsdus pa yin no// sa dang po rab tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i sgrub pa ni mthong ba'i lam gyi bdag nyid yin la/

gnyis pa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin ni sgom pa'i lam gyi ngo bo nyid yin zhing gnyen po'i phyogs kyi bdag nyid can gyi tshogs kyi sgrub pa ni lam gnyis ka'i spyod yul can yin no// nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa ni sgom pa'i lam la brten pa yin no zhes gsungs so// zhes so// thub dgongs su mthong ba dang sgom pa'i lam gnyis po 'di las phyi ma nas bzung nas sems bskyed pa nyi shu pa'i bar ni nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa ste zhes te sgom lam dgu ni yod par bzhed do// 'grel chung du khyad par gyi lam zhes pas chos bshes ltar mngon no// bzhi pa 'di chos bshes bar chad med rtse dang gcig ces sogs yang yang dang*/ ār+yas/ nges 'byung sgrub pa gsum pa'i thad du 'di ni dmigs su med pa'i rnam pas bsdus pa'i lam ni sems can gyi don du nges par 'byung ba'i rgyu yin no// zhes bstan te/ lam yang byang ba'i sa rnam pa bcus bsdus pa yin no// zhes so// sa bcu car na yod par bshad par mngon cing de ltar bu bzhed pa ni nor bar mngon te/ 'phags pa thogs med dang 'gal bas so//

(514) gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ go 'jug tshogs/ nges so// dang po la gsum las snga 'grel ni/ bzhi po de rnams kyi nang nas dang por go cha'i sgrub pa gsungs pa yin no// rgyu mtshan ni/ sgrub pa byed dus go cha'i brtson 'grus dgos shing de go cha'i brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo yin pa nyid kyis so// re rer drug drug tshang bar sgrub pa la sems kyi sran tshugs pas bar 'di rnams chos bshes du gcod pa'i mda' mtshon gyis mi phigs pas go cha yin la de can don dngos gyi sgrub pa la de'i sgrub pa zhes bar gyi tshig mi mngon pa'o// rtsa ba la gnyis te/ go bgos yul phyin drug gtan la dbab/ go bgos pa'i sgrub pa'i ngo bo bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ grangs dang de yi mtshan nyid go rim dang*/ nges pa'i tshig dang goms bya yon tan dang*/ theg bsdus su goms bya yon tan dang zhes bsgyur ro// de dag rab dbye bsdu dang mi mthun no// yon tan phan tshun rnam nges yin// zhes bya/ 'grel bshad blo brtan mar bshad sbyar na ci yang med yon tan phan tshun rnams nges gcig tu bsdus so// rgya cher de nyid dam lung snyer shes par bya zhing 'dir mangs su dogs pas cung zad bshad na/ drug dang bzhi bshad/ drug gi khyad chos bshad pa'o// dang po mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya'i sgra bshad/ mtshan gzhi'i rab dbye'o// dang po la/ phar phyin spyi'i mtshan nyid/ srid zhi'i pha rol du phyin pa'am phyin byed gang zhig 'khor gsum du mi rtog pa'i blo zhes pa dgu ma 'jug pa ltar ro// bye brag gi (515) ni/ sbyin pa mi mthun phyogs nyams dang*// rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan// 'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed// sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum// theg gsum gyi smin pa zhes dang*/ don rnams gtong bar byed pa dang*// zhes pas sbyin bya ci rigs pa yongs su gtong ba'i chos bzhi ldan te/

'gal zla ser sna nyams pa blo brtan mar bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'i mi rtog ye shes kyis 'grel bshad zin pa gang ci 'dod pa de la sbyin pas 'dod pa rdzogs par byed pa/ sbyin pas bsdus nas skal ba bzhin theg pa gsum gyis sems can smin par byed pa bzhi'o// de bzhin du gzhan la gnod la gzhi dang bcas pa spong ba'i blo chos bzhi ldan/ bzhi'i dang po gnyis sla ste 'og ma rnams su yang ngo*// gsum pa ni sems can rnams 'di snyam du byang se 'dis bdag dang longs spyod chung ma sogs la gnod pa ma byas na ci ma rung snyam pa las de kho na bzhin gnod pa mi byed par de yan blo brtan mar sgo dbyig gsum sdom pas 'dod pa rdzogs par byed pa'o// bzhi pa tshul khrims kyis bsdus nas zhes sogs sngar ltar te 'og ma la yang ngo*// yang na yan lag drug ldan gyi tshul khrims chos bzhi ldan de yan lag drug ces so// drug ni/ tshul khrims dang ldan par gnas pa/ so thar gyi sdom par bsdams pa/ cho ga phun tshogs/ spyod yul phun tshogs/ kha na ma tho ba phra rab tsam la yang 'jigs par lta ba/ bslab pa'i gzhi rnams yang (516) 1$0000220dag par blangs te slob pa'o// 1$0000270mi 'khrugs pa'i blo chos bzhi ldan/ chos gsum pa ni byang se la gzhan gyis gnod pa byas kyang de rjes su 'dis lan du gnod pa ma byas na ci ma rung snyam pa las de bzhin mi byed blo brtan mar par dbyig gnod pa la bzod pas so// dge ba la spro ba'i blo chos bzhi ldan/ gsum pa ni/ sems can gyi las su bya ba gang dang blo gang yod pa'i grogs dbyig byed pas so// sems rtse gcig pa chos bzhi ldan/ gsum pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi mthus rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan nas so// chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo chos bzhi ldan/ gsum pa ni shes rab kyis chos kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid shes par byas nas blo brtan mar sems can gyi the tshom gcod pas so// dbyig bzhi'i mtshan nyid ni/

thabs/ smon lam/ stobs/ ye shes kyi rim bzhin/ phyin drug gi dge blo brtan dbus mthar ba rdzogs byang du bsngos pas mi zad par byed pa'i phar phyin/ tshe rabs du mar sangs rgyas mnyes par byed cing phyin drug la spyod par skye blo ba'i sems kyi smon pa'i phar phyin/ so sor rtog pa dang bsgom pa'i stobs gnyis kyis phyin drug gi mi mthun phyogs kyis zil gyis mi non par rgyun mi chad par sbyin sogs la 'jug pa'i phar phyin/ theg chen gyi chos la sgra ji bzhin du rtog pa'i rmongs pa dang bral bas phyin drug sogs theg chen gyi chos la longs spyod cing des sems can smin par byed pa'i phar phyin/ zhes dbus mtha' (517) 'grel pa 'grel bshad ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/ drug gi rim bzhin skad dod la/ dā na ste/ dā ri tra dbul ba/ nā sha sel ba'am 'joms pa med par byed blo brtan ste/ dbul ba 'dor bas dang*/ shī la/ shī ta bsil ba/ lab+bha thob pa ste/ tshe 'dir yul la chags pas chags sdang sogs kyis kun nas blang ba'i sgo gsum gyi bya ba ngan pa sna tshogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gdung bar mi byed pa 'thob/ tshe gzhan du ngan song du mi gdung zhing lha mi'i bsil ba thob par 'gyur/ mthar myang 'das kyi bde ba'i bsil ba thob par byed pas so blo brtan mar ro// k+ṣān+ti/ k+ṣā ma k+ṣo bha 'khrug pa zhes ral gris 'khrug pa shān+ti zhi ba ste/ khro ba bzod pas dang*/ k+ṣa ni zad pa ti ni byed pa ste khro ba zad byed ces blo brtan mar ro// wīr+ya/ wi ral gri bu wa ra mchog yo ga sbyor ba ste/ dge ba mchog dang sbyor bas dang wi ni dam pa r+ya ni sbyor ba ste/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge rtsa dam pa la sbyor zhes blo brtan mar ro// dhā na dh+ye blo brtan mar dhī yid/ bu dha ra 'dzin nam/ ma na yid de/ yid nang du 'dzin pas dang*/

pra dzñā pa ra mār+tha don dam pa/ dzñā na shes pas te/ dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang*// bsil ba thob dang khro bzod dang*// mchog sbyor ba dang yid 'dzin dang*// don dam shes pa'i phyir bshad do// zhes so// chos gang 'grub/ 'phel/ 'thob/ spong byed du rigs pa ni thabs so// de la mkhas pa ni/ thog tu phebs pa ste/ chos (518) gang 'grub par bya ba dang rnam par 'phel ba dang 'thob par bya ba dang*/ spang bar bya ba'i phyir rigs pa gang yin pa de ni de'i thabs yin no// de la mkhas pa ni thog tu phebs pa ste thabs la mkhas pa'o// spyir rnam pa du mar smon pa yin mod kyis 'dir dge ba dang mthun pa'i skye ba la smon pas smon lam/ shes rab dang dge chos goms par byed pas mi mthun phyogs kyis zil gyis mi non pas stobs/ theg chen gyi chos la sgra ji bzhin gyi rmongs pa dang bral nas ji bzhin shes pas ye shes te/ blo brtan gyi dbus mtha'i 'grel bshad dgongs pa'o// gsum pa ni/ gsum gsum ste/ chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs gtong*// zhes dang*/ brdar btags chos nyid thob pa ste/ dang po so thar gnyis pa la bsam gtan zag med kyi gnyis so// mi mjed ji mi snyam shes dang*// zhes dang*/ de dag la ni de rnam bdun// zhes te/ lus kyi brtson 'grus rngog lnga ste mi blo dge ba spong zhing dge ba sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus gang dbang gnyis ka shes lnga dang mtshungs bshad sbyar ldan du gnas pa lnga ste de ni dbang po'i bshad sbyar dngos/ gcig na med sgo ba sdams te gnas sbyar bas lhag pa'i tshul khrims la gus sbyor rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus so// sems kyi brtson 'grus gnyis te/ blo dngos gcig don/ lhag sems kyi bslab pa la gus sbyor rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus drug (519) pa'o// lhag pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa la gus rtag blo brtan sbyor gyi brtson 'grus de bdun pa'o// bshad sbyar de ltar bslab pa gsum la gus rtag gi sbyor ba'i sgo nas bdun du blo brtan mar te bshad sbyar dang don gcig go

/bod dag nor ba bu sogs ji snyed cig smra'o// bsam gtan la rtog bcas dpyod bcas/ rtog med dpyod tsam/ rtog med dpyod med kyi 'grel bsam gtan gsum mo// shes rab la/ 'jig rten pa'i shes rab/ 'das pa'i shes rab chung ngu nyan rang gi'o// 'das chen byang se'i blo brtan mar 'am theg chen gyi'o// thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab gsum du yang ste rang kir sogs/ theg bsdus ltar na/ spyi'i mtshan nyid dam pa drug ldan gyi shes pa'o// drug ni byang chub thub dgongs su 'di ltar bsdus te kyi sems la brten thub dgongs su pas gnas dam pa/ phyi nang bshad sbyar gi dngos po mtha' dag gtong sbyar bas dngos po dam pa/ sems can thams cad la phan bde'i ched du spyod pas ched du bya ba dam pa/ 'khor bshad sbyar gsum mi rtog pa'i rang nyid ye shes kyi rang sbyar gnyis zin pas thabs la mkhas pa dam pa/ rdzogs byang du bsngos pas yongs su bsngo ba dam pa/ sgrib gnyis dag par 'grub pas dngos rnam par dag pa dam pa'o// don bsdu'o// re re yang drug ces bshad sbyar (520) te so sor bkod na/ yongs su gtong ba dam pa drug ldan zhes sogs dgod do// nges rang nyid tshig ni/ 'jig rten pa dang nyan rang gi sbyin sogs dge ba thams cad las phul du byung bar pha rol tu 'gro bas phar phyin dngos rnams so// ser re re'i sgra bshad ni ji bzhin sna dang dbul ba 'joms pa dang longs spyod chen po dang bsod nams kyi tshogs thob par byed pas sbyin pa'o// 'chal pa'i tshul khrims dang ngan 'gro zhi bar byed pa dang bde 'gro dang ting nge 'dzin thob par byed pas tshul khrims so// khro ba dang 'khon pa zad par byed pa dang bdag dang gzhan dag la bde bar byed pas bzod pa'o// le lo dang sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams dang 'bral bar byed pa dang dge ba'i chos tshad med pa rnam par spel bar byed pas brtson 'grus so// rnam par g.yeng ba sel ba dang nang du sems gnas pa sgrub par byed pas bsam gtan no// lta bar gyur pa dang 'chal ba'i shes rab thams cad sel ba dang yang dag par rnam pa thams cad du chos rnams rab tu shes pas shes rab bo// zhes so// ji bzhin no// gsum gsum du blta bar bya ste// zhes nas/

dang po 'dra/ sdom pa'i dge ba'i chos sdud sems can don byed kyi dang dgongs 'grel gsum pa 'dra dgongs 'grel go cha'i re re sbyar sbyor ba'i sems can gyi don bya ba'i brtson 'grus gsum du dgongs 'grel du bshad/ mi zhum zhing mi mngon 'grel 'khrugs la (521) chog par mi 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ mthong chos la bde bar mdo gnas theg bsdus pa'i/ mngon sogs yon tan mdo mngon par theg bsdus sgrub pa'i sems mdo can gyi bya ba bsdus bsgrub pa'i bsam gtan no// mdo dang gnyis rnam par mi rtog par sbyor ba'i/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i rjes la thob pa'i shes rab bo// dgongs 'grel du/ kun rdzob shes pa/ don dam shes pa/ sems can gyi don la dmigs pa gsum du bshad do// gnyis pa la grangs nges ni/ dang po gsum gyis longs spyod/ bde 'gro'i lus/ skye bo thams cad dbang du gyur pa thob pas mngon mtho'i lam dang*/ phyi ma gsum gyis dge ba la sbyor ba'i/ sems can smin pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos sgrub pa'i thabs gsum gyis nges legs kyi lam ste drug tu nges shing mi mang mi nyung zhes kun btus 'grel lo// go rim ni/ snga ma la brten phyi ma skye// dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang*// rag pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir// de dag rim par bstan pa yin// zhes so// 'bras bu ni bral 'bras rang rang gi spang bya spang ba/ rgyu mthun khyad par can phyi ma bdag 'bras byang chen/ mthong chos la bdag gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa skyes bu byed 'bras/ rnam smin ni dang po gsum gyi ni rim bzhin/ lus dang longs spyod phun tshogs dang*// bde 'gro gnas pa sbyin byed dang*// phan yon lngar 'khon med pa/ dbye na med pa/ bde (522) 1$0000220ba dang yid bde ba mang ba/

'gyod pa med par 'chi ba/ shi nas bde 'gror skye ba lnga'o// 1$0000270ni yang ngag bshad// phyi ma gsum gyi rnam smin sems can dbang du 'gyur ba/ lus la gnod pa med pa/ dbang che bar grags pa gsum rim bzhin no// kun btus 'grel pa rgyal sras so// bran sogs yon tan 'phel byed dang*// bde ba skye bar byed pa dang*/ byed 'bras// kun nas nyon mongs shin du grol/ bral 'bras// zhes pa'i don bshad do// bcu po'i byed las ni/ dbus mthar/ las ni rjes su 'dzin byed dang*// gnod mi byed dang de la bzod// yon tan 'phel dang bsam gtan gyi mthus rdzu 'phrul bstan nas bstan pa 'di la dzud nus dang*// rnam par grol bar byed pa dang*/ phyi ma bzhi sngar gyi mtshan nyid kyis shes/ */mi zad pa dang rtag 'jug dang*// nges par rgyun mi chad par phyin drug la 'jug pa'o// longs spyod smin par byed/ sngar bshad mtshan nyid// ces so// phan tshu bsdu ba ni/ tshul khrims bzod phar gnyis mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pas bsdus te/ gzhan la gnod pa mi byed pa dang gzhan gyis byas pa la bzod pas pha rol tu gdung bar mi byed pas so// brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab phar chos sbyin gyis bsdus te mi skyo bar bsam gtan rnams bskyed nas pha rol gyi bsam pa shes te shes rab kyis ji bzhin rtogs nas ston pas so// zhes thub dgongs don no// dge ba chos sdud kyis lnga po thams cad bsdus te/ rgyu mtshan sla'o// sbyin phar ni zang zing gi sbyin pa/ gzhan lnga mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa'o// thams cad chos kyi sbyin pa ste gzhan (523) gyi sems rgyud la bskyed pas so// zhes dang*/ tshul phar ni sbyin phar yin la/ sbyin phar yin la tshul phar min pa yod de/ tshul phar gyis ma zin pa'i sbyin phar ro// phyi ma 'di 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar ro// zhes dang dpyad dgos sbyin pa yin la sbyin phar min pa byang chen du ma bsngos pa'i sbyin pa'o// gnyis yin bsngos pa'o// gnyis min de gnyis ma gtogs pa'o// shes rab kyi bar la gsum mo// zhes pa rnams kun btus 'grel par ro// theg bsdus su/

sbyin pa yang yin la pha rol phyin pa min pa'ang yod ces mu bzhi'o zhes pa tsam gsungs pa la/ bshad sbyar du/ dang po dam pa drug bral gyi sbyin pa/ gnyis pa drug ldan gyi tshul khrims sogs/ gsum pa drug ldan gyi sbyin pa/ gnyis min ni drug bral gyi tshul khrims sogs so gzhan la sbyar ro// 'dir sbyin pa dang phar phyin zhes sogs sbyar gyi sbyin pa'i phar phyin sogs ma sbyar ro// gnyis pa ni/ go cha'i sgrub pa gang yin pa de bshad do zhes drang ngo*// gang gis na/ drug tshan drug gis so// der tshul gang gi sgo nas 'gyur na/ drug po de dag so sor te re re la yang sbyin pa la sogs pa rnams drug drug tu bsdus shing tshang ba'i sgo nas der 'gyur ro// ji ltar na/ mdo las ji ltar dag ldan dngos gsungs pa bzhin du'o/ dngos// so drug ji lta ba bzhin du bshad par shes par bya'o zhes gser ro// sbyin pa gang yongs su gtong ba de dag nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi yid byed

(524) kyis min gyi rnam mkhyen dang ldan pa'i yid byed kyis gtong zhing rdzogs byang du bsngo ba/ zhes sogs rgya cher te mdo nyid blta'o// 'grel pa la gnyis te/ drug tshan drug tu dbye ba/ drug tu bsdus te bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ go cha drug tshan drug dang phar phyin drug phan drug ste/ chos kyi sbyin pa dang zang zing gi sbyin pa sogs sbyin par byed pa na sbyin pa de nyid sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te rdzogs byang du bsngo bar go bgos pa sbyin che chung gnyis phar gyi go cha/ de ltar bsngos pa sbyin pa'i sbyin pa/ de nyid kyi tshe bdag gcig pu dul gser bar bya'o zhes sogs nyan thos kyi yid byed spong bar go 'joms gnyis ār+ya bgos pa sbyin pa'i tshul khrims kyi go cha/ spong ba'i blo nyid sbyin tshul lo// de nyid kyi tshe skye bo thams cad kyis gshe ba la sogs pa'i mi snyan par smra ba bzod par go bgos pa sbyin pa'i bzod pa'i go cha bzod pa dngos sbyin bzod/ 'khor gsum ma dmigs par yid la byed pa'i chos zab mo la bzod pa ni bzod pa'i go cha'o zhes gnod 'joms gnyis so// rnam mkhyen gyi chos la bzod cing 'dod pa'i ni bzod pa'i go cha zhes ār+ya'o// de nyid kyi tshe dge gser ba la 'dun pa'am mngon gser par 'dod pa bskyed par go bgos pa ni sbyin pa'i brtson 'grus kyi go cha/ de bskyed pa sbyin brtson/ yang de nyid kyi tshe dngos sbyin pa byed pa la snyoms las med pa dang mi skyo zhing brtson 'grus nyams par mi byed pa de'o zhes 'bum ṭīka ko /1$0000220ār+yas dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngos la der bshad gnod 'joms che bar 1$0000270 (525) 1$0000220rdzogs byang du bsngos pas sbyin pa las brtson 'grus 'phel ba ni brtson 'grus kyi go cha'o zhes so// 1$0000270de nyid kyi tshe theg pa gzhan dman pa dang ma 'dres pa'i sems rtse gcig par go bgos pa sbyin pa'i bsam gtan gyi go cha/

rtse gcig pa dngos sbyin pa'i bsam gtan no// rdzogs byang du bsngo ba der ār+ya ltar na brtson 'grus dang 'di la khyad mi snang ngo*// dang 'grel chen no// de nyid kyi tshe sgyu ma lta bu'i 'du shes nye bar gnas pas sbyin par 1$0000220gnod 'joms gnyis 1$0000270bya ba dang sbyin po len po mi dmigs par go bgos pa sbyin pa'i shes rab kyi go cha/ mi dmigs pa'i blo sbyin pa'i shes rab bo// phyi ma 'di ār+ya'o// gzhan lnga la yang go rim bzhin du tshul khrims bsrung bya bsrung byed ma dmigs pa la sogs par sbyar te snga ma de bzhin du tshul khrims bsrung bar byed pa drug tshan gnyis pa/ bzod pa rdzogs par byed pa gsum pa/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa bzhi pa/ bsam gtan sgrub pa lnga pa/ shes rab sgom par byed pa drug pa'o// yang na gzhung tshig ji bzhin sbyar te chos sbyin lta bu'i phar phyin kho rang sbyin phar yin mod/ de la gzhan lnga tshang bar bshad nas sbyin bya sogs ma dmigs pa'i go cha nyid kyis sngar bshad de ltar byed pa ni sbyin pa'i go cha zhes sogs gzhan la yang zhes gser gling pa ste 'grel pa 'di'i don de yin no// mdo nyid gsal lo// gnyis pa ni/ sngar bshad de ltar sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin pa drug po de sbyin pa la sogs (526) pa so sor te re res kyang bsdus pa drug tshan drug gis rnam pa sum cu rtsa drug tu 'gyur ba yin no// 'o na go sgrub so drug tu 'gyur ro zhe na/ de lta mod kyi go cha'i sgrub pa rnam pa drug tu bsdus so// rgyu mtshan ni chos bshes sbyin pa'i drug sbyin pa'i rgyu las byung zhing de'i nyams len pas phye bas sbyin par chos mthun/ sogs pas tshul khrims kyi drug tshul khrims su chos mthun pa sogs kyi phyir na'o// bsdus pa'i dgos pa ni rgyas par bstan pa rnams bsdus na go sla bas so// dper na/

mdo'i le'u mang po rnams 'phags pa rnam grol sdes le'u brgyad du gdags pa mdzad pa lta bu'o// zhes chos bshes so// le'u brgyad ma 'phags pas byas par bzhed do// yang na drug po de'i sbyin pa drug sbyin par mthun zhes kyang de'i lugs gcig tu mngon no// bam po gnyis pa 'chad de/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ tshul de ltar rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas phyin drug mtshan mar mi dmigs par bsgrub par go bgos pa la theg chen la 'jug pa 'byung bas sgrub pa gnyis 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ston no// chos bshes ni/ chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa thob nas bsgrub ces pa ste de yan du 'dun pa tsam gyis spyod pa ste zhes mthong lam la sbyor ro// rtsa ba la/ 'jug yul theg chen/ de la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa gnyis so// dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ rdzogs byang mthar phyin pa'am/ der bgrod pa'i thabs khyad par can no// de la gnyis las/ rgyu'i theg chen (527) gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rang gang gis bzhon par gyur pa'i skyes bu da phyis rdzogs byang du bgrod par byed pa'i thabs khyad par can 'bras bu'i theg chen gyi mtshan nyid/ bgrod bya mthar thug pa'o// sgra bshad ni/ dmigs pa rgya chen po nyid dang ni// de bzhin rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa chen po gnyis dag dang*/ bdag med gnyis ka rtogs pa'i */ye shes chen po dang*/ grangs med gsum du gus sbyor rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*/ chen po 'khor bar gnas kyang nyon mongs kyis yan lag bcu gnyis sogs mi gos pa'i */thabs la mkhas par gyur pa chen po dang*// yang stobs dang mi 'jigs sogs dag 'grub pa chen po dang*/ byang chub pa dang myang 'das ston pa sogs/ */sangs rgyas 'phrin las chen po ste// chen po 'di rnams dang ldan pas// theg chen zhes ni mngon par brjod// zhes pa ltar chen po bdun dang ldan pas 'di theg chen gyi mtshan nyid du bzhag pa cung mi legs so// no// mtshan gzhi ni/

de bdun yang de yin zhing*/ thub dgongs su/ sems bskyed nyer gnyis kho na theg chen no// zhes sogs te/ theg chen gyi sa bcu lam lnga sogs mtha' yas so// gnyis pa ni/ 'jug pa'i bsgrub pa shes par bya'o zhes drang ngo*// gang du na/ theg chen la dang por 'jug cing phyis gong nas gong du khyad par rtogs pas 'jog pa yin par ro// 'grel chen no// ār+ya ni/ don gcig gsung ngo*// 'gro ba'i rtsom pa 'jug pa de nyid theg chen gyi lam (528) la 'jog pa'o// zhes dag ldan te zla zer yang ngo*// dbye na du zhe na/ bsam gtan gzugs med nas/ rnam kun mkhyen pa'i tshul la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa zhes dgu'o// 'grel pa la/ dang po rang gi rnam rtags mtshan ma rnams kyis bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis yang dag par gnas pa'i mtshan nyid kyi 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ste/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog cing ldang zhes sogs rgyas par ro// rnam pa ni 'dod pas dben dngos sogs 'og sa'i skyon spangs pa/ rtags ni/ rtog dpyod sogs gnyen po'i yan lag gi cha/ mtshan ma ni/ dga' bde sogs phan yon/ yang na sa gong 'og gi dbye bas zhi rags sogs rnam pa'o// sa gang la tshor ba gang yod rtags so// snyoms 'jug gi bde ba'i ro myong ba ni mtshan ma'o// zhes ār+ya'o// 'dir mtha' dpyad na/ ngo bo/ yan lag snyoms par 'jug pa/ nyon mongs/ rnam byang*/ tshad dang drug go /dang po la/ mdzod du/ bsam gtan dag ni rnam gnyis bzhi// zhes snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan nam rgyu'i bsam gtan/ skye ba'am 'bras bu'i bsam gtan gnyis yin la/ gnyis po de la dang po nas bzhi pa'i bar bzhi bzhi'o// de'i gnyis pa ni/ mdzod du/ der so so yi// bsam gtan sa ni gsum pa yin// bzhi pa sa ni brgyad pa yin// zhes so// gnyis kyi dang po bshad na bzhi las/

dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ snyoms 'jug gi (529) bsam gtan gang zhig rtog pa'am dpyod pa'i sa pa yin pa'o// de yang nyon mongs can rnams kyang bsam gtan yin pa'i dbang du byas pa'o// yang na/ gang zhig rtog dpyod gang rung can no// nyon mongs can ni snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan dngos min te/ dga' bde sogs yan lag med pas so// 'on kyang log par rtse gcig pa tsam yod pas sgra don thob pas der brjod de/ sa bon rul ba bzhin/ zhes 'grel bshad du'o// yang na rgyu snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan dang*/ snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan gnyis su 'byed dgos par mngon te/ dang po'i khyad par can la zag med dag pa ro myang can gsum yod par rtsa bar bshad do// ro myang can rgyu nyon mongs 'jug gi bsam gtan min te/ dge ba min pa'i phyir/ mdzod las/ snyoms 'jug dge ba rtse gcig pa// zhes dang*/ ro myang can sogs gcod pa la dge ba zhes smros zhes pa'i phyir dang*/ de ni snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan nyams byed yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan du skye mi nus te der skye ba la dag pa ba dgos so// de yang nyon mongs pa'i 'dod pa 'dod khams kyi chags sogs dang mtshungs par ldan pa las dben/ dngos po'i 'dod pa la yul lnga don du gnyer nas dmigs pa las dben/ nyon mongs pa'i 'dod pa'i rgyu can sgo gsum gyi nyes spyod mtshon gyi 'debs sogs mi dge ba mtha' dag gis dben pa/ rtog dpyod la skyon (530) du ma mthong bas de yan gnod 'joms che ba blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo 'grel sogs 'dod pa ni rags dang po ni zhi'o zhes sems pa'am kun btus 'jug 'grel shes rab la brten nas ngo bo tsam kun tu tshol ba rtog pa sems pa'am shes rab la brten nas 'dod pa ni tshe thung nyon mongs mang ba sogs kyis rags/ dang po de las bzlog pas zhi'o snyam du khyad par zhib mo 'byed pa dpyod pa kun btus mdo ste 'dod pa'i 'di yan gnod 'joms gnyen po rtog dpyod dang bcas pa 'dod pa'am sgrib pa las dben pa las skyes pa'i phyir dben pa las skyes pa/

'dod pa'i don rnyed pa dang 'dod pa'i nyon mongs can gyi gnas ngan len thams cad dang bral bas lus sems shin tu sbyangs te las su rung ba'i dga' bde dang ldan pa'o// bsam gtan dang po bsgrubs te gnas so zhes pa de rdzogs par byas te gnas zhes 'bum ṭīka nye bar bsgrubs te ni snyoms par zhugs pa'o// gnas pa ni rang gi rjes su myong ba'o// dag ldan no// yan lag de bzhi yang bsam gtan dang po'i yan lag tshang bar bgrangs kyi dang po gang yin la tshang mi dgos so// rtog dpyod sems 'khrug byed kyi skyon du mthong bas de las sems gnod 'joms thub dgongs bzlog ste rtog dpyod med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan ma la sems nye bar 'dogs gnod shing g.yeng bar spyod pa'i dmigs pa dang bral nas rtse gnod 'joms che ba blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo 'grel gcig tu dpyod sbyong dpyod pa'i dmigs pa la dang gcig pas zhi ba dang rab tu dang ba'i sems su (531) 'jog pas na rab tu dang ba/ rtog dpyod rgyun mi chad par rgyud la 'jug pa dag med par rgyud gcig pa'am rtog dpyod kyis glags sam bar chad rma med pa zhes 'jug bshad do// med par rgyud gcig tu gyur pa'o// mtshan nyid ni/ snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan gang zhig nang yongs su dang ba dang dga' ba'i sa pa'am de gnyis kyi yan lag can zhes pa'o// gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ rgyu snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan gang zhig dga' ba la 'dod chags dang bral zhing bde ba'i sa pa'am bde ba'i yan lag can no// dga' ba yang rags thub dgongs 'jug pa'i 'grel ba pa nyid kyis btang snyoms su byed pa'i phyir dang*/ dran pa dang shes bzhin can te dga' ba'i skabs mi 'byed pa'i don du dran pa nye bar gnas shing skyes pa rnams kyang nam yang dang du mi blang ba'i phyir du shes rab blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo 'grel dang gnod 'joms lan mang du byed pa dang*/

gzugs kyi lus dang yid kyi lus kyis tshor ba'i bde ba dang shin tu sbyangs ba'i bde ba myong bar byed pa'o// bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ rgyu snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan gang zhig skyon brgyad las grol zhing tshor ba btang snyoms can no// bde sdug yid bde mi bde dang bral nas tshor ba btang snyoms dang ldan pa/ skyon bde sdug yid bde mi bde dbugs 'byung rngub rtog dpyod brgyad do// brgyad las grol 'jug bshad bas dran pa dang (532) btang snyoms yongs su dag pa can gyi rtse gcig pa'o// gzugs med bzhi la'ang*/ rgyu snyoms 'jug gi dang*/ 'bras bu skye ba'i gzugs med bzhi bzhi brgyad do// skye ba'i gzugs med ni nam mkha' mtha' yas sogs lha'i skye ba bzhi'o// dang po la/ rgyu nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ rgyu gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig gzugs kyi 'du shes bshig ste nam mkha' gnod 'joms sogs mtha' yas so zhes dmigs shing mos pa gnod 'joms sogs de yang thams cad la nam mkha'i 'du shes shin tu bsgoms dag thub pas sngo ser sogs kha dog gyed dang rwa ba rtsig pa sogs sgrib pa/ khang bzang dang skyed mos tshal nyi zla sogs sna tshogs kyi 'du shes dang kun bral te de rnams snang ba med par nam mkha' mtha' 'jug bshad yas pa pa nyid dmigs par 'jug byed pa'o// de yang nyer bsdogs kyi tshe/ 'og sa dang nam mkha' la dmigs pa'am dngos gzhi ma thob kyi bar nam mkha' kho na la dmigs/ thob nas rang sa'i phung po dang nam mkha' la dmigs par mngon no// rgyu rnam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig nam mkha'i 'du shes ldog ste rnam shes mtha' yas so zhes dmigs shing mos pa/ rgyu ci yang gi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rnam shes mtha' yas snyoms 'jug las gong du bskyod pas gzugs gzugs med kyi dmigs pa ci yang med do zhes dmigs shing mos pa

(533) rgyu 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig ci yang yod med kyi 'du shes bzlog cing 'du shes phra mo ma spangs pa can no// gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan dang po yan lag lnga ste/ rtog dpyod gnyis ni/ dang po'i mi mthun phyogs bsdu bar 'dod pa'i 'dod chags gnod sems 'tshe ba'i rtog pa sdug bsngal yid mi bsdu bar bde sogs spong bas gnyen po'i yan lag dga' bde gnyis phan yon gyi yan lag rtse gcig pa gnas kyi yan lag ste/ de la brten nas rtog dpyod sogs gnyen po 'jug cing phan yon blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo 'grel 'byung bas so// gnyis pa yan lag bzhi ste/ nang yongs su dang ba rtog dpyod spong bas gnyen po'i/ dga' bde phan yon/ rtse gcig pa gnas so// gsum pa lnga ste/ dran shes bzhin btang snyoms gsum dga' ba spong bas gnyen po'i yan lag bde ba phan yon/ rtse gcig gnas so// bzhi pa bzhi ste/ dran pa dang btang snyoms g.yo ba'i skyon brgyad yongs su dag pa bde ba spong bas gnyen po'i/ tshor ba btang snyoms phan yon/ rtse gcig pa gnas so// kun btus 'grel ba rgyal po'i sras so// shān+tis kyang ngo*// 'dir gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i gnyen po'i yan lag btang snyoms ni/ sems byung 'du byed kyi btang snyoms yin la/ spyir btang snyoms la/ 'du byed/ tshor ba/ tshad med kyi gsum yod do// bsdu bar/ bsam gtan dang po la dran

(534) shes bzhin btang snyoms gsum yod kyang rtog dpyod kyis bsgribs pas ma smros so// gnyis pa la'ang yod kyang dga' ba'i nyon mongs pas kun nas dkris pas ma smros par nang yongs su dang ba'i ming gis bstan/ gsum par rtog dpyod dga' ba de dag dang bral bas rang ming gis smros so// zhes so// gzugs med rnams yan lag mi 'dra bas 'da' ba min te/ thams cad yan lag btang snyoms dang rtse gcig par 'dra bas so// 'on kyang dmigs pa las yang dag par 'da' ba yin la zhi rags kyi khyad yod de/ ras yug chu zheng mnyam yang sbom phra'i khyad yod pa bzhin no// zhes ār+ya'o// kun btus dang thub dgongs su gzugs med la yan lag med par bshad do// gsum pa ni/ bsam gtan dang po la yid la byed pa bdun gyis snyoms par 'jug ste/ mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa/ mos pa las byung ba/ rab tu dben pa dga' ba sdud pa/ dpyod pa/ sbyor ba'i mtha'/ sbyor ba'i mtha'i 'bras bu yid la byed pa'o// dang po ni/ mnyam bzhag gi sa pa'i yid la byed pas 'dod khams 'di nyon mongs dang sdug bsngal shas che zhing mang pas rags/ bsam gtan dang po sras de dag med pas zhi ba'i mtshan nyid du thos sras bsam gyis rig pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de nas thos bsam las 'das nas gcig tu bsgom pa'i rnam pas de 'dra'i zhi rags kyi mtshan ma la dmigs pa'i zhi lhag bsgom zhing rtog dpyod kyis zhi rags su mos pa'o// gsum pa ni/ de goms sras pas 'dod pa'i sgom spang sras gi nyon (535) mongs chen po gsum spong ba'i lam mo// bzhi pa ni/ de'i 'og tu spong ba la dga' bas 'dod pa'i nyon mongs 'og tu dngos 'bring spangs te dben pa'i dga' bde chung ngus reg nas dus dus su dad pas rmugs pa dang gnyid dang rgod pa dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir rab tu dga' bar byed pa'o// lnga pa ni/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs spangs ma spangs shes pa'i ched du sdug pa'i mtshan ma yid la byed pa la sogs pas nyon rmu mongs skye mi skye so sor rtog pa'o// drug pa ni/

de nas 'dod pa'i nyon mongs chung ngu gsum spang ba'i phyir dang po'i dngos gzhi la thug gi bar du gnyen po yid la byed pa ste/ drug po de bsam gtan gzugs med la mnyam par bzhag pa'i phyir snga nas goms pa'i sems kyi ming ste/ nyer bsdogs so// de la brten nas khams gsum gyi nyon mongs spong mi nus pa med pas mi lcogs pa med do zhes sgra sbyor bam gnyis las so// bdun pa ni/ dang po'i dngos gzhi'o// de bzhin du 'og ma rnams sdug bsngal che zhing tshe thung gong ma rnams de las bzlog pas rags pa dang zhi bar rig nas rim pa bzhin spang bar dang thob par bya ba'i phyir du sems 'jog pa dang po mtshan nyid rigs pa de'i yang dag par sbyor ba rtsom pa gnyis pa/ 'og sa'i nyon mongs chen po spong ba gsum pa/ 'bring spong ba bzhi pa/ thob par mngon par nga rgyal med pa la sems 'jog pa lnga pa/ chung ngu spong ba drug pa/ dngos gzhi (536) myong ba bdun pa ste/ des srid rtse'i bar du snyoms par 'jug go / kun 'grel pa rgyal po'i sras so// bzhi pa ni/ sred pa lta ba nga rgyal ma rig pa bzhis nyon mongs pa can du gyur pas bsgribs la lung du ma bstan par 'gyur ro// lnga pa ni/ dag pa'i bsam gtan gzugs med sras 'jig rten pa rnams kyang dge ba'i phyir/ kun nas dkris sras pa'i dri ma dang bral bas rnam byang zhes bya la/ rab kyi mtha'i ni mdzod du bzhi par bshad/ cha las byung ba'i bsam gtan gzugs med ni/ mngon shes sogs/ yon tan khyad par can mngon par bsgrub pa'i phyir ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du thob pa la sogs pas las su rung bar snang dpyad ba'i mchog tu phyin par khrid pa'i phyir ro// drug pa ni/ yid byed de dag chung 'bring chen por bsgoms pas bsam gtan bzhi'i skye ba gsum gsum 'grub bo// gzugs med na gzhal med khang gi gnas gzhan med pas skye ba'i bye brag med kyang chung ngu la sogs par bsgoms pas tshe ring thung gi mtho dman dang nyon mongs nyung mang gis bzang ngan gyi khyad yod do zhes kun btus 'grel bcas so// de nas tshogs gnyis la slob pa'i phyir 'khor gsum dag pa'i sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug la'o// sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa rab tu spang bar bya ba'i phyir chos ston pa 'di ni sems pa chen po'i sbyin pa'i phar phyin no// zhes sogs so// mthong ba dang sgom pa dang*/

mi slob pa dang khyad par gyi lam la'o// mi slob lam (537) 1$0000220la 'jug sgrub med ces zla zer te mi slob lam yin pa'i de med pa la dgongs shing mi slob lam la 'jug par bshad pas skyon med do// 1$0000270theg pa chen po ni rnam pa thams cad du zhes pa mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsgom pa'i dbang du byas pa'o// ār+ya byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun bsgom pa dang*/ zhes sogs so// de nas gzhan don byed pa'i byams sogs tshad med bzhi la'o// byams pa dang ni yon tan no// lhag pa yon tan no// bsam pas che bas yangs pa/ 'phel bas rgya chen/ dmigs pas sems can tshad med pa la dmigs pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa dang byams pa'i rnam par gcig pas mi gnyis pa/ rnam 'tshe'i gnyen por gyur pas nang gi chos las gyur pa'i gnod pa med pas 'khon med pa/ phyi'i sems can gyis byas pa'i gnod pa med pas 'gran zla med pa/ phyi rol 'du byed las gyur pa'i gnod pa med pas gnod pa med pa ste 'dod chags dang*/ dug dang me sogs kyi gnod pa med pas so// zhes che bar ro// 'bum ṭīka dang dag ldan sogs las rgya cher shes par bya'o// ldan pa'i sems ni yon tan can yin la yon tan ni 'dod pa na spyod pa'i bde ba sgrub pas yangs pa bsam gtan dang po gnyis kyi dga' ba sgrub pas rgya chen por gyur pa gsum pa'i bde ba bsgrubs pas mi gnyis pa 'bras bu bde sogs tshad med pa sgrub pa ste sngar bshad gsum po bsdus pa'o// rnam 'tshe med pas 'khon gcugs med pa zhes mdor/ med pa/ zhes pa gnyen po las bstan nas/ gnyid rmugs med pas 'gran zla med pa rgod 'gyod med pas sgrib pa med pa ni rnam par dag pa (538) 1$0000220las bstan nas 'bras bu/ 1$0000270gnod pa med pa can no de rnams sems can la dmigs pa'i yon tan no// khams gsum gyi so skye dang slob pa thams cad du song ba ste dmigs pa shin tu bsgoms pa 'i ni bsgoms par byas pa'o// de gnyis chos la dmigs pa'o// 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa ni chos kyi bdag med gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can la dmigs pa nyid do// mtha' ma chad pas nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa thams cad dang ldan pa ni dmigs med do zhes ār+ya zhes sogs snying sogs rgya cher ro// 'di la rgyu/

ngo bo/ 'bras bu'o// rgyu ni/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal dang de rgyu btang snyoms las// byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje ste// rgyu rigs dang bdag rkyen bshes gnyen de ma thag rkyen rig pa snga ma'o// rang bzhin las// byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje'o// zhes pa snying rje'i dmigs rkyen no// gzhan ni dbye ba'i skabs las shes so// ngo bo la mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya/ mtshan gzhi'o// dang po ni/ brtan pa'i tshangs pa'i mi mthun spangs// rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan// dmigs pa rnam pa gsum la 'jug /sems can rnams ni yongs smin byed// ces/ gnod sems sogs mi mthun phyogs spangs pa/ gnyen po mi rtog ye shes dang ldan pa/ dmigs pa sems can dang chos dang dmigs pa med pa la 'jug pa/ byed las sems can smin par byed pa ni theg chen gyi tshad med spyi'i mtshan nyid do// bye brag tu theg chen gyi byams pa tshad (539) med pa sogs bzhi'i rim bzhin du/ rang gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas sems can tshad med pa bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab mtshungs ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa/ bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa/ chags sdang gi nyon mongs pa med par 'dod pa'o// sems can rnams la brtse ba can// zhes sogs ltar ro// dag zla thub gsum dang mdo rgyan bshad sbyar du btang snyoms ni sems can rnams rjes chags khong khro med par smon pa la bshad/ kun btus dngos/ gzhan du rang nyid sems can la nye ring chags sdang med par snyoms pa la bshad do// kun btus su sems can rnams la phan par bsam pa'i gnas pa zhes so// bshes spring 'grel pas/ rigs par lta bas na btang snyoms te phyogs su ma lhung bar lta zhes bya ba'i don zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ lha tshangs par skye ba'i rgyu yin pas tshangs pa'i gnas/ gnod 'joms gnyis su/

sems can tshad med pa la dmigs bsod nams dang ye shes tshogs tshad 'bum ṭīka med pa'i rgyur gyur stobs 'bum ṭīka bcu sogs sangs rgyas kyi 'bum ṭīka chos tshad gnyis ka med pa thob pa'i rgyur gyur pa dang*/ ye shes tshad 'bum ṭīka med pa'i spyod yul du gyur pa'i phyir tshad med ces byas so// zhes so// gsum pa la/ spyi dang*/ bye brag gi dbye ba gnyis so// dang po la/ lta ba/ sa mtshams/ dmigs pa/ bsam (540) pa'i sgo nas dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi sems can la/ gzung 'dzin gnyis bden gyi sems can la/ sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can la dmigs pa/ sems can/ chos/ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i byams sogs gsum du slob dpon rab tu 'gying ba'i rdo rjes bshad do// dang po mu stegs pa'i/ gnyis pa nyan thos pa'i/ gsum pa theg chen pa'i 'o// gnyis pa ni/ blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo'i/ las/ thog ma sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byams pa ni sems can la dmigs pa'o// spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byams pa ni chos la dmigs pa'o// mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob pa'i byang sems rnams kyi byams pa ni dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa'o// zhes so// don gnod 'joms gnyis sogs su mos spyod kyi sa la sems can la dmigs pa/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar la chos de bzhin gnyis ka nyid la dmigs pa/ sa brgyad pa yan ni dmigs med do zhes so// so skye'i sems can la/ nyan rang 'phags pa'i chos la/ theg chen 'phags pa'i dmigs med du chos mchog tu bshad do// gsum pa ni/ sems can bde ba 'dod pa sdug bsngal bde bar gnas pa la dmigs pa sems can la dmigs pa/ tshad med bstan pa'i chos la dmigs pa/ bdag gnyis su mi rtog pas de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa dmigs med kyir bshad do// ār+yas/

bar pa ni sems can du gdags gzhi so skye dang slob pa'i chos ji (541) snyed pa la dmigs par bshad do// bzhi pa ni/ kye ma dag zla sems can bde ba dang ldan na re dga' ldan par gyur gcig ldan par bya'o snyam pa'i sogs yi rang smon lam go cha'i ngo bo gsum gsum mo// kye ma sems can bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung*/ sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung*/ bde ba dang mi 'bral na ci ma rung*/ nyon mongs pa las grol na ci ma rung zhes zla zer te dag ldan yang ngo*// gnyis pa la/ bzhi car gyi dbye ba/ bye brag snying rje'i dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ gnod 'joms che bar/ byams pa gsum ste/ mos spyod du sems can la/ sa bdun pa'i bar de bzhin nyid la/ brgyad pa yan dmigs med la'o// snying rje gsum sems can sdug bsngal can/ nyes spyod mang ba/ rkyen mi ldan pas rnam par ma grol ba'i sems can la dmigs so// dga' ba gsum/ bde ba'i sems can/ bdag gi tshogs rdzogs pa/ dam pa'i chos kyi ro myang ba la phyi ma gnyis go bzlog gam dpyad dmigs pa'o// btang snyoms gsum ni/ sems can gyi don dpyad pa la skal ba yod med la/ rnyed ma rnyed sogs 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad sogs la mnyam pa nyid du tshogs rdzogs par bya ba la dus dang dus ma yin pa la dmigs pa'o// zhes so// phyi ma gnyis lung snyer nor ro// gnyis pa ni drug ni mi mthun phyogs can drug la brtsi ste/ bkren la brtse dang ma rungs ba la brtse// kun 'khrugs la brtse bag med rnams la brtse// yul gyi gzhan dbang can la snying rje dang*// log par mngon par zhen la snying (542) rje'o// zhes drug ste/ rab tu 'bar ba 'dod pa'i bde ba la chags pa dgra yi dbang du song ba bdud kyis bar chad byas pa sdug bsngal gyis zil gyi non pa mun pas bsgribs pa las rgyu 'bras la rmongs pa/

bgrod dka'i lam la kun tu zhugs pa rigs chad pa/ 'ching ba ched dang yang dag ldan pa ni mu stegs can/ zas chen dug dang 'dres la zhen pa ni snyoms 'jug gi bde ba la zhen pa lam ni rab tu stor gyur pa ni mngon pa'i nga rgyal can/ lam gol rab zhugs pa rigs ma nges pa theg dman la zhugs pa stobs chung ba'i byang sems tshogs ma rdzogs pa'o// sems can rnams la snying rje'o// zhes pa ltar bcu'o// gsum pa la/ ma bsgoms pa'i nyes dmigs/ bsgoms pa'i phan yon no// dang po ni/ nyon mongs rnams kyis bdag 'joms sems can 'joms shing tshul khrims 'joms pas tshe 'dir tshul khrims nyams pa bcas shing gzhan gyis rnyed pa dman zhing bsrung ba ste mi ster ba dang de bzhin lha dang ston pas smad/ rtsod pa dang bcas shing mi snyan pa grags ngan 'byung ngo*// de ni la gzhan du mi khom gnas su skye 'o/ tshe 'di dag pa'i yon tan thob dang ma thob pa phyi mar thob pa kun nyams pas yid la sdug bsngal chen po 'thob/ zhes pa ltar/ byams sogs ma bsgoms na de bzhi'i mi mthun phyogs kyi nyon mongs kyis don min pa kun bskyed do// gnyis pa ni/ tshangs pa'i gnas pas gnas pa yi// blo ldan rtag tu gang 'dod par (543) skye ba rnam smin gyi 'bras bu des ni tshogs rnams rdzogs par byed cing pa bdag 'bras yin sems can rnams kyang yongs su smin par byed/ 1$0000220pa skyes bu byed 'bras/1$0000270 kun tu 'am rtag tu/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa/ dang mi 'bral ba rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu'o// la de yi mi mthun phyogs gnod sems sogs dang bral ba bral 'bras so// bag med gyur kyang tshad med de yi 'gal rkyen gyi chos mi bzad pas kyang sems gzhan du mi 'gyur ro// zhes pa ltar 'bras bu lnga'o// bshes spring du/

byams dang snying rje dag dang dga' ba dang*// btang snyoms yang dag rtag tu sgoms mdzod cig / de bsgoms pas/ gong ma ni myang 'das thob par 'gyur ro// 'on te ci zhig ltar myang 'das te/ brnyes par ma gyur de ltar na'ang*// 1$0000220pa/1$0000270 tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gzugs kyi khams su// khong khro dang bral ba'i bsam gtan skyon med pa zhi ba/ bde ba thob par 'gyur// ro zhes 'grel par ro// zhes sogs rgya cher shes par bya'o// nang stong nyid la sogs par mi dmigs shing rtag pa de sogs su dang de dag med par yang stong nyid nyi shu'i chos thams cad ma dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bsgom pa ni/ mi dmigs pa dang ldan pa la dang*/ theg chen po ni nang stong pa nyid shes kyang dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ zhes sogs so// phar phyin drug gi dngos po thams cad la 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa dang*/ sbyin pa po dang len pa po dang sbyin pa zhes snying po mchog rnams

(544) mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis/ zhes sogs so// mi slob pa'i chos rnams kyi ched du bya ba ste sngar ring du 'dris pa rnams bsgom pa chos bshes la dang*/ rnam mkhyen nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas sgom pa po bsgom bya bsgom pa gang yang med pa de ni/ bsgom pa rnam par gzhig pa'i ste bsgom pa mi dmigs pa'o// de'i ched du dge ba'i chos rnams bsgom pa ni ched du bya ba'i 'jug pa'o// snying po mchog ste dag zla yang ngo*// don du byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis// zhes sogs so// 'grel chen dang rang kir bud+dha shrī ni chen po gsum la 'chad do// a bha ya de mi rigs zhes pa'o// gzhan gyi sems shes pa la sogs pa'i mngon par shes pa drug la ste/ mngon par shes pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir sems can yongs su smin par byed do// zhes sogs so// de nas 'tshang rgya bar/ 'grel chen/ spro bas 'bras bu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i tshul la yang dag par gnas pa'i mtshan nyid kyi sgrub pa ste/ rnam mkhyen nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar byed do// zhes so// de ltar na theg chen sbyor lam gyi sgrub pa chos can/ 'jug pa'i sgrub pa yin te/ bsam gtan sogs theg pa chen po'i chos mtha' dag ni sems bskyed la sogs pa'o gser ro// sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis gnon pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sgrub pa yin pas so// de la rnam pa dgu'o// gsum pa la gnyis te/ tshogs sgrub bcu bdun spyir bstan/ (545) rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum las/ snga 'grel ni/ tshul de ltar theg chen gyi g.yul du 'jug pa'i sgrub pa byas pa la byang chub chen po'i rgyu tshogs skye bas sgrub pa gsum pa byang chen sgrub pa'i tshogs kyi sgrub pa 'chad do// chos bshes kyis 'jug pa byas pa ste mthong lam skyes pa la tshogs skye ba ste sgom lam 'byung bas zhes so// rtsa ba la/

brtse dang nas gnyen po brgyad de bcu bdun po de tshogs kyi sgrub pa yi rim pa yin par shes par bya'o// 'grel pa la/ ngo bo/ nges tshig grangs nges gsum mo// dang po la/ sgrub rgyu'i tshogs bcu bdun/ de sgrub pa'i tshogs sgrub bcu bdun yod pas na snga rabs rnams kyis de ma phyed par tshogs bcu bdun nyid tshogs sgrub bcu bdun du 'chad pa ni don spyi ma shar ro// 'di la sgrub ces drang ngo*// brtse sogs theg pa chen po'i don bcu bdun sogs mtha' dag go / ni sems bskyed sogs la'o// gser ro// rnam pa gang gis na/ bcu bdun po rnams bden par mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas so// ji ltar na/ don dam par gser sgrub pa med kyi kun rdzob kyi bden pa las mi 'da' bar ro// sgrub rgyu bcu bdun po gang zhe na/ ji tsam gyis na byang chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bgyi ba lags/ zhes rab 'byor gyis zhus pa'i lan du dang po bcu gsungs so// de la dang po ni/ phyogs bcu'i ngan song gsum na gnas pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byed (546) cing sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i zhing du lha mir skye bar byed pa'i rnam pa can gyi zhe sdang med pa'i dge rtsa ni snying rje chen po'i tshogs te ār+ya sogs kun no// sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi me'i phung po ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad med par bya ste/ zhes sogs dang*/ byol song dang yi dwags las rnam par ldang ngo*// zhes sogs so// sbyin pa'i tshogs te/ zas 'dod pa rnams la zas zhes sogs so// tshul khrims kyi tshogs te/ tshul khrims kyi phar phyin la gnas shing*/ nas/ sems can rnams dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la 'god/ ces sogs so// bzod pa'i ste/ bzod pa'i phar phyin la gnas shing*// zhes sogs so// brtson 'grus dang bsam gtan dang shes rab gsum gyi mdo 'don pa bsgyur ro// gzugs sogs yul gyi sems g.yeng ba zhi bar byas nas bsam gtan nam ting nge 'dzin gang bsgom pa de la sems rtse gcig tu zhugs pa ni zhi gnas/

zhes sgra sbyor bam gnyis te/ khyad par du rnam mkhyen la sems rtse gcig pas gnas shing sems can thams cad phyin drug sogs rnam mkhyen gyi bar la 'god par 'dod pa'i sems rtse gcig pa ni zhi gnas te ni sems rtse gcig pa'o// khyad par du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ste shes rab ces rang kir dang dgongs 'grel chen rnam mkhyen nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis gnas shing sems bskyed pa gzhan gyi go mi 'byed de/ zhes sogs nas/ sems can tshad med pa sbyin phar la dgod/ nas/ rnam mkhyen bar (547) ro// de lta bu'i dgod bya dgod byed sogs chos thams cad bden med du rab tu 'byed pa'i blo ni skabs 'dir/ lhag mthong ste/ shes rab kyi dngos po'i rang bzhin lhag par rtogs pa'i ming yin pas lhag mthong zhes bya zhes sgra sbyor bam gnyis las so// rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi slad du go cha ma mchis pa'i go cha bgos par rig par bgyi'o// rab 'byor zhes sogs rgya cher ro// de gnyis ya bral min par zung du 'brel ba'i lam gyi ste/ med pa dang*/ zhes sogs nas/ ma skyes pa nyid de shin tu mi dmigs pa'i rnam pas/ zhes sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong*/ sogs nas/ ma bcings ma grol ba de'i rnam mkhyen nyid du 'tshang rgya'o// zhes so// de nas theg chen po gang lags zhes zhus lan du lnga gsungs te/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis phar phyin rnams la rang spyod cing gzhan 'dzin du 'jug pa ni thams la mkhas ār+ya dag snying zla pa ste/ phyi nang gi dngos po yongs su gtong ste de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing bla med rdzogs byang du mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bsngo/ zhes sogs phyin drug rgya cher ro// de yang phyin drug ni sangs rgyas kyi thabs yin la de la mkhas pas so// zhes rang kir ro// mdo rgyan du/ snying rje dang thabs mkhas las gzhan du/

bshad pa ni mdo gzhan gyi dgongs pa'o// 'dir bshad dag stong nyid nyi shu'i ye shes kyi ste/ theg chen po ni 'di lta ste (548) nang stong pa nyid/ ces sogs so// dag par byed pas bsod nams te dge ba'i rnam grangs so// zhes sher rtsa shes 'grel chen legs ldan ma sgron dang yang dang yang dge legs kyi ched du 'gyur ba'i phyir bsod nams so// yang na skyes bu dag tu 'jug par byed dag par byed pa'i phyir bsod nams zhes thub dgongs so// mdor na gzhan la phan zhing bsod pas gsos shing gnas pa'i ming ste bsod nams zhes btags zhes bam gnyis so// 'dir de'i rgyu ting nge 'dzin te dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ zhes sogs so// tshogs sbyor mthong dang sgom pa'i lam sogs te/ theg chen po ni/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi dang*/ zhes sogs nas/ bco brgyad kyi bar rgya cher dngos 'dzin dang bcas pa gsungs so// tshig dang don la sogs pa'i gzungs bzhi ste/ a zhes bya ba ni ma skyes pa'i phyir chos thams cad kyi sgo'o// ra ni rdul dang bral bas/ pa ni don dam ston pas/ tsa ni 'chi 'pho skye ba mi dmigs pas/ na ni ming dang bral zhing*/ zhes sogs te/ a ra pa tsa na'o// rgya cher yod do// 'di la ngo bo/ dbye ba/ byed las so// dang po la 'dzin par byed pas gzungs zhes che bar ro// chos rnams kyi tshig don 'dzin par nus pas gzungs te mdor bsdus na dran pa dang shes rab ces 'bum ṭīka 'o bzod pa'i gzungs ni/ a ra pa tsa na la sogs pa'i yi ge'i don de bzhin du sgro btags nas bsgoms pas bsgom pa rdzogs pa na yi ge de'i don dam pa la (549) bzod pa skye ba ni/ bzod pa'i gzungs de yang thub dgongs dngos te/ dper na a'i 'di man ngag ldan don skye ba med par btags dag ldan te bsgoms pas bsgom pa rdzogs pa na chos thams cad skye med du rtogs pa'i bzod pa thob ste/

des na bzod gzungs so// dag ldan no// des na chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i sgo ste thabs so// gzhan yang byang se mos spyod pas tad+ya tha/ i ṭi mi ṭi ki ṭi bhi ṭi bhik+ṣan ti ba dā ni swā hā rgya dpe mang po la gtugs pas 'di ltar snang*/ gcig la ki ṭi ni k+ṣān ti zhes so// zhes sogs kyi yi ge'i brjod bya gang yin bsams pas/ de mi mthong ngo de nas 'di dag gi brjod bya med kyi brjod bya med pa nyid de'i don yin par nges te gtan la 'bebs shing sngags de dag brjod par bya byed dang bral bar bsgoms nas tshul des chos thams cad de gnyis dang bral bas brjod du med par bsgoms pas chos thams cad kun brtags kyi stong par mthong ngo*// de mthong ba na chos thams cad brjod med du rtogs pas dga' ba chen po skye ste bzod pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i gzungs so// de nas de ma thag tu sa dang po'i ye shes skye ba dang mthun pa'i bzod pa skye ste don dam pa'i chos la bzod pas na bzod pa'o// de la gzungs kyi bzod pa'am ye shes zhes bya'o// de mos spyod du gtogs so// byang sar yang ngo*// tshig gi gzungs ni/ sa thob nas sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bstan pa'i chos (550) kyi ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs tshad med grangs med rnams dus dpag med du rim pa de nyid kyis ma brjed par 'dzin pa'i dran pa dang shes rab mtshungs ldan no// de chos kyi gzungs zhes gnod 'joms so// don gyi gzungs ni/ des sngar gzung ba'i chos rnams kyi don tshad med grangs med rnams dus dpag med du mi brjed par 'dzin pa'i dran pa dang shes rab gcig tu byas zhes zla zer mtshungs ldan no// gsang sngags kyi gzungs ni/ grangs med dang por tshogs bsags pas sa dang po thob pa nas bzung ste/ sngags kyi yi ge rnams ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du byin gyis rlob ste/

sngags kyi yi ge 'di rnams cho ga 'di lta bus sems can rnams kyi yams dang nye bar 'tshe ba dang nad 'go ba dang 'khrug pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ces sogs byin gyis brlabs pas don de rnams gsang sngags kyi tshig de dag gis 'grub ste de ltar byin gyis rlob pa'i ye shes gnod 'joms de sngags mtshan nyid pa/ de'i yul yin pas gsang sngags kyi tshig de rnams btags pa'o// yang man+t+ra zhes zla pa man gnod 'joms shes pa'am yid/ tra ya ni skyob pas te de nyid shes pa dang 'gro ba skyob pas stong nyid kyi ye shes dang snying rje dbyer med pa ni gsang sngags so// de nyid ma rig pa spong zhing rigs pa bskyed pas rig sngags so// yi ge rnams de'i rgyu mthun 'bras bu yin pas der btags so// rnam mkhyen gyi gzhi yin pas gsang sngags kyi gzhi'o// dang po mos spyod (551) rdzogs pa nas dang gsum sa thob nas so// mdo gzhan sa bcu par dus bcu la gzungs mi 'dra ba re re thob cing bsrung byed kyi gzungs yang so sor gsungs pa yod do// phal cher gnod 'joms te rgya cher bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ sngon gyi rnam smin las byung ba dang tshe 'dir mang du thos pa las byung ba gnyis chung ngu goms pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi gzungs dag ni/ chen po// chung ngu dang ni chen po ste// chen po de yang rnam pa gsum// mos spyod pa'i chung ngu*/ sa bdun pa'i bar 'bring*/ brgyad pa yan chen po'o// zhes sogs te sngar bshad dang tshul cung mi 'dra'o// gsum pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' yang dang yang*// de la yang dag brten nas ni// rtag tu dam pa'i chos dag kyang*// 1$0000220gzhan pa 1$0000270ston cing rang kir yang dag par 'dzin par byed pa yin// zhes so// sa bcu dang gnyen po brgyad 'og tu 'chad do// gnyis pa ni/

sam+bha ra tshogs yin pas/ sa ma yang dag par 'grub pa/ bha ngo bor 'dzin pa ste/ sngar ltar sgrub cing nyams su blangs gser bas na snying rje la sogs pa bcu bdun po 'di dag gis byang chen yang dag par 'grub pa'i ngo bo'am dngos po gser thob pas byang chub chen po 'bras bur nges par 'dzin par byed pa'i phyir na/ snying rje la sogs pa ni byang chen gyi rgyu'i tshogs yin no// gsum pa ni/ de yin pas sgrub rgyu'i tshogs bcu bdun yod pas de sgrub pa'i tshogs kyi sgrub pa'ang rnam pa (552) bcu bdun no// de ltar 'chad ma shes na lam gyi tshogs ni dran pa nyer bzhag nas sangs rgyas kyi bar bshad pa chos mchog chen po na yod dam soms shig tshogs zhes pa chos du ma'i don no// tshogs lam nas khyad par lam gyi bar du ldan mod kyi khyad par can sgom lam nas yod ces chos bshes te/ 'dir chos mchog chen po nas zhes bya'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ ye shes/ sa/ gnyen bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ shes bya stong nyid nyi shur yod pas ye shes nyi shur phye/ shes bya stong nyid nyi shu gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po ni/ 'dir stong nyid nyi shu'i sa mtshams phyed na ni 'dus ma byas nam mkha'i sa mtshams byed par nus sam/ yul can ye shes kyi sa mtshams 'jog na/ theg chen tshogs lam du spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs/ sbyor lam du gsal snang skyes pa'i tshul gyis rtogs/ mthong lam du gsar du sgom lam du mthong zin goms/ sangs rgyas sar sgrib pa thams cad dang bral bas mthar phyin pa'i tshul gyis rtogs so// de yang byang 'phags rnams stong rgyu'i chos kun gyis stong par gcig car bsgom gyi char phye nas mi sgom mo// 'on kyang 'grel chen thub dgongs sogs ltar na/ tshogs bcu bdun yod pa de la ste de'i nang nas ye shes kyi tshogs ni rnam pa nyi shu'o// ji ltar byas pas zhe na/

re re la stong pa nyid kyi yul can gyi ye shes zhes sbyar te/ nang dang*/ phyi dang*/ phyi nang de gnyis ka gsum tshogs lam nas so// stong pa nyid ni sbyor lam nas 'grel chen (553) so// yang na dang po gsum tshogs lam nas bzod pa'i bar ro// bzhi pa chos mchog na'o// thub dgongs so// chen po ni sa dang po las so// don dam pa ni gnyis pa la'o// 'dus byas ni gsum pa la 'dus ma byas ni bzhi pa la/ mtha' yas 'das pa ni lnga pa na/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa ni drug pa na'o// dor ba med pa ni bdun pa na/ rang bzhin dang*/ chos thams cad ni brgyad pa na/ rang gi mtshan nyid dang*/ mi dmigs pa ni dgu pa na/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang*/ dngos po ni bcu pa na/ dngos po med pa dang*/ rang gi ngo bo dang*/ gzhan gyi ngo bo ni sangs rgyas kyi sa na'o// zhes rgyu mtshan dbus mthar bshad pa dang sbyar te bshad do// dgongs pa yang sa mtshams de dang de'i stong nyid kyi yul can gyi ye shes rnams nyi shu po de dang de rtogs pa gtso che zhes pa'o// des na sa dang po'i mnyam bzhag gi ye shes chos can/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi yul can gyi ye shes yin te/ phyogs bcu'i stong nyid gtso bor mngon sum du gsar du rtogs pa'i ye shes yin pas so// zhes sogs 'og ma dang sbrel nas 'don pa bsgyur zhing dgod do// gnyis pa ni/ skabs 'dir shes bya stong nyid nyi shu po mdor bsdus te tshigs bcad du byas nas smras pa/ nang ni/ mig sogs skye mched kyi dbang po drug ste/ de don dam par rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i phyir na/ de pa de skabs stong pa'i stong nyid ni/ nang stong pa nyid do// zhes sogs 'don pa bsgyur te/

(554) phyi rol ni phyi'i yul gyi skye mched drug go /sems kyis zin pas nang dbang pos ma bsdus pas phyi yin pas de sen mo sogs/ zhes rang kir gnyis ka ni dbang rten gyis bsdus pa'o// dbus mtha'i don ni rten khog pa la 'grel bar ro// chos thams cad stong pa nyid du shes pa ni stong pa'i dngos po ste de ni 'dir chos thams cad stong pa nyid do// dbus mtha' ār+ya sogs/ gang zag la sogs pas stong pa zhes rang kir/ phyogs bcu ni/ rang kir yang chen po ste dbyibs che bas so// snod kyi 'jig rten ni chen po ste rgya che bas so zhes so// zla zer du gnyis ka'o// don dam pa ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam rang kir ste de yang dam pa ni myang 'das so de'i don nam thabs lam ste dam pa'i don zhes pa'o// yang na don dam ni myang 'das te de ni dri ma dang bral ba tsam gyis phye bas ngo bos stong zhes ār+ya zla zer ro// 'grel chen yang na chos thams cad stong nyid du shes pa'i blo des ji ltar mthong ba de nyid don dam pa'i rnam pa'o zhes sam blo brtan mar don dam pa'o snyam du rtogs pa de don dam pa'o dbus mtha' skor ro// 'grel pa gnyis/ 'dus byas ni ār+ya 'grel chen sogs khams gsum ste rgyu rkyen las skyes pas so// de las gcig shos skye 'gag gnas 'gyur bzhi dang bral ba ni 'dus ma byas te don dam par bzlog phyogs skye ba sogs med pas ngo bos stong ngo*// dbus mtha'i don 'dus byas lam bden 'dus ma byas myang 'das la blo brtan bshad do// rtag chad kyi mtha' ni mtha' de las don (555) dam par 'das pa ste mthar 'jog byed dbus don dam par ma grub pas so// des na mtha' 'das ni rtag pa'i dngos po'o// rang kir/ mtha' de nyid do// yang na mtha' med pas mtha' 'das te longs spyod rdzogs sku'o// dag ldan no// rtag tu sems can la phan par bya'o snyam pa ni mtha' 'das zhes dbus mtha'i don blo brtan no// te yul sems can la sbyar na 'thad do// thog ma dbus dang tha ma med pa ni thog ma dang tha ma med pa'o// zhes so// ār+ya 'grel chen/

de ni zla dag ldan rang kir 'khor ba ste/ 'khor ba mi btang bya ba'i phyir// zhes dbus mthar ro// dor spangs btang rgyur med pa ni dor ba med pa ār+ya 'grel chen de bas med ste dge phyogs so zhes zla zer ro// theg chen no zhes dag ldan dang*/ dor ba ni rnam g.yeng ste de med pa zag med lam zhes rang kir te gser yang ngo*// lhag med du yang mi 'dor ba'i dge bar dbus mthar dbyig gnyen no// 'phags pa thams cad kyis ma byas pa ni rang bzhin te/ glo bur ba min gyi thog med nas theg pa gsum gyi rigs su so sor gnas pa'i skye mched drug gam/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs de bzhin nyid do zhes blo brtan no// shes rab dang snying rje la phyogs glang ngo*// don bsdur chos dbyings la dag ldan rang kir ro// 'dus byas ma byas kyi chos kun ni chos thams cad do// de gnyis ltos nas bzhag pas ngo bos ār+ya stong zhes so// stobs sogs sangs rgyas (556) 1$0000220kyi chos thams cad ces dbus mthar skor ro// 1$0000270'dus byas kyi chos kyi skye gnas rnying sogs sam gzugs su snying mchog rung ba sogs ni rang gi mtshan nyid do// yang na mtshan dpe rnams ni rang gi mtshan nyid de skyes bu chen por mtshon pas so// dbus mtha' skor ro// 'das pa dang sogs pa ma 'ongs da ltar gsum phan tshun ār+ya bzlog par ma ār+ya dmigs pas mi dmigs pa'o// rgyu rkyen gnod 'joms ldan pa'am phrad pa las byung ba ni ldan pa'am 'dus mdo pa'o// de ni rten cing 'brel 'byung yin pas don dam par dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid yin la de ltar na rgyu rkyen 'dus pa ni zhes sbyar ro// gcig shos ni gzhan rang kir du bsgyur nye bar len ār+ya sogs pa'i phung po mdo ni ngo bo ste dngos po'o// de yang phung po'i don ni spungs pa'i don yin la spungs pa ni don dam par med pa'i don yin pas zhes sogs sbyar ro// 'dus mdo ma byas nam ār+ya mkha' sogs ni dngos po med pa'o// de ni sgrib ār+ya byed sogs dngos po'i chos med pa tsam la btags pas zhes sogs sbyar ro// chos rnams kyi gnas lugs ma nor mdo ba ni de rnams kyi rang gi ngo bo ste ār+ya 'phags pa rnams kyi shes mdo pa ni mi rtog ye shes so// dang mthong bas ni de'i rjes las byung ba'i dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes so zhes 'bum ṭīka 'o// ma byas pa'o mdo zhes sbyar ro// 'on kyang 'di ni shes pa dang mthong bas byas pas stong zhes mdo don no// chos rnams kyi chos

(557) nyid dang de bzhin nyid yang dag mdo mtha' sogs ni rtag tu gnas pas byed pa po don/ ār+ya 'grel chen a bha gzhan gyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'o// de don dam par rang gi ngo bos stong zhes sogs sbyar ro// 'on kyang chos nyid sogs brgyad ni de pa rnams byung yang rung ma byung yang rung rtag tu gnas pas de dag ni don dam par phung po la sogs pa'i chos gzhan rnams kyis stong pa nyid la gzhan gyi dngos po stong pa nyid ces bya'o zhes mdo dang de 'grel gnod 'joms ār+ya las bshad pas rang rang gis stong par sbyor ba ni 'dir rang bzo'o// stong bzhi nyi shu yod pas de'i stong pa nyid ni nyi shur 'dod do// stong nyid zab mo 'di dag mdo dang bstan bcos du ma las bshad tshul shes shing bri bar rigs kyang*/ mangs pas 'jigs pa dang 'dir rang stong pa'i lugs nyid la mos pa'i dbang du byas nas cha tsam bstan no// kha cig 'di dag gis gzhan dgag pa'i sgo nas stong nyid 'ba' zhig bstan gyi mngon rtogs kyi go rim ma bstan zer ba ltar na mdo'i tshig don tsam brjod kyi bstan bcos kyi don ma tshang bar 'gyur ro zhes ār+ya'o// gnyis pa la/ spyi dang yan lag gi don gnyis las/ dang po la/ spyir sa zhes pa phyi rol chos can gyis bsdus pa 'byung bas lta bu dang*/ rang ris kyi sdes bsdus pa thos pa'i sa zhes sogs sa bcu bdun bstan pa lta bu dang*/ spang bya gtso che ba khams gsum sa dgu lta bu dang (558) spangs rtogs yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i sa du ma yod pa las/ 'dir tha ma ste/ 'di la bdag med rtogs pa'i blo gang zhig nyan thos kyi lam gyi rten byed pa nyan thos kyi sa gang zhig rang rgyal lam gyi rten byed pa rang rgyal gyi sa'o// dbye na/ rin chen phreng bar/ ji ltar nyan thos theg pa la// nyan thos sa ni brgyad bshad pa// zhes te/ zhugs gnas kyi sa brgyad do// yang de'i steng du nyan thos kyi dkar po rnam par mthong ba'i sa/

rigs kyi sa dang bcas pas bcur yang yod do// yang dkar mthong*/ rigs brgyad/ mthong*/ bsrabs/ 'dod chags dang bral ba/ byas pa rtogs pa/ rang rgyal gyi sa ste brgyad dam 'og tu 'chad pa ltar brgyad do// theg chen gyi la/ phal pa dad pa'i sa'am tshogs kyi sa/ mos spyod kyi sa ste gtso bo sbyor lam gyi skabs so// khyad par can 'phags pa'i sa ste bcu gcig go /'di la gsum las/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi snying rje chen po sogs kyis zin pa'i zag med ye shes gang zhig theg chen gyi spangs rtogs yon tan gyi rten du gyur pa'o// 'jug pa'i bshad par/ byang ba rnams kyi snying rje la sogs pas yongs su bzung ba'i zag pa med pa'i ye shes kho na char rnam par phye ba ni sa'i ming 'thob ste/ yon tan gyi rten du gyur pa nyid kyi phyir ro// zhes te/ thub dgongs su yang ngo*// sa rnams kyi rang bzhin ni ye shes 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ngo bo nyid do zhes chos bshes so// bye brag tu sa bcu gcig gi mtshan nyid mkhas pa'i ngag las bzung shig gnyis (559) pa mtshon bya'i sgra bshad ni/ 'byung po dpag med 'jigs med phyir// dpag tu med pa de dag la// phyi phyir gong du 'gro ldan phyir// de dag nyid ni sar 'dod do// zhes te/ bhu mi zhes pa sa ste bhū ta 'byung po ste sems can/ a mi ta dpag med/ bhū las a bha la zhes sbyar na 'jigs med/ yang a mi ta dpag med de yon tan dpag tu med pa can no// yang bhā la/ bhū ya bhā ya phyi phyir te yang yang ngo*// mi la ga mi ni 'gro ba ste/ sems can dpag tu med pa rnams kyi 'jigs pa thams cad spang bar bya ba'i phyir/ re re la yang yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i sa de dag la yang yang sa gong ma gong mar 'gro ba dang ldan pas sa'o// mtshan gzhi la 'dir bcu ste/ de yang sbyong byed kyi chos bcu yod pas bcur phye bar 'grel chen no// 'on kyang spangs rtogs yon tan sogs mi 'dra ba bcu yod pas bcur phye'o// 'di la brgyad de/

rtags yon tan/ skye ba slob tshul/ spang bya/ spyod pa/ spangs rtogs/ 'bras bu'i khyad par ro// dang po la gnyis las/ zhugs pa'i rtags ni sa gang la zhugs pa la snang ba dang bcas dang ma zhugs pa la mos pa ste gcig tu bya'o// dang*/ zab cing rgya che ba la sems ma zhum pa dang dka' spyad la sems mi dman gnyid rang gi thob pa'i sa la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa'i bdag nyid dang*/ thams cad rab tu rtogs pa ni sa thams cad bsgrub pa la mkhas pa'o// (560) dang*/ sems can kun la bdag dang sems ni mnyam pa ste rang gzhan mnyam par rtogs pa'o// dang*/ snyan mi snyan gyi sgras bkrir mi btub pa dang*/ rjes su chags med ni 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal sogs kyi phun tshogs la'o// dang*/ mi dmigs par 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs shes rtag tu sangs rgyas kyi 'khor du skye ba ni/ sa bcu kun la byang chub sems dpa'i rtags su 'dod pa yin// zhes so// gnyis pa rmi lam gyi rtags ni/ sa bcu po la rim bzhin du/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gter bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong gis yongs su gang bar mthong ngo*// yang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams lag mthil lta bur gyur pa la rin po che bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong du mas legs par brgyan par mthong ngo*// yang bdag nyid dpa' zhing lag cha dang go cha sra ba thogs nas phas kyi rgol ba thams cad 'dul bar mthong ngo*// yang phyogs bzhi nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor bzhis thams cad dang ldan pa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor la me tog sna tshogs kyis mngon par 'thor bar mthong ngo*// yang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i bu med kyis mgo la me tog tsam pa ka'i phreng ba 'dogs par mthong ngo*// yang rdzing them skas bzhi dang ldan pa gser gyi bye ma brdal ba rnyog pa med cing dwangs la yan lag bsil dang zhim dang yangs ba dang*// dwangs dang 'jam dang dri nga med// 'thungs na lto la mi gnod dang*// mgrin pa la ni mi gnod pa'o// zhes so// brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus yongs

(561) su gang ba la me tog ut+pal dang ku mu ta dang dang pad+ma dkar pos brgyan pa'i chu mthong ste de la bdag nyid rtse dga' zhing yongs su spyod pa mthong ngo*// yang phyogs g.yas g.yon gnyis nas sems can dmyal ba'i g.yang sa mthong ste de las bdag nyid ma smras ma nyams par slar ldog par mthong ngo*// yang*/ phrag pa gnyis na ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge ral pa can cod pan thogs pas gcan gzan phra mo thams cad skrag par byed cing 'dug pa mthong ngo*// yang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po mthong ste skye bo bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor zhing mdun gyis bltas la mgo'i steng na rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i gdug dkar po 'dzin pa mthong ngo*// yang de ba'i sku mthong ste kha dog gser lta bu 'od 'doms gang ba tshangs pa bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor zhing mdun gyis bltas nas chos ston pa mthong ngo*// zhes gser 'od dang blo gros mi zad pas zhus pa gnyis car la'o// drod thob nas gnyid sogs sgrib pa lnga med par bshad pas sa bcu thob pa la ci ltar rmi ltas 'ong snyam na/ gnyid la gnyis las/ 'jug pa rang dbang med par sdud byed nye nyon gyi gnyid med kyang*/ ched du byin gyis brlabs pas lus rgyas par byed pa dge bar bgrang pa'i gnyid ni sa de dag na'ang yod pas skyon med do// skabs min par mtshan ma 'di dag byung na sngags kyi mthu'am bdud kyi byin brlabs su (562) shes par bya'o zhes chos bshes so// gnyis pa la/ spyi dang*/ bye brag gi yon tan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sa rnams kun la rnam kun tu// blo ldan rnams kyi phan yon ni// zhi gnas lhag mthong gnyis ka la// lnga po'i bdag nyid dag tu 'dod// ces te/ skad cig re re la gnas ngan len zad par byed de// zhi gnas rtse gcig pas lus sems las su rung bar byas pa'i rgyus lus sems las su mi rung ba'i rgyu sgrib gnyis 'joms par byed pa'o// zhes blo brtan no// bul tog gi chus gos kyi dri ma bzhin du zhi gnas chu lta bus gnas ngan len lus las 'dag par byed pa'o// bshad sbyar skabs gzhan du/

gzugs yod med 'dus byas ma byas sogs sna tshogs kyi 'du shes dang bral ba'i zhi gnas thob pas chos kyi dga' ba ni sems mi g.yeng ba ste de thob pa ste zhi gnas kyi gnyis dang*/ gzugs can yin 'grel bshad gnyis min la sogs pa'i rnam dbyig blo brtan don par ram phyogs gnyis ka bcu dus gsum gyi chos blo thams cad mnyam par shes pas na yongs su ma chad pa'i mtshan blo ma med pa'i chos kyi snang ba rab tu shes pa dang*/ rnam par dag pa'i skal ba dang mthun pa'i rgyu mtshan rnam lus las srin bu phyir 'thon pa lus mi gtsang bas lpags pa sbyong bar mthong ba sogs zhes skabs gzhan du bshad sbyar ro// par ma brtags pa dag kun tu spyod par 'gyur ba gnyis blo lhag mthong gi'o// chos sku rdzogs par 'grub pa'i phyir du de'i rgyu phyin bcu sogs gong nas gong du 'dzin pa ni gnyis ka'i yon tan no// (563) gnyis pa ni/ sa dang po la yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis te/ skad cig gcig gis ting nge 'dzin brgya so sor thob cing snyoms par 'jug 1 go /ting nge 'dzin gyi las ni sangs rgyas brgya mthong 2 ngo*// de rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs kyang shes so/ 3 /'jig rten gyi khams brgya g.yo bar byed cing*/ 4 snang bar yang byed do/ 5 /zhing brgyar 'gro'o/ 6 /sems can brgya yongs su smin par 7 byed do// bskal pa brgyar gnas 8 shing*/ sngon dang phyi ma'i mthar 'jug 9 go /chos kyi sgo brgya rnam par 10 'byed do// lus brgya ston par byed do/ 11 /lus dang lus la yang byang se'i 'khor brgya dang ldan 12 par ston par byed do// de bzhin du bsgres te/ gnyis pa sogs la stong dang*/ 'bum dang*/ bye ba phrag khrig dang brgya dang phye ba phrag khrig stong dang stong dang*/ bye ba phrag khrig 'bum dang*/ bye ba phrag khrig 'bum dang*/

stong gsum dngos 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed dag stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa las 'das pa'i rdul phra mo ji snyed pa de 'di mdo dngos gtug dgos snyed do// sa bcu pa'i mdor ro// thub dgongs su yod gsum pa ni/ blo ldan rnams kyi las dang ni// gzhan yang smon lam dag dang ni// ting nge 'dzin dang dbang 'byor ba'i// dbang gis skye bar 'dod pa yin// zhes te/ mos spyod

(564) pa rnams las kyis mngon par 'dod thub dgongs su pa'i gnas su skye ba dang*/ sa thob pa rnams sems can smin pa'i phyir du dud 'gro sogs gnas dman par skye ba ni smon lam gyi dbang dang*/ bsam gtan rnams kyi 'bras bu skye ba bzlog nas 'dod khams su skye ba ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang*/ sprul pas dga' ldan na gnas pa sogs dbang 'byor ba'i dbang gis skye dbyig gnyen ltar ro// ba ste dbang gi skye ba bzhi'o// rnam smin gyi skye ba ni/ sa bcu thob pa rnams rim bzhin du/ dzam+bu'i gling*/ gling bzhi/ sum cu rtsa gsum/ 'thab bral/ dga' ldan/ 'phrul dga'/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi rgyal po dang*/ stong gi bdag po tshangs pa/ stong gnyis kyi bdag po/ stong gsum gyi bdag po gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i rgyal po rnams su phal cher skye'o// zhes sa bcu pa'i mdo don no// bzhi pa ni/ chos nyid rab tu rtogs nas 'dir// lhag pa'i tshul khrims lhag sems dang*// lhag pa'i shes rab la rjes slob// zhes te/ sa dang por chos nyid rtogs nas/ gnyis par tshul khrims kyi/ gsum par sems kyi bslab pa dang*/ bzhi par byang phyogs la mkhas pa/ lnga par bden gnyis la mkhas pa/ drug par rten 'brel la mkhas pa ste gsum po der shes rab kyi bslab pa la slob bo// de ltar bslab pas sa bdun par mtshan ma med cing mngon par 'du byed pa'i ye shes/ brgyad par mtshan ma dang 'du byed pa gnyis ka med cing zhing (565) dag pa/ dgu par sems can smin par byed pa/ bcu par gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rnams 'grub pa'i 'bras bu ste/ 'bras bu dam pa 'di bzhi ni// sa bzhi po la rab tu brten// zhes so// de ltar slob pa de nyid zag med kyi phung po lnga sbyong ba'ang yin te/ 1$0000220sa dang por1$0000270/ chos nyid rab tu rtogs nas sa gnyis pa 'dir tshul khrims kyi ni phung po sbyong*// de yi 'og tu gsum par ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang*/ bzhi lnga drug par// shes rab kyi phung po rnam par sbyong*// de las gzhan pa bdun sogs bzhi po dag la ni// sngar bshad 'bras bu bzhi'i sgrib pa rnam pa bzhi dang sangs rgyas kyi sa la thogs pa yi sgrib pa sbyangs pa las ni rim pa bzhin/

rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang rnam par grol ba'i ye shes kyi phung po rnam par sbyong zhes pa ltar ro// lnga pa ni/ sa la 'jug pa'i mdor/ yan lag bcu gcig rdzogs gyur pas// rab dga' la sogs sa bcu gcig /rmongs gnyis gnas ngan len gcig ste// mi mthun phyogs ni tha dad do// zhes pa ltar/ sa bcu gcig la rmongs pa gnyis gnyis dang gnas ngan len re re ste ming tsam chos bshes su bshad cing lung gi snye ma dang lhan thabs gnyis su yang bshad do// rgyas par dgongs 'grel 'grel pa gsum dang bcas pa las shes par bya'o// drug pa ni/ phar phyin bcu ste sngar bshad zin cing*/ sa bcu la phar phyin bcu re re gtso cher spyod cing*/ gzhan phal pa'i (566) tshul gyis spyod de/ dbus mthar/ khyad par can dang khyad med ni// sa bcu dag tu shes par bya// zhes so// rgyas par sa bcu pa'i mdor shes par bya'o// bdun pa la/ sa bcu po'i rtogs pa la khyad ci yod ce na/ mnyam gzhag tu chos nyid tsam rtogs khyad med/ chos nyid bcu la sgrib pa bcu spangs pa'i rim gyis nges pa 'dren tshul la khyad yod par bstan/ rtsod pa spong ba'o// dang po ni/ sa bcu gcig gi mnyam bzhag na chos nyid tsam mngon gsum du rtogs par khyad par med de/ chos thams cad kyi chos dbyings gcig nyid yin pa'i phyir te/ mdo las/ 'jam dpal chos kyi dbyings gcig yang dag pa'i mtha' gcig yin na snod dang snod min par ci ltar brtags ces dang*/ ār+ya de bas/ gang gis dngos gcig de bzhin nyid mthong ba// de yis dngos kun de bzhin nyid du mthong*// zhes sogs mtha' yas so// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar yin kyang chos dbyings bcus sgrib pa bcu spangs pa'i sgo nas rjes thob kyi yang dag pa'i nges pa 'dren pa'i sgo nas rtogs pa la khyad par yod de/ dbus mthar/ kun tu 'gro don mchog gi don// rgyu mthun don gyi mchog nyid dang*// yongs su 'dzin pa med don dang*// rgyud rnams tha dad med don dang*// nyon mongs rnam dag min don dang*// tha dad med pa'i don nyid dang*// dri med 'phel ba med don dang*// dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yi gnas// chos kyi dbyings la ma rig pa// nyon mongs can min sgrib pa bcu// sa bcu'i mi mthun phyogs

(567) rnams kyi// gnyen po dag ni sa yin no// zhes te/ 1$0000220sa dang por/1$0000270 chos nyid de rang gzhan thams cad la khyab pa kun tu 'gro ba'i don du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgrib pa spangs pas de rtogs shing rang gzhan mnyam par rig gnyis par rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar blo brtan mthong bas chos dbyings de nyon mongs can yin min gyi rmongs blo pa kun sbyang rung gi mchog gi don du gtso bor rtogs nas de la rang stobs gyis nges pa 'dren/ gsum par yongs su dag pa'i chos sku'i ming can chos dbyings kyi dbang gis de'i rgyu mthun pa mdo la blo sogs pa'i bstan pa'i chos byung ba'i phyir na chos dbyings mchog yin pas de dag byed kyi bstan pa'i chos rgyu dang mthun pa'i don gyi mchog tu mi rtog ye shes kyis rig nas de la rang stobs kyis nges pa 'dren/ bzhi par/ chos dbyings de gang gis kyang yongs su 'dzin pa med cing bdag dang bdag gi sogs gang du yang gzung bya min par spros med ye shes kyis gtso bor rtogs pas de la rang stobs kyis nges pa 'dren/ lnga par/ sangs rgyas byang sems dang rang gi rgyud rnams chos dbyings tha dad med pa'i don du sems kyi bsam pa rnam dag mnyam pa nyid bcus rtogs te/ de la rang stobs kyis nges pa 'dren/ bcu ni dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi chos rnam par dag pa la/ bsam pa mnyam pa gsum/ tshul khrims dang sems kyi bslab pa rnam dag la sems (568) mnyam pa gnyis/ lta ba the tshom yid gnyis 'gyod pa sel bas rnam par dag pa la sems mnyam pa ste de ni shes rab kyi bslab pa la'o// de ltar bslab gsum la'o// lam dang lam min shes pa rnam dag la dang*/ lam shes pa rnam dag la dang*/ byang phyogs thams cad gong nas gong du rnam dag la dang*/ sems can thams cad smin par byed pa rnam dag la bsam pa mnyam pa rnams so// drug par/

rten 'brel gyi don la nyon mongs rnam dag gi bdag gam bdag gi gang yang med par rtogs pas chos dbyings de rang bzhin gyis kun nas nyon mongs pa min blo brtan cing rang bzhin gyis dag pas glo bur du rnam par dag pa'ang min par mngon sum du rtogs nas de la rang stobs kyis nges pa 'dren/ bdun par/ chos dbyings de mdo la sogs pa'i chos kyi mtshan ma tha dad pa'i don du mtshan ma thams cad stong par ro gcig pa'i rnam pa'i ye shes kyis mngon sum du rtogs shing de la rang stobs kyis nges pa 'dren/ brgyad par/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob dbyig pas chos dbyings blo rang bzhin gyis dag pas dri bcas kyi dus su bri ba med dri med kyi dus su yang 'phel ba med par mngon sum du rtogs shing de la rang stobs kyis nges pa 'dren/ nyon yid gnas gyur pas mi rtog ye shes shin tu dag pa la dbang dbang shes lnga gnas gyur pas ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin ston pa zhing dag pa la dbang ba'i gnas nyid du rtogs/ dgu par/ so so yang dag rig bzhi (569) thob pas ye shes la dbang*/ bcu par/ ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin sprul pa rnams kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pas las la dbang ba'i gnas nyid du rtogs te/ dbang de gnyis yid shes gnas gyur pa las byung ngo zhes pa rnams sangs rgyas gnyis pa dbyig gnyen dang blo gros brtan pa ltar ro// phyi ma bzhi po mdo rgyan du yang ngo*// ye shes zhabs sogs ltar na/ sa bcu pa'i mnyam gzhag gi skabs na khyad med cing rjes thob kyi skabs su khyad yod la sa'i khyad par yang rjes thob kyi skabs kyi dbang du byas par bzhed de/ sdud 'grel du/ gal te 'o na ni rab tu dga' ba'i gnas skabs kho nar pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i phyir sa gzhan don med par 'gyur ro
